senses.chn: 像城堡的；有城垛的；有雉堞的

senses.def: the top edge of a castle wall, that has regular spaces along it
white sugar in the form of very fine grains, used in cooking
to criticize sb/sth/yourself severely

ex.en: He castigated himself for being so stupid.
ex.cn: 他责怪自己太笨。

senses.def: the process of choosing actors for a play or film/movie
an object made by pouring hot liquid metal, etc. into a mould (= a specially shaped container)
used to refer to a process in which actors are chosen for a film/movie, etc. if they have sex with the person in charge of choosing the actors
senses.chn: 床笫选角（为争演角色与负责选派角色者发生性关系）

senses.def: the vote given by the person in charge of an official meeting to decide an issue when votes on each side are equal
senses.chn: （会议主席在赞成票和反对票票数相等时所投的）决定票

senses.def: a hard type of iron that does not bend easily and is shaped by pouring the hot liquid metal into a mould (= a specially shaped container)
made of cast iron

ex.en: a cast-iron bridge
ex.cn: 铸铁桥

senses.def: very strong or certain; that cannot be broken or fail
senses.chn: 有力的；确实的；坚定不移的

ex.en: a cast-iron guarantee/promise
ex.cn: 永不反悔的保证；铁誓

ex.en: a cast-iron excuse/alibi
ex.cn: 有说服力的辩解；不在犯罪现场的确凿证据

senses.def: a large strong building with thick high walls and towers, built in the past by kings or queens, or other important people, to defend themselves against attack
any of the four pieces placed in the corner squares of the board at the start of the game, usually made to look like a castle
(to have) plans or dreams that are not likely to happen or come true
a person's home is a place where they can be private and safe and do as they like
senses.chn: 人之住宅即其城堡；人在家中，自成一统

senses.def: to undo the ropes that are holding a boat in a fixed position, in order to sail away
to remove stitches from the needles in a way that forms an edge that will not come undone
a piece of clothing that the original owner no longer wants to wear
to put the first row of stitches on a needle
one of the small wheels fixed to the bottom of a piece of furniture so that it can be moved easily
a thick yellow oil obtained from a tropical plant and used in the past as a type of medicine, usually as a laxative
to remove the testicles of a male animal or person
senses.chn: 割除（男子或雄性动物）的睾丸；阉割

senses.def: to consider a lot of different people, activities, possibilities, etc. when you are looking for sth
senses.chn: 撒开大网（搜寻时考虑面要宽）

senses.def: not showing much care or thought; seeming not to be worried; not wanting to show that sth is important to you
senses.chn: 不经意的；无忧无虑的；漫不经心的；不在乎的

ex.en: a casual manner
ex.cn: 漫不经心的样子

ex.en: It was just a casual remark—I wasn't really serious.
ex.cn: 我只是随便说说，并不当真。

ex.en: He tried to sound casual, but I knew he was worried.
ex.cn: 他讲话时试图显得不在乎，但我知道他心里着急。

ex.en: They have a casual attitude towards safety (= they don't care enough).
ex.cn: 他们对安全问题采取无所谓的态度。

senses.def: without paying attention to detail

ex.en: a casual glance
ex.cn: 随便扫一眼

ex.en: It's obvious even to the casual observer.
ex.cn: 即便再马虎的人也能一眼看明白是怎么回事。

senses.def: not formal

ex.en: casual clothes (= comfortable clothes that you choose to wear in your free time)
ex.cn: 便装

ex.en: family parties and other casual occasions
ex.cn: 家庭聚会和其他非正式场合

senses.def: not permanent; not done, or doing sth regularly

ex.en: casual workers/labour
ex.cn: 临时工

ex.en: Students sometimes do casual work in the tourist trade.
ex.cn: 学生有时做些旅游方面的零工。

ex.en: They are employed on a casual basis (= they do not have a permanent job with the company).
ex.cn: 他们被雇为临时工。

senses.def: without deep affection

ex.en: a casual acquaintance
ex.cn: 泛泛之交

ex.en: a casual friendship
ex.cn: 一般的友谊

ex.en: to have casual sex (= to have sex without having a steady relationship with that partner)
ex.cn: 做露水鸳鸯

senses.def: happening by chance; doing sth by chance

ex.en: a casual encounter/meeting
ex.cn: 不期而遇；邂逅

ex.en: a casual passer-by
ex.cn: 碰巧过路的人

ex.en: The exhibition is interesting to both the enthusiast and the casual visitor.
ex.cn: 热心的爱好者和碰巧来参观的人都认为这个展览有意思。

ex.en: The disease is not spread by casual contact.
ex.cn: 此病不会通过偶然接触传染。

senses.def: informal clothes or shoes

ex.en: dressed in casuals
ex.cn: 穿着便装

senses.def: a casual worker (= one who does not work permanently for a company)
the practice of employing temporary staff for short periods instead of permanent staff, in order to save costs
senses.chn: 雇用临时工制（以节省开支）

senses.def: a person who is killed or injured in war or in an accident
senses.chn: （战争或事故的）伤员，亡者，遇难者

ex.en: road casualties
ex.cn: 交通事故伤亡人员

ex.en: Both sides had suffered heavy casualties (= many people had been killed).
ex.cn: 双方都伤亡惨重。

senses.def: a person that suffers or a thing that is destroyed when sth else takes place

ex.en: She became a casualty of the reduction in part-time work (= she lost her job).
ex.cn: 她成了裁减兼职工作的受害人。

ex.en: Small shops have been a casualty of the recession.
ex.cn: 小商店在经济萧条中深受其害。

senses.def: the part of a hospital where people who need urgent treatment are taken

ex.en: The victims were rushed to casualty.
ex.cn: 受伤者被迅速送往急救室。

senses.def: a way of solving moral or legal problems by using clever arguments that may be false
senses.chn: 诡辩（指用似是而非的论点解决伦理或法律问题）

senses.def: an act or situation that is used to justify a war

ex.en: cat food
ex.cn: 猫粮

senses.def: a wild animal of the cat family

ex.en: the big cats (= lions, tigers, etc.)
ex.cn: 大型猫科动物（狮、虎等）

senses.def: to be the best thing, person, idea, etc.
senses.chn: 最棒的东西（或人、主意等）

ex.en: He thinks he's the cat's whiskers (= he has a high opinion of himself).
ex.cn: 他自以为了不起。

senses.def: to tell a secret carelessly or by mistake

ex.en: I wanted it to be a surprise, but my sister let the cat out of the bag.
ex.cn: 我想给大家来个惊喜，可我妹妹却先说漏了嘴。

senses.def: very nervous
senses.chn: 局促不安；如坐针毡；像热锅上的蚂蚁

ex.en: She was like a cat on hot bricks before her driving test.
ex.cn: 她考驾驶执照前十分紧张不安。

senses.def: very pleased with yourself
said to sb, especially a child, who stays silent when expected to speak, for example after being asked a question

ex.en: What's the matter? Cat got your tongue?

senses.def: to look dirty and untidy
senses.chn: 穿着邋遢；衣衫褴褛；不修边幅

senses.def: to have no chance at all
to play a cruel game with sb in your power by changing your behaviour very often, so that they become nervous and do not know what to expect
senses.chn: 和某人玩起猫捉老鼠的游戏；耍弄

senses.def: to say or do sth that is likely to cause trouble
people enjoy themselves more and behave with greater freedom when the person in charge of them is not there
senses.chn: 猫儿不在，老鼠玩得自在（指管事的不在，下面的玩个痛快）

senses.def: used to tell sb not to ask questions or try to find out about things that do not concern them
senses.chn: 好奇害死猫（让人别提问或打听与己无关的事情）

senses.def: used to describe a very difficult task, especially one that involves organizing people
senses.chn: 如牧猫般困难（形容非常难的任务，尤涉及对人的组织管理）

ex.en: Managing a political party is a lot like herding cats.
ex.cn: 管理一个政党很像放牧一群猫，极为困难。

senses.def: to be raining heavily
when sb says there's no room to swing a cat, they mean that a room is very small and that there is not enough space
senses.chn: 没有活动的余地；连转身都很难

senses.def: there are many different ways to achieve sth
senses.chn: （要做成某事）方法不只一个，有的是办法

senses.def: the process by which chemical structures are broken down and energy is released
a sudden disaster or a violent event that causes change, for example a flood or a war
senses.chn: （突然降临的）大灾难，大灾变，大动乱

senses.def: a series of underground tunnels used for burying dead people, especially in ancient times
senses.chn: （尤指古代纵横交错的）地下墓穴

senses.def: a decorated platform on which the dead body of a famous person is placed before a funeral
a language spoken in Catalonia, Andorra, the Balearic Islands and parts of southern France
senses.chn: 加泰罗尼亚语（通行于西班牙加泰罗尼亚、安道尔、巴利阿里群岛和法国南部一些地区）

senses.def: a person who was born in or who lives in Catalonia
connected with Catalonia, its people, its language, or its culture
senses.chn: 加泰罗尼亚的；加泰罗尼亚人（或语言、文化）的

senses.def: a condition in which sb's body becomes stiff and they temporarily become unconscious
senses.chn: 僵住；僵住症；强直性昏厥；倔强症

senses.def: a complete list of items, for example of things that people can look at or buy

ex.en: a mail-order catalogue (= a book showing goods for sale to be sent to people's homes)
ex.cn: 邮购商品目录

ex.en: to consult the library catalogue
ex.cn: 查看图书馆目录

ex.en: An illustrated catalogue accompanies the exhibition.
ex.cn: 展览会有插图目录。

ex.en: an online catalogue
ex.cn: 联机目录

senses.def: a long series of things that happen (usually bad things)

ex.en: a catalogue of disasters/errors/misfortunes
ex.cn: 接二连三的灾难／错误／不幸

senses.def: to arrange a list of things in order in a catalogue; to record sth in a catalogue
to give a list of things connected with a particular person, event, etc.
senses.chn: 记载，登记（某人、某事等的详情）

ex.en: Interviews with the refugees catalogue a history of discrimination and violence.
ex.cn: 对难民的采访记录下了一部歧视和暴力的历史。

senses.def: to make a chemical reaction happen faster
a substance that makes a chemical reaction happen faster without being changed itself
a person or thing that causes a change
senses.chn: 促使变化的人；引发变化的因素

ex.en: I see my role as being a catalyst for change.
ex.cn: 我认为我的角色是促成变革。

senses.def: a device used in the exhaust system of vehicles to reduce the damage caused to the environment
senses.chn: 催化转化器，催化式排气净化器（用以净化机动车废气）

senses.def: a fast sailing boat with two hulls
a boy kept as a slave for a man to have sex with
a word that refers to or has the same meaning as a later word. For example in 'When he saw me, Steve looked shocked', 'he' is a cataphor for 'Steve'.
senses.chn: 后指词，下指语（如 When he saw me, Steve looked shocked 中的 he 是 Steve 的后指词）

senses.def: the use of a cataphor
a stick shaped like a Y with a rubber band attached to it, used by children for shooting stones
a weapon used in the past to throw heavy stones
a machine used for sending planes up into the air from a ship
senses.chn: 弹射器（用以从舰船上弹射飞机升空）

senses.def: to throw sb/sth or be thrown suddenly and violently through the air

ex.en: She was catapulted out of the car as it hit the wall.
ex.cn: 汽车撞墙时，她被甩出车外。

ex.en: The movie catapulted him to international stardom.
ex.cn: 这部电影使他一跃成为国际明星。

senses.def: a medical condition that affects the lens of the eye and causes a gradual loss of sight
a large steep waterfall
thick liquid (called phlegm) that you have in your nose and throat because, for example, you have a cold
a sudden event that causes many people to suffer

ex.en: Early warnings of rising water levels prevented another major catastrophe.
ex.cn: 提前发出的洪水水位上涨警报防止了又一次的重大灾害。

senses.def: an event that causes one person or a group of people personal suffering, or that makes difficulties

ex.en: The attempt to expand the business was a catastrophe for the firm.
ex.cn: 扩展业务的尝试使这家公司陷入困境。

ex.en: We've had a few catastrophes with the food for the party.
ex.cn: 我们为聚会准备食物时遇到了一些困难。

senses.def: part of mathematics that deals with systems that sometimes change suddenly
a condition resulting from a mental illness, especially schizophrenia, in which a person does not move for long periods
not able to move or show any reaction to things because of illness, shock, etc.
to have an advantage over other people or be in control of a situation
senses.chn: 处于有利地位；控制着局势

senses.def: a thief who climbs up the outside of a building in order to enter it and steal sth
a noise or shout expressing anger at or disapproval of sb who is speaking or performing in public
senses.chn: （表示愤怒或反对的）嘘声，不满之声

senses.def: to stop and hold a moving object, especially in your hands

ex.en: She managed to catch the keys as they fell.
ex.cn: 她接住了落下的钥匙。

ex.en: 'Throw me over that towel, will you?' 'OK. Catch!'
ex.cn: “请你把毛巾扔过来好吗？” “好，接住！”

ex.en: The dog caught the stick in its mouth.
ex.cn: 狗衔住了木棍。

senses.def: to hold a liquid when it falls

ex.en: The roof was leaking and I had to use a bucket to catch the drips.
ex.cn: 屋顶漏雨，我不得不用桶来接。

senses.def: to take hold of sb/sth

ex.en: He caught hold of her arm as she tried to push past him.
ex.cn: 她试图从他身边挤过去时，他一把抓住了她的手臂。

senses.def: to capture a person or an animal that tries or would try to escape

ex.en: The murderer was never caught.
ex.cn: 这个杀人犯一直未抓到。

ex.en: Our cat is hopeless at catching mice.
ex.cn: 我们的猫绝对捉不到老鼠。

ex.en: How many fish did you catch?
ex.cn: 你捕到几条鱼？

senses.def: to find or discover sb doing sth, especially sth wrong

ex.en: I caught her smoking in the bathroom.
ex.cn: 我撞见她在盥洗室里抽烟。

ex.en: You wouldn't catch me working (= I would never work) on a Sunday!
ex.cn: 你绝对不会看到我在星期日工作！

ex.en: She caught herself wondering whether she had made a mistake.
ex.cn: 她发觉自己在怀疑是否犯了错误。

ex.en: He was caught with bomb-making equipment in his home.
ex.cn: 他被发现家里藏有制造炸弹的设备。

ex.en: Mark walked in and caught them at it (= in the act of doing sth wrong).
ex.cn: 马克走了进去，当场发现他们正在干坏事。

ex.en: thieves caught in the act
ex.cn: 偷窃时被当场抓住的窃贼

senses.def: to be in time for a bus, train, plane, etc. and get on it
senses.chn: 赶上（公共汽车、火车、飞机等）

ex.en: We caught the 12.15 from Oxford.
ex.cn: 我们赶上了 12:15 从牛津发出的火车。

ex.en: I must go—I have a train to catch.
ex.cn: 我得走了，我要赶火车。

senses.def: to be in time to do sth, talk to sb, etc.

ex.en: I caught him just as he was leaving the building.
ex.cn: 他正要离开大楼时，我追上了他。

ex.en: I was hoping to catch you at home (= to telephone you at home when you were there).
ex.cn: 我本希望赶上你在家的时候给你打电话。

ex.en: The illness can be treated provided it's caught (= discovered) early enough.
ex.cn: 此病若及早发现是可医治的。

ex.en: to catch the post (= post letters before the box is emptied)
ex.cn: （寄信）赶上邮局的收信时刻

ex.en: Bye for now! I'll catch you later (= speak to you again later).
ex.cn: 再见！下次再谈。

senses.def: to see or hear sth; to attend sth

ex.en: Let's eat now and maybe we could catch a movie later.
ex.cn: 咱们现在就吃吧，也许还能赶上一场电影。

ex.en: She looked for him but couldn't see him in the crowd.
ex.cn: 她在人群里找来找去，但没看见他。

ex.en: He could see (that) she had been crying.
ex.cn: 他看得出她哭过。

ex.en: I've just spotted a mistake on the front cover.
ex.cn: 我刚才在封面上发现了一处错误。

ex.en: She caught sight of a car in the distance.
ex.cn: 她瞥见远处有一辆车。

ex.en: He caught a glimpse of himself in the mirror.
ex.cn: 他看了一眼镜子中的自己。

senses.def: to happen unexpectedly and put sb in a difficult situation

ex.en: His arrival caught me by surprise.
ex.cn: 他的到来让我感到意外。

ex.en: She got caught in a thunderstorm.
ex.cn: 她遇上了雷雨。

senses.def: to get an illness

ex.en: to catch measles
ex.cn: 染上麻疹

ex.en: I think I must have caught this cold from you.
ex.cn: 我的感冒想必是你传染的。

senses.def: to become stuck in or on sth; to make sth become stuck

ex.en: Her dress caught on a nail.
ex.cn: 她的连衣裙被钉子钩住了。

ex.en: He caught his thumb in the door.
ex.cn: 他的拇指被门夹住了。

senses.def: to hit sb/sth

ex.en: The stone caught him on the side of the head.
ex.cn: 他头的侧面被石头击中。

ex.en: She caught him a blow on the chin.
ex.cn: 她一拳打在他下巴上。

senses.def: to notice sth only for a moment

ex.en: She caught sight of a car in the distance.
ex.cn: 她瞥见远处有一辆车。

ex.en: He caught a glimpse of himself in the mirror.
ex.cn: 他看了一眼镜子中的自己。

ex.en: I caught a look of surprise on her face.
ex.cn: 我发现她面露惊奇。

ex.en: He caught a whiff of her perfume.
ex.cn: 他闻到一股她身上的香水味。

senses.def: to hear or understand sth

ex.en: Sorry, I didn't quite catch what you said.
ex.cn: 对不起，我没听清楚你的话。

senses.def: if sth catches your interest, etc., you notice it and feel interested in it
senses.chn: 引起，激发（兴趣、想象、注意等）

senses.def: to show or describe sth accurately

ex.en: The artist has caught her smile perfectly.
ex.cn: 艺术家完美地捕捉到她的微笑。

senses.def: if sth catches the light or the light catches it, the light shines on it and makes it shine too

ex.en: The knife gleamed as it caught the light.
ex.cn: 刀在光照下闪闪发亮。

senses.def: if you catch the sun, you become red or brown because of spending time in the sun
to begin to burn

ex.en: The wooden rafters caught fire.
ex.cn: 木椽子着火了。

ex.en: These logs are wet: they won't catch.
ex.cn: 这些木柴是湿的，烧不着。

senses.def: to make a player unable to continue batting by catching the ball they have hit before it touches the ground
to stop breathing for a moment because of fear, shock, etc.
to breathe normally again after running or doing some tiring exercise
to catch a very bad cold
to attract sb's attention
senses.chn: 引起某人注意；惹人注目

ex.en: Can you catch the waiter's eye?
ex.cn: 你能引起服务员的注意吗？

senses.def: to be punished or spoken to angrily about sth

ex.en: If your dad finds out you'll really catch it!
ex.cn: 要是你老爸知道了，你非挨骂不可！

senses.def: to get an advantage over sb by doing sth when they are not expecting it and not ready for it
senses.chn: 使人措手不及；乘其不备

senses.def: to surprise sb by doing sth when they are not expecting it and not ready for it
to catch sb in the act of doing sth wrong or committing a crime
to arrive or do sth when sb is not expecting it and not ready, especially when they are in an embarrassing situation
senses.chn: 使突陷窘境；乘人措手不及；出其不意；冷不防

senses.def: to make sb/sth unsteady and in danger of falling
senses.chn: 使失去平衡（而有跌落危险）

ex.en: I was thrown off balance by the sudden gust of wind.
ex.cn: 突如其来的一阵风差点儿把我吹倒。

senses.def: to make sb surprised and no longer calm
senses.chn: 使（毫无准备而）不知所措

ex.en: The senator was clearly caught off balance by the unexpected question.
ex.cn: 参议员显然因这意想不到的问题而乱了阵脚。

senses.def: to be in a difficult situation when any action you take will have bad results
the person who takes the opportunity to do sth before other people will have an advantage over them
to attract or please sb

ex.en: She looked through the hotel advertisements until one of them caught her fancy.
ex.cn: 她仔细查看旅馆广告，终于有一家中了她的意。

senses.def: to upset sb by reminding them of sth they are particularly sensitive about
senses.chn: 触到某人的痛处；揭某人的疮疤

senses.def: in a situation where you have to choose between two things, both of which are unpleasant
to suddenly feel an urgent need to go to the toilet/bathroom
senses.chn: 突然感觉要上厕所；内急

senses.def: to be put at a disadvantage
to become popular or fashionable
senses.chn: 受欢迎；流行起来；变得时髦

ex.en: He invented a new game, but it never really caught on.
ex.cn: 他发明了一种新的游戏，但从未真正流行起来。

senses.def: to understand sth

ex.en: He is very quick to catch on to things.
ex.cn: 他领悟能力很强。

senses.def: to surprise sb and put them in a difficult position

ex.en: Many investors were caught out by the fall in share prices.
ex.cn: 许多投资者由于股价下跌而突然陷入困境。

senses.def: to show that sb does not know much or is doing sth wrong
senses.chn: 抓住某人的短处；指出无知；指出过失

ex.en: They tried to catch her out with a difficult question.
ex.cn: 他们试图用一道难题去难倒她。

senses.def: to spend extra time doing sth because you have not done it earlier
senses.chn: 补做（未做的事）；赶做；补上

ex.en: I have a lot of work to catch up on.
ex.cn: 我有许多工作要补做。

senses.def: to find out about things that have happened

senses.chn: 最重要的；首要的；主要的

ex.en: The central issue is that of widespread racism.
ex.cn: 最重要的问题是种族主义到处泛滥。

ex.en: She has been a central figure in the campaign.
ex.cn: 她一直是这场运动的主要人物。

ex.en: Prevention also plays a central role in traditional medicine.
ex.cn: 预防在传统医学中也起着主导作用。

ex.en: Reducing inflation is central to (= is an important part of) the government's economic policy.
ex.cn: 减少通货膨胀是政府经济政策重要的组成部分。

ex.en: Be careful crossing the main road.
ex.cn: 过大马路时小心点。

ex.en: The main thing is to remain calm.
ex.cn: 最重要的是要保持冷静。

senses.def: having power or control over other parts
senses.chn: 起支配作用的；有控制力的

ex.en: the central committee (= of a political party)
ex.cn: （政党的）中央委员会

ex.en: The organization has a central office in York.
ex.cn: 该组织在约克设有总部。

senses.def: in the centre of an area or object

ex.en: central London
ex.cn: 伦敦中心区

ex.en: Central America/Europe/Asia
ex.cn: 中美洲；中欧；中亚

ex.en: the central area of the brain
ex.cn: 大脑中枢

senses.def: easily reached from many areas
senses.chn: 容易到达的；交通方便的；四通八达的

ex.en: The flat is very central—just five minutes from Princes Street.
ex.cn: 这座公寓位于市中心，离王子街只需要五分钟。

ex.en: a central location
ex.cn: 中心位置

senses.def: produced with the centre of the tongue in a higher position than the front or the back, for example /ɜː/ in bird
senses.chn: 中央的（发音时舌高点在口腔中间位置）

senses.def: (a person) from the Central African Republic
senses.chn: 中非共和国人；中非共和国的；中非共和国人的

senses.def: the part of N America that consists of Guatemala, Belize, Honduras, El Salvador, Nicaragua, Costa Rica and Panama
senses.chn: 中美洲（包括危地马拉、伯利兹、洪都拉斯、萨尔瓦多、尼加拉瓜、哥斯达黎加以及巴拿马）

senses.def: a national bank that does business with the government and other banks, and issues the country's coins and paper money
a company or a department that supplies actors, usually for small, stereotypical film roles
senses.chn: 角色分派中心（通常分派模式化次要电影角色的公司或部门）

ex.en: He looked like an absent-minded professor straight out of central casting.
ex.cn: 他看起来就像径直从角色分派中心走出来的心不在焉的教授。

senses.def: the time used in summer in the central US and Canada, which is five hours behind UTC
senses.chn: 中部夏令时（美国中部和加拿大中部的夏令时，比协调世界时晚五小时）

senses.def: the time used in summer in central and part of western Europe, which is two hours ahead of UTC
senses.chn: 欧洲中部夏令时间，中欧夏令时（用于中欧及部分西欧地区，比协调世界时早两个小时）

senses.def: the time used in winter in central and part of western Europe, which is one hour ahead of UTC
senses.chn: 欧洲中部时间（欧洲中部和西欧部分地区的冬季时间，比协调世界时早一小时）

senses.def: the government of a whole country, rather than local government which is concerned with smaller areas
a system for heating a building from one source which then sends the hot water or hot air around the building through pipes
senses.chn: 集中供热；中央供暖（系统）

senses.def: a way of organizing sth, such as government or education, that involves one central group of people controlling the whole system
senses.chn: 中央集权制（或主义）；集中制

senses.def: to give the control of a country or an organization to a group of people in one particular place

ex.en: a highly centralized system of government
ex.cn: 高度中央集权的政府体制

senses.def: a system for locking a car in which all the doors can be locked or opened at the same time
senses.chn: （汽车的）中央门锁系统，中央控制门锁

senses.def: the part of the system of nerves in the body that consists of the brain and the spinal cord
the part of a computer that controls all the other parts of the system
senses.chn: 中央处理器；中央处理机

senses.def: a narrow strip of land that separates the two sides of a major road such as a motorway or interstate
senses.chn: （高速公路、州际公路等的）中央隔离带

senses.def: the time used in winter in the central US and Canada, which is six hours behind UTC
senses.chn: 中部标准时间（美国中部和加拿大中部的冬季时间，比协调世界时晚六小时）

senses.def: the time at the line of longitude 90°W, which is the standard time in the central US and Canada
senses.chn: 中部时间（指西经 90 度的时间，是美国中部和加拿大的标准时间）

senses.def: the middle point or part of sth

ex.en: the centre of a circle
ex.cn: 圆心

ex.en: a long table in the centre of the room
ex.cn: 房间中央的长桌

ex.en: chocolates with soft centres
ex.cn: 软心巧克力糖

senses.def: the main part of a town or city where there are a lot of shops/stores and offices

ex.en: in the town/city centre
ex.cn: 在镇／市中心区

ex.en: the centre of town
ex.cn: 市中心

ex.en: a town-centre car park
ex.cn: 市中心停车场

senses.def: a place or an area where a lot of people live; a place where a lot of business or cultural activity takes place
senses.chn: 人口集中的地区；商业中心区；文化中心区

ex.en: major urban/industrial centres
ex.cn: 主要城市／工业中心

ex.en: a centre of population
ex.cn: 人口密集区

ex.en: Small towns in South India serve as economic and cultural centres for the surrounding villages.
ex.cn: 印度南部的小城镇是周围村庄的经济文化中心。

senses.def: a building or place used for a particular purpose or activity

ex.en: a shopping/sports/leisure/community centre
ex.cn: 购物／运动／休闲／社区中心

ex.en: the Centre for Policy Studies
ex.cn: 政策研究中心

senses.def: a place where a particular kind of work is done extremely well
senses.chn: 居领先地位的中心；（某领域中成绩突出的）中心

senses.def: the point towards which people direct their attention

ex.en: Children like to be the centre of attention.
ex.cn: 小孩子喜欢受到大家的关注。

ex.en: The prime minister is at the centre of a political row over leaked Cabinet documents.
ex.cn: 首相成了内阁文件泄密而引起的一场政治风波的中心人物。

senses.def: having the thing mentioned as the most important feature or centre of attention
senses.chn: 有…最重要特征的；有…中心的；以…为中心的

ex.en: a child-centred approach to teaching
ex.cn: 以儿童为中心的教学法

senses.def: a moderate political position or party, between the extremes of left-wing and right-wing (= middle) political position or party, between the extremes of left-wing and right-wing parties

ex.en: a party of the centre
ex.cn: 中间党派

senses.def: a player or position in the middle of the pitch/field, court, etc.
in or into the most important position
in all directions; everywhere

ex.en: He's giving away money left, right and centre.
ex.cn: 他到处赠款。

senses.def: to move sth so that it is in the centre of sth else

ex.en: Carefully centre the photograph on the page and stick it in place.
ex.cn: 把照片小心地放在页面中央并粘贴好。

senses.def: to be or make sb/sth become the person or thing around which most activity, etc. takes place
senses.chn: 把…当作中心；（使）成为中心

ex.en: State occasions always centred around the king.
ex.cn: 国家庆典总是以国王为中心。

ex.en: Discussions were centred on developments in Eastern Europe.
ex.cn: 讨论围绕着东欧的发展这一中心议题进行。

senses.def: to make somewhere the place where an activity or event takes place

ex.en: Most of the fighting was centred in the north of the capital.
ex.cn: 战斗大多集中在首都北部。

senses.def: a player or position in the middle of the back line of players
a board that can be passed through a hole in the bottom of a sailing boat to keep it steady when sailing
calm, sensible and emotionally in control

ex.en: My family helps to keep me centred.
ex.cn: 家人帮助我保持冷静。

senses.def: a large picture, often of a young woman with few or no clothes on, folded to form the middle pages of a magazine
senses.chn: （杂志内常刊登性感女郎照片的）中间插页

senses.def: a person whose picture is the centrefold of a magazine
a player or position in the middle of the front line of players
supporting both capitalism and gradual social change
senses.chn: 中左的（指支持资本主义和渐进式社会改革的）

ex.en: a centre-left coalition government
ex.cn: 中间靠左的联合政府

senses.def: the point in an object at which its weight is considered to act
the most important item

ex.en: This treaty is the centrepiece of the government's foreign policy.
ex.cn: 这个条约是政府外交政策最重要的一环。

senses.def: a decoration for the centre of a table
supporting capitalism and accepting some social change
senses.chn: 中右的（指支持资本主义并接受某些社会改革的）

ex.en: Europe's centre-right parties
ex.cn: 欧洲的中右党派

senses.def: the two facing middle pages of a newspaper or magazine
an important position where sb/sth can easily get people's attention

ex.en: Education is taking centre stage in the government's plans.
ex.cn: 教育正在成为政府计划的核心。

ex.en: This region continues to occupy centre stage in world affairs.
ex.cn: 这个地区继续在国际舞台上占主导地位。

senses.def: moving or tending to move away from a centre
a force that appears to cause an object travelling around a centre to fly away from the centre and off its circular path
a machine with a part that spins around to separate substances, for example liquids from solids, by forcing the heavier substance to the outer edge
senses.chn: 离心机；离心分离机；离心过滤机

senses.def: moving or tending to move towards a centre
a person with political views that are not extreme
(in ancient Rome) an army officer who commanded 100 soldiers
senses.chn: 百夫长（古罗马军队中管理 100 名士兵的军官）

senses.def: a period of 100 years *
any of the periods of 100 years before or after the birth of Christ

ex.en: the 20th century (= AD 1901–2000 or 1900–1999)
ex.cn: 20 世纪

ex.en: eighteenth-century writers
ex.cn: 18 世纪的作家

senses.def: a score of 100 runs by one player
the time when a new century/year starts
senses.chn: 世纪之交；新年伊始；辞旧迎新之际

ex.en: It was built at the turn of the century.
ex.cn: 这是在世纪之交修建的。

senses.def: chief executive officer (the person with the highest rank in a business company)
a type of mushroom which many people consider to be one of the best to eat
senses.chn: 牛肝菌（一种可食用的蘑菇）

senses.def: in or related to the head

a type of mollusc and squid with a combined head and body and large eyes. Cephalopods have arms and/or tentacles(= long thin parts like arms), which may have suckers(= round parts that suck) on them. Octopus and squid are cephalopods.
senses.chn: 头足类，头足纲动物（如章鱼和乌贼）

senses.def: a pot or other object made of clay that has been made permanently hard by heat

ex.en: an exhibition of ceramics by Picasso
ex.cn: 毕加索陶瓷作品展

senses.def: the art of making and decorating ceramics
senses.chn: 制陶艺术；陶瓷装潢艺术

senses.def: one of various types of grass that produce grains that can be eaten or are used to make flour or bread. Wheat, barley and rye are all cereals.

ex.en: cereal crops
ex.cn: 谷类作物

senses.def: the grain produced by cereal crops
food made from the grain of cereals, often eaten for breakfast with milk
senses.chn: （常加牛奶作早餐用的）谷类食物

ex.en: breakfast cereals
ex.cn: 谷类早餐食物

ex.en: a bowl of cereal
ex.cn: 一碗麦片粥

senses.def: the part of the brain at the back of the head that controls the activity of the muscles
relating to the brain

ex.en: a cerebral haemorrhage
ex.cn: 脑出血

senses.def: relating to the mind rather than the feelings

ex.en: His poetry is very cerebral.
ex.cn: 他的诗富有理性。

senses.def: a medical condition usually caused by brain damage before or at birth that causes the loss of control of movement in the arms and legs
the front part of the brain, responsible for thoughts, emotions and personality
relating to or used in a ceremony
senses.chn: 礼仪的；礼节的；用于礼仪的

ex.en: ceremonial occasions
ex.cn: 礼仪场合

ex.en: a ceremonial sword
ex.cn: 礼仪佩剑

senses.def: the system of rules and traditions that states how things should be done at a ceremony or formal occasion

ex.en: The visit was conducted with all due ceremonial.
ex.cn: 访问按照一切应有的礼仪进行。

senses.def: behaving or performed in an extremely formal way
a public or religious occasion that includes a series of formal or traditional actions

ex.en: an awards/opening ceremony
ex.cn: 颁奖／开幕仪式

ex.en: a wedding/marriage ceremony
ex.cn: 婚礼

senses.def: formal behaviour; traditional actions and words used on particular formal occasions
to behave formally

ex.en: Please don't stand on ceremony (= Please be natural and relaxed) with me.
ex.cn: 请别跟我讲客套。

senses.def: in a very rough or informal way
senses.chn: 粗鲁无礼；不拘礼节；随便

ex.en: He found himself pushed without ceremony out of the house and the door slammed in his face.
ex.cn: 他被毫不客气地推出屋子，门砰的一声当着他的面关上了。

senses.def: pinkish-red in colour
a chemical element. Cerium is a silver-white metal used in the production of glass and ceramics.
a thing that is sure to happen or be successful
senses.chn: 必然发生的事；确定无疑的事；有把握成功的事

ex.en: That horse is a dead cert for (= is sure to win) the next race.
ex.cn: 那匹马下一场比赛准赢。

senses.def: that you can rely on to happen or to be true

ex.en: The climbers face certain death if the rescue today is unsuccessful.
ex.cn: 救援行动如果今天不能成功，登山队员必死无疑。

ex.en: It is certain that they will agree.
ex.cn: 他们一定会同意。

ex.en: She looks certain to win an Oscar.
ex.cn: 看来奥斯卡金像奖非她莫属。

ex.en: They are certain to agree.
ex.cn: 他们一定会同意。

ex.en: If you want to be certain of getting a ticket, book now.
ex.cn: 要想有把握买到票，现在就得预订。

ex.en: It's certain that they will agree.
ex.cn: 他们肯定会同意。

senses.def: firmly believing sth; having no doubts

ex.en: She wasn't certain (that) he had seen her.
ex.cn: 她不敢肯定他见过她。

ex.en: Are you absolutely certain about this?
ex.cn: 你对这事绝对确信无疑吗？

ex.en: I'm not certain who was there.
ex.cn: 我无法确定谁当时在场。

ex.en: To my certain knowledge he was somewhere else at the time (= I am sure about it).
ex.cn: 我敢肯定他当时不在现场。

senses.def: used to mention a particular thing, person or group without giving any more details about it or them
senses.chn: （不提及细节时用）某事，某人，某种

ex.en: For certain personal reasons I shall not be able to attend.
ex.cn: 由于某种个人原因，我将不能出席。

ex.en: Certain people might disagree with this.
ex.cn: 某些人对这事可能不会赞同。

ex.en: They refused to release their hostages unless certain conditions were met.
ex.cn: 除非某些条件得到满足，否则他们不会释放人质。

senses.def: used with a person's name to show that the speaker does not know the person
senses.chn: （与人名连用，表示说话者不识其人）某某，某位，一位叫…的

ex.en: It was a certain Dr Davis who performed the operation.
ex.cn: 是一位叫戴维斯的医生做的手术。

senses.def: slight; noticeable, but difficult to describe
senses.chn: 轻微的；微小的；显而易见却难以描述的

ex.en: That's true, to a certain extent.
ex.cn: 在一定程度上的确如此。

ex.en: I felt there was a certain coldness in her manner.
ex.cn: 我觉得她的态度有点冷淡。

senses.def: without doubt

ex.en: I can't say for certain when we'll arrive.
ex.cn: 我说不准我们什么时候能到。

senses.def: to find out whether sth is definitely true

ex.en: I think there's a bus at 8 but you'd better call to make certain.
ex.cn: 好像 8 点有一班公共汽车，不过你最好打电话弄清楚。

senses.def: to do sth in order to be sure that sth else will happen

ex.en: You'll have to leave soon to make certain of getting there on time.
ex.cn: 你得快点出发，好确保准时到达那里。

senses.def: if you talk about a person being of a certain age, you mean that they are no longer young but not yet old
senses.chn: 不算年轻的；年纪不轻的；中年的

ex.en: The show appeals to an audience of a certain age.
ex.cn: 这个节目中年观众感兴趣。

senses.def: used for talking about some members of a group of people or things without giving their names
senses.chn: （不提及人或事物的名称时用）某些

ex.en: Certain of those present were unwilling to discuss the matter further.
ex.cn: 某些在场的人不愿意进一步讨论这个问题。

senses.def: without doubt

ex.en: Without treatment, she will almost certainly die.
ex.cn: 要是不治疗，她十有八九会死。

ex.en: Certainly, the early years are crucial to a child's development.
ex.cn: 毫无疑问，幼年对儿童的发展至关重要。

ex.en: I'm certainly never going there again.
ex.cn: 我肯定不会再去那里了。

ex.en: Surely this can't be right?
ex.cn: 这不可能是对的吧？

ex.en: You're surely not thinking of going, are you?
ex.cn: 你不是想走吧？

ex.en: I'll certainly remember this trip!
ex.cn: 我绝不会忘记这次旅行！

senses.def: of course

ex.en: 'May I see your passport, Mr Scott?' 'Certainly.'
ex.cn: “斯科特先生，请出示您的护照好吗？” “当然可以。”

ex.en: 'Do you think all this money will change your life?' 'Certainly not.'
ex.cn: “你认为这些钱会改变你的生活吗？” “当然不会。”

senses.def: a thing that is certain

ex.en: political/moral certainties
ex.cn: 政治上／道德上确定无疑的事

ex.en: Her return to the team now seems a certainty.
ex.cn: 她的归队现在似乎已成定局。

senses.def: the state of being certain

ex.en: There is no certainty that the president's removal would end the civil war.
ex.cn: 总统下台是否会结束内战现在还很难说。

ex.en: I can't say with any certainty where I'll be next week.
ex.cn: 我根本说不准我下周会在什么地方。

senses.def: a person who is certifiable can or should be officially stated to be insane
senses.chn: 可证明患有精神病的；应被证明为精神病患者的

ex.en: He's certifiable (= he's crazy).
ex.cn: 他脑子有问题。

senses.def: good enough to be officially accepted or recommended
an official document that may be used to prove that the facts it states are true

ex.en: a birth/marriage/death certificate
ex.cn: 出生／结婚／死亡证明

senses.def: an official document proving that you have completed a course of study or passed an exam; a qualification obtained after a course of study or an exam
senses.chn: 文凭；结业证书；合格证书

ex.en: a Postgraduate Certificate in Education (= a British qualification for teachers)
ex.cn: 教育学研究生证书（英国教师资格证书）

senses.def: to give sb an official document proving that they have successfully completed a training course, especially for a particular profession
senses.chn: 发给结业证书；（尤指）发给职业培训证书

senses.def: having the certificate which shows that the necessary training for a particular job has been done
senses.chn: 持有职业培训证书的；有执业资格的

senses.def: the act of certifying sth

ex.en: the medical certification of the cause of death
ex.cn: 为死因出具医学鉴定书

senses.def: the process of giving certificates for a course of education

ex.en: the certification of the exam modules
ex.cn: 出具考试课程结业证书

senses.def: a cheque that a bank guarantees
a method of sending a letter or package in which the person sending it gets an official note to say it has been posted and the person receiving it must sign a form when it is delivered
senses.chn: 挂号邮寄（寄件人会收到发件通知，收件人需签收）

senses.def: a fully trained and qualified accountant
senses.chn: 注册会计师；特许会计师

senses.def: to state officially, especially in writing, that sth is true

ex.en: He handed her a piece of paper certifying (that) she was in good health.
ex.cn: 他递给她一份证明其健康状况良好的文件。

ex.en: This (= this document) is to certify that…
ex.cn: 兹证明…

ex.en: He was certified dead on arrival.
ex.cn: 他送达时被证实已死亡。

ex.en: The accounts were certified (as) correct by the finance department.
ex.cn: 账目经财务部门证实无误。

ex.en: The plants must be certified to be virus free.
ex.cn: 这些植物必须具备无病毒证明。

senses.def: to give sb an official document proving that they are qualified to work in a particular profession
senses.chn: 颁发（或授予）专业合格证书

senses.def: to officially state that sb is mentally ill, so that they can be given medical treatment

ex.en: Patients must be certified before they can be admitted to the hospital.
ex.cn: 该医院只接纳经证明患有精神病的人。

senses.def: a feeling of being certain; a thing about which you are certain

ex.en: 'You will like Rome,' he said, with absolute certitude.
ex.cn: “你会喜欢罗马的。” 他深信不疑地说道。

ex.en: the collapse of moral certitudes
ex.cn: 道德信念的崩溃

senses.def: deep blue in colour
a substance like wax which is produced in the ear
connected with the cervix

ex.en: cervical cancer
ex.cn: 宫颈癌

senses.def: connected with the neck

ex.en: the cervical spine
ex.cn: 颈椎

senses.def: the narrow passage at the opening of a woman's womb
a chemical element. Cesium is a soft silver-white metal that reacts strongly in water, used in photoelectric cells.
the stopping of sth; a pause in sth

ex.en: Mexico called for an immediate cessation of hostilities.
ex.cn: 墨西哥要求立即停止敌对行动。

senses.def: a plant with a sweet smell and small white and yellow flowers. Its dried leaves and flowers are used to make tea, medicine, etc.
senses.chn: 苹果菊，春黄菊，甘菊（花及叶可制茶、药等）

ex.en: chamomile tea
ex.cn: 苹果菊茶

senses.def: to bite or eat sth noisily
impatient to do or start doing sth
an informal way of referring to a champion, often used in newspapers
senses.chn: （常用于报章，champion 的非正式写法）冠军

ex.en: Scottish champs celebrate victory!
ex.cn: 苏格兰的冠军庆祝胜利！

senses.def: a French sparkling white wine (= one with bubbles) that is drunk on special occasions

ex.en: a glass of champagne
ex.cn: 一杯香槟酒

senses.def: a person who has socialist ideas but is rich or has social advantages
senses.chn: 香槟酒社会主义者（有社会主义思想但富有或享有社会特权）

senses.def: impatient to do or start doing sth
a person, team, etc. that has won a competition, especially in a sport

ex.en: the world basketball champions
ex.cn: 世界篮球冠军

ex.en: a champion jockey/boxer/swimmer
ex.cn: 获得冠军的赛马骑师／拳击手／游泳运动员

ex.en: the reigning champion (= the person who is champion now)
ex.cn: 本届冠军

senses.def: a person who fights for, or speaks in support of, a group of people or a belief
senses.chn: 斗争者；捍卫者；声援者；拥护者

ex.en: She was a champion of the poor all her life.
ex.cn: 她终身都是穷苦人的卫士。

senses.def: to fight for or speak in support of a group of people or a belief

ex.en: He has always championed the cause of gay rights.
ex.cn: 他一直在为争取同性恋者的权利而斗争。

senses.def: a competition to find the best player or team in a particular sport

ex.en: the National Basketball Association Championship
ex.cn: NBA 总决赛

ex.en: He won a silver medal at the European Championships.
ex.cn: 他获得了欧洲锦标赛的银牌。

senses.def: the position of being a champion

ex.en: They've held the championship for the past two years.
ex.cn: 他们在过去的两年里一直保持着冠军地位。

senses.def: the football (soccer) league in England and Wales that has the second best teams in it, after the premiership (2)
senses.chn: （英格兰和威尔士的）足球冠军联赛（仅次于足球超级联赛）

senses.def: a possibility of sth happening, especially sth that you want
senses.chn: （尤指希望发生的事的）可能性

ex.en: Is there any chance of getting tickets for tonight?
ex.cn: 有可能弄到今晚的票吗？

ex.en: She has only a slim chance of passing the exam.
ex.cn: 她通过考试的希望很渺茫。

ex.en: There's a slight chance that he'll be back in time.
ex.cn: 他及时赶回来的可能性不大。

ex.en: There is no chance that he will change his mind.
ex.cn: 他不可能改变主意。

ex.en: What chance is there of anybody being found alive?
ex.cn: 找到生还者的希望有多大？

ex.en: Nowadays a premature baby has a very good chance of survival.
ex.cn: 如今早产儿存活的希望非常大。

senses.def: a suitable time or situation when you have the opportunity to do sth

ex.en: It was the chance she had been waiting for.
ex.cn: 那正是她一直等待的机会。

ex.en: Jeff deceived me once already—I won't give him a second chance.
ex.cn: 杰夫已骗过我一次，我不会再给他机会。

ex.en: This is your big chance (= opportunity for success).
ex.cn: 这是你成功的大好机会。

ex.en: We won't get another chance of a holiday this year.
ex.cn: 我们今年不会再有机会度假了。

ex.en: Please give me a chance to explain.
ex.cn: 请给我一个解释的机会。

ex.en: Tonight is your last chance to catch the play at your local theatre.
ex.cn: 今晚是你在本地剧院看这出戏的最后一次机会。

senses.def: an unpleasant or dangerous possibility

ex.en: When installing electrical equipment don't take any chances. A mistake could kill.
ex.cn: 安装电器设备时千万不要冒险，一个失误就可能要人命。

senses.def: the way that some things happen without any cause that you can see or understand

ex.en: I met her by chance (= without planning to) at the airport.
ex.cn: 我碰巧在机场遇见她。

ex.en: Chess is not a game of chance.
ex.cn: 国际象棋不是靠运气取胜的。

ex.en: It was pure chance that we were both there.
ex.cn: 我们俩当时都在场纯属巧合。

ex.en: We'll plan everything very carefully and leave nothing to chance.
ex.cn: 我们将非常周密地筹划一切，决不留任何纰漏。

ex.en: This ring has always brought me good luck.
ex.cn: 这戒指总是给我带来好运。

ex.en: The results could simply be due to chance.
ex.cn: 这结果可能纯属意外。

senses.def: happening in a way that was lucky, although it was not planned

ex.en: As chance would have it, John was going to London too, so I went with him.
ex.cn: 赶巧约翰也去伦敦，所以我跟他一块儿去了。

senses.def: to have the possibility of succeeding or achieving sth
senses.chn: 有可能成功；有机会获得

ex.en: 'Do you think we'll win?' 'I think we're in with a chance.'
ex.cn: “你认为我们会获胜吗？” “我觉得有可能。”

ex.en: He's in with a good chance of passing the exam.
ex.cn: 他大有可能考试合格。

senses.def: used especially in questions, to ask whether sth is true, possible, etc.
senses.chn: （尤用于问句，询问是否真实、可能等）或许，可能

ex.en: Are you in love with him, by any chance?
ex.cn: 或许你爱上他了？

senses.def: it is likely that…

ex.en: The chances are you won't have to pay.
ex.cn: 你可能不用付钱。

senses.def: people say chance would be a fine thing to show that they would like to do or have the thing that sb has mentioned, but that they do not think that it is very likely
to give sb/sth some opportunity to do sth

ex.en: That dog will give you a nasty bite, given half a chance.
ex.cn: 只要一有机会，那条狗就会狠咬你一口。

senses.def: there is no possibility

ex.en: 'Do you think he'll do it?' 'No chance.'
ex.cn: “你认为他会做这事吗？” “不可能。”

senses.def: because of the possibility of sth happening, although it is unlikely

ex.en: I didn't think you'd be at home but I just called by on the off chance.
ex.cn: 我想你不会在家，只是碰碰运气顺路来看一下。

senses.def: to have the possibility of succeeding or achieving sth
senses.chn: 有可能成功；有机会获得

ex.en: The driver didn't stand a chance of stopping in time.
ex.cn: 司机根本不可能及时刹车。

senses.def: to decide to do sth, knowing that it might be the wrong choice

ex.en: We took a chance on the weather and planned to have the party outside.
ex.cn: 我们怀着天气可能会好的侥幸心理筹划到户外聚会。

senses.def: to take a risk or to use the opportunities that you have and hope that things will happen in the way that you want

ex.en: He took his chances and jumped into the water.
ex.cn: 他冒险跳进水里。

senses.def: to have no chance at all
to have no chance at all

ex.en: He hasn't a dog's chance of passing the exam.
ex.cn: 他根本不可能通过这次考试。

senses.def: to be equally likely to do or not do sth
senses.chn: （做某事）有一半的机会；正反各半的可能性

ex.en: She has more than an even chance of winning tomorrow.
ex.cn: 她明天多半会赢。

senses.def: with the hope of using a particular situation in order to gain some advantage for yourself
used for saying that you do not believe sth is likely to happen

ex.en: 'They might let us in without tickets.' 'Fat chance of that!'
ex.cn: “他们也许会让我们免票入场。” “别痴心妄想了！”

senses.def: a small chance of being successful if a great effort is made
senses.chn: 要努力奋斗才有的一线成功机会

senses.def: to have no chance at all
a reasonable chance of success
senses.chn: 比较有成功希望的机会

senses.def: to risk sth, although you know the result may not be successful

ex.en: She was chancing her luck driving without a licence.
ex.cn: 她无照驾车，完全是在冒险。

ex.en: 'Take an umbrella.' 'No, I'll chance it (= take the risk that it may rain).'
ex.cn: “带上伞吧。” “不带了，我就冒冒险吧。”

ex.en: I stayed hidden; I couldn't chance coming out.
ex.cn: 我躲了起来，不能冒险出去。

senses.def: to happen or to do sth by chance

ex.en: If I do chance to find out where she is, I'll inform you immediately.
ex.cn: 要是我真的碰巧发现她的行踪，会立即通知你的。

ex.en: They chanced to be staying at the same hotel.
ex.cn: 他们碰巧住在同一家旅馆。

ex.en: It chanced (that) they were staying at the same hotel.
ex.cn: 碰巧他们住在同一家旅馆。

senses.def: to take a risk although you will probably fail
to find or meet sb/sth unexpectedly or by chance

ex.en: One day he chanced upon Emma's diary and began reading it.
ex.cn: 有一天他偶然发现了埃玛的日记，便开始读了起来。

senses.def: not planned

ex.en: a chance meeting/encounter
ex.cn: 邂逅

senses.def: the part of a church near the altar, where the priests and the choir(= singers) sit during services
the place where a chancellor has his or her office
senses.chn: 大臣（或大法官等）的官署

senses.def: the staff in the department of a chancellor
senses.chn: 大臣（或大法官等）官署的全体工作人员

senses.def: the head of government in Germany or Austria

ex.en: Chancellor Merkel
ex.cn: 默克尔总理

senses.def: the official head of a university in Britain. Chancellor is an honorary title.
the head of some American universities
used in the titles of some senior state officials in Britain
senses.chn: （用于英国某些高级政府官员的头衔）

ex.en: the Lord Chancellor (= a senior law official)
ex.cn: 大法官

senses.def: (in Britain) the government minister who is responsible for financial affairs
a person who is always looking for opportunities to gain an advantage, even when they do not deserve to do so
a division of the High Court in Britain
senses.chn: （英国）高等法院的大法官法庭

senses.def: an office where public records are kept
senses.chn: 公共档案馆；公共档案室

senses.def: a court in the US that decides legal cases based on the principle of equity
the offices where the official representative of a country works, in another country
senses.chn: 大使馆（或领事馆）办公处

chance would be a fine thing.lemma: chance would be a fine thing

senses.def: people say chance would be a fine thing to show that they would like to do or have the thing that sb has mentioned, but that they do not think that it is very likely
to take a risk although you will probably fail
involving risks and uncertainty
a large round frame with branches that hold lights or candles. Chandeliers are decorated with many small pieces of glass and hang from the ceiling.
a person or shop/store that sells equipment for ships
to become different

ex.en: Rick hasn't changed. He looks exactly the same as he did at school.
ex.cn: 里克一点儿没变，他和上学时一模一样。

ex.en: changing attitudes towards education
ex.cn: 不断变化的对教育的看法

ex.en: Her life changed completely when she won the lottery.
ex.cn: 买彩票中奖后她的生活完全变了。

senses.def: to make sb/sth different

ex.en: Fame hasn't really changed him.
ex.cn: 名声并没有使他有丝毫改变。

ex.en: Computers have changed the way people work.
ex.cn: 计算机已改变了人的工作方式。

senses.def: to pass or make sb/sth pass from one state or form into another

ex.en: Wait for the traffic lights to change.
ex.cn: 等待交通灯变换颜色。

ex.en: The lights changed from red to green.
ex.cn: 交通灯已由红变绿。

ex.en: Caterpillars change into butterflies.
ex.cn: 毛虫变成蝴蝶。

ex.en: With a wave of her magic wand, she changed the frog into a handsome prince.
ex.cn: 她魔杖一挥，把青蛙变成了英俊的王子。

senses.def: to stop having one state, position or direction and start having another

ex.en: Leaves change colour in autumn.
ex.cn: 树叶在秋天改变颜色。

ex.en: The wind has changed direction.
ex.cn: 风向已经变了。

ex.en: Our ship changed course.
ex.cn: 我们的船改变了航向。

senses.def: to replace one thing, person, service, etc. with sth new or different

ex.en: I want to change my doctor.
ex.cn: 我想另找一位医生看病。

ex.en: That back tyre needs changing.
ex.cn: 那个后轮胎需要更换。

ex.en: We change our car every two years.
ex.cn: 我们的车每两年更换一次。

ex.en: We changed the car for a bigger one.
ex.cn: 我们换了一辆较大的车。

ex.en: Marie changed her name when she got married.
ex.cn: 玛丽婚后改了姓。

ex.en: She changed her name to his.
ex.cn: 她改用了他的姓氏。

senses.def: to exchange positions, places, etc. with sb else, so that you have what they have, and they have what you have

ex.en: At half-time the teams change ends.
ex.cn: 球队在半场时交换场地。

ex.en: Can we change seats?
ex.cn: 咱们可以交换一下座位吗？

ex.en: Can I change seats with you?
ex.cn: 我可以和您换一下座位吗？

senses.def: to put on different or clean clothes

ex.en: I went into the bedroom to change.
ex.cn: 我走进卧室更衣。

ex.en: She changed into her swimsuit.
ex.cn: 她换上了游泳衣。

ex.en: You need to change out of those wet things.
ex.cn: 你该把那些湿衣服换掉。

ex.en: I didn't have time to change clothes before the party.
ex.cn: 我没时间在聚会前更换衣服。

ex.en: I didn't have time to get changed before the party (= to put different clothes on).
ex.cn: 我没时间在聚会前更换衣服。

senses.def: to put clean clothes or a clean nappy/ diaper on a baby

ex.en: She can't even change a nappy.
ex.cn: 她连换尿布都不会。

ex.en: The baby needs changing.
ex.cn: 该给婴儿换尿布了。

ex.en: There are baby changing facilities in all our stores.
ex.cn: 我们所有的商店都有供顾客给婴儿换尿布的地方。

senses.def: to put clean sheets, etc. on a bed

ex.en: to change the sheets
ex.cn: 换床单

ex.en: Could you help me change the bed?
ex.cn: 你帮我换一下床单好吗？

senses.def: to exchange money into the money of another country
senses.chn: 把（货币）兑换（成另一种货币）

ex.en: Where can I change my traveller's cheques?
ex.cn: 哪里可以兑换旅行支票？

ex.en: to change dollars into yen
ex.cn: 把美元兑换成日元

senses.def: to exchange money for the same amount in different coins or notes

ex.en: Can you change a £20 note?
ex.cn: 你能把一张 20 英镑的钞票换成零钱吗？

ex.en: to change a dollar bill for four quarters
ex.cn: 把一元美钞换为四个二十五分币

senses.def: to exchange sth that you have bought for sth else, especially because there is sth wrong with it; to give a customer a new item because there is sth wrong with the one they have bought

ex.en: This shirt I bought's too small—I'll have to change it for a bigger one.
ex.cn: 我买的这件衬衫太小，得换件大一点的。

ex.en: Of course we'll change it for a larger size, Madam.
ex.cn: 夫人，我们当然会给您掉换件大号的。

senses.def: to go from one bus, train, etc. to another in order to continue a journey

ex.en: Where do I have to change?
ex.cn: 我该在哪儿换车？

ex.en: Change at Reading (for London).
ex.cn: 在雷丁换车（去伦敦）。

ex.en: I stopped in Moscow only to change planes.
ex.cn: 我为了转机才在莫斯科停留。

senses.def: to pass to a different owner

ex.en: The house has changed hands several times.
ex.cn: 这房子已几易其主。

senses.def: to change to a different or new activity while you are in the middle of sth else; to change from supporting one person or thing to another
senses.chn: 中流换马；中途变卦；转而支持另外的人（或事）

senses.def: to change a decision or an opinion

ex.en: Nothing will make me change my mind.
ex.cn: 什么都不能让我改变主意。

senses.def: to express a different opinion or behave in a different way when your situation changes
senses.chn: 改变口风；转变态度；变卦

ex.en: Wait until it happens to him—he'll soon change his tune.
ex.cn: 等着瞧吧，到他遇上这事时，他很快就会改变看法了。

senses.def: to start to live or behave in a different way from before
senses.chn: 开始过另一种生活；换个活法

senses.def: to keep changing your mind or what you are doing
people cannot change their character, especially if they have a bad character
to be in sb else's situation

ex.en: I'm perfectly happy—I wouldn't change places with anyone.
ex.cn: 我幸福极了，谁也甭想跟我交换位置。

senses.def: to move things or people into different positions

ex.en: You've changed all the furniture around.
ex.cn: 你改变了所有家具的位置。

senses.def: to return to a previous situation, form, etc.
to take off your clothes and put on what you were wearing earlier

ex.en: She changed back into her work clothes.
ex.cn: 她又换上了工作服。

senses.def: to exchange an amount of money into the currency that it was in before

ex.en: You can change back unused dollars into pounds at the bank.
ex.cn: 你可以到银行把没有用掉的美元兑换回英镑。

senses.def: to start using a lower gear when you are driving a car, etc.
senses.chn: （开车等）换低一挡，换成低速挡，降挡

ex.en: Change down into second.
ex.cn: 把车降到第二挡。

senses.def: to change from one system or position to another

ex.en: The farm has changed over to organic methods.
ex.cn: 农场已改用有机耕作方法。

senses.def: to start using a higher gear when driving a car, etc.
senses.chn: （开车等）换高一挡，换成高速挡，加挡

ex.en: Change up into fifth.
ex.cn: 把车加到第五挡。

senses.def: the act or result of sth becoming different

ex.en: a change in the weather
ex.cn: 天气的变化

ex.en: important changes to the tax system
ex.cn: 税收制度的重大变革

ex.en: There was no change in the patient's condition overnight.
ex.cn: 病人整夜病情稳定。

ex.en: She is someone who hates change.
ex.cn: 她是十分讨厌变革的那种人。

ex.en: social/political/economic change
ex.cn: 社会／政治／经济变革

senses.def: the fact of a situation, a place or an experience being different from what is usual and therefore likely to be interesting, enjoyable, etc.
senses.chn: （会令人感兴趣或可喜的）变化，变更

ex.en: Finishing early was a welcome change.
ex.cn: 能早日结束是个可喜的变化。

ex.en: Let's stay in tonight for a change.
ex.cn: 咱们今晚换换口味，就待在家里吧。

ex.en: Can you just listen for a change?
ex.cn: 你就当一回听众，好吗？

ex.en: It makes a change to read some good news for once.
ex.cn: 破例读到点好消息，真让人高兴。

senses.def: the process of replacing sth with sth new or different; a thing that is used to replace sth

ex.en: a change of address
ex.cn: 地址的变更

ex.en: a change of government
ex.cn: 政府的更迭

ex.en: a change from agriculture to industry
ex.cn: 从农业向工业转换

ex.en: There will be a crew change when we land at Dubai.
ex.cn: 我们在迪拜着陆后将更换机组人员。

ex.en: Let's get away for the weekend. A change of scene (= time in a different place) will do you good.
ex.cn: 咱们出去度周末吧，换换环境会对你有好处的。

senses.def: an extra set of clothes, etc.

ex.en: She packed a change of clothes for the weekend.
ex.cn: 她已收拾好度周末的一套换洗衣物。

ex.en: I keep a change of shoes in the car.
ex.cn: 我在车里放有一双供替换的鞋。

senses.def: the money that you get back when you have paid for sth giving more money than the amount it costs

ex.en: Don't forget your change!
ex.cn: 别忘了找给你的零钱！

ex.en: That's 40p change.
ex.cn: 这是找给您的 40 便士。

ex.en: The ticket machine gives change.
ex.cn: 自动售票机可以找零。

senses.def: coins rather than paper money

ex.en: Do you have any change for the parking meter?
ex.cn: 你有投进停车计时器的硬币吗？

ex.en: a dollar in change (= coins that together are worth one dollar)
ex.cn: 总值一美元钱的硬币

ex.en: I didn't have any small change (= coins of low value) to leave as a tip.
ex.cn: 我没有零钱留下来付小费。

ex.en: He puts his loose change in a money box for the children.
ex.cn: 他把身上的零钱放进了给孩子的钱箱。

ex.en: Could you give me change for a ten pound note (= coins or notes that are worth this amount)?
ex.cn: 你能换给我十英镑的零钱吗？

ex.en: I counted the money carefully.
ex.cn: 我仔细点过这笔钱。

senses.def: an occasion when you go from one bus, train or plane to another during a journey

ex.en: The journey involved three changes.
ex.cn: 这趟旅行中转乘过三次。

senses.def: a person, thing, situation, etc. that is better/worse than the previous or present one
if you have a change of heart, your attitude towards sth changes, usually making you feel more friendly, helpful, etc.
senses.chn: 改变态度，改变看法（通常指变得更友好、有益等）

senses.def: an act of changing what you think about a situation, etc.
to get no help or information from sb
senses.chn: （从某人处）得不到帮助，打听不到消息

senses.def: to make changes to sth in order to have greater variety

ex.en: Ring the changes with a new colour.
ex.cn: 用一种新的颜色来改变一下。

senses.def: an event or a series of events that has started to happen and will cause important changes or results

ex.en: A wind of change was blowing through the banking world.
ex.cn: 银行界刮起了改革之风。

senses.def: likely to change; often changing
senses.chn: 可能变化的；易变的；常变的

ex.en: The weather is very changeable at this time of year.
ex.cn: 年年在这个时候天气都变化无常。

senses.def: very different from what they were before
senses.chn: 与以前截然不同的；变化大的；已变的

ex.en: She's a changed woman since she got that job.
ex.cn: 她自从得到了那份工作，变得判若两人。

ex.en: This will not be possible in the changed economic climate.
ex.cn: 这在经济气候已经改变的条件下是不可能的。

senses.def: to start using a lower gear when you are driving a car, etc.

ex.cn: 把车降到第二挡。

senses.def: to pass to a different owner

ex.cn: 这房子已几易其主。

senses.def: to change to a different or new activity while you are in the middle of sth else; to change from supporting one person or thing to another
senses.chn: 中流换马；中途变卦；转而支持另外的人（或事）

senses.def: never changing

senses.chn: （尤指童话中被仙女）偷换后留下的孩童

senses.def: a change from one system, or method of working to another
senses.chn: （系统或工作方法的）改变，转变，更换

ex.en: the changeover from a manual to a computerized system
ex.cn: 由手工操作向计算机化系统的转换

ex.en: a changeover period
ex.cn: 转变时期

senses.def: a small bag made of leather, plastic, etc. for carrying coins
a piece of equipment that holds several discs, etc. and is able to switch between them
senses.chn: （光盘等的）换片装置；光盘转换器；光碟更换器

ex.en: The car comes with white leather seats and a 6-CD changer.
ex.cn: 这辆车配置了白色皮座椅和一台 6 碟光盘换片装置。

senses.def: a person or thing that changes sth, usually in order to improve it

ex.en: The whole experience was a life changer for me.
ex.cn: 这整个经历改变了我的一生。

senses.def: to start using a higher gear when driving a car, etc.
senses.chn: （开车等）换高一挡，换成高速挡，加挡

ex.cn: 把车加到第五挡。

senses.def: to express a different opinion or behave in a different way when your situation changes
senses.chn: 改变口风；转变态度；变卦

ex.en: Wait until it happens to him—he'll soon change his tune.
ex.cn: 等着瞧吧，到他遇上这事时，他很快就会改变看法了。

senses.def: to start to live or behave in a different way from before
senses.chn: 开始过另一种生活；换个活法

senses.def: a room for changing clothes in, especially before playing sports
senses.chn: （尤指做运动前使用的）更衣室

senses.def: a television station

ex.en: What's on Channel 4 tonight?
ex.cn: 电视四台今晚有什么节目？

ex.en: a movie/sports channel
ex.cn: 电影台；体育台

ex.en: to change/switch channels
ex.cn: 换频道

senses.def: a band of radio waves used for broadcasting television or radio programmes

ex.en: terrestrial/satellite channels
ex.cn: 地面／卫星频道

senses.def: a method or system that people use to get information, to communicate, or to send sth somewhere

ex.en: Complaints must be made through the proper channels.
ex.cn: 投诉必须通过正当途径进行。

ex.en: The newsletter is a useful channel of communication between teacher and students.
ex.cn: 简讯是有助于师生沟通的渠道。

ex.en: The company has worldwide distribution channels.
ex.cn: 这家公司拥有遍布全世界的销售网络。

senses.def: a way of expressing ideas and feelings

ex.en: The campaign provided a channel for protest against the war.
ex.cn: 这场运动是反对战争的一种方式。

ex.en: Music is a great channel for releasing your emotions.
ex.cn: 音乐是宣泄情感的好方法。

senses.def: a passage that water can flow along, especially in the ground, on the bottom of a river, etc.

ex.en: drainage channels in the rice fields
ex.cn: 稻田的排水沟

senses.def: a deep passage of water in a river or near the coast that can be used as route for ships
a passage of water that connects two areas of water, especially two seas

ex.cn: 布里斯托尔海峡

senses.def: the area of sea between England and France, also known as the English Channel

ex.cn: 英吉利海峡隧道

ex.en: cross-Channel ferries
ex.cn: 横渡英吉利海峡的渡船

ex.cn: 来自英吉利海峡对岸（指法国）的消息

senses.def: to direct money, feelings, ideas, etc. towards a particular thing or purpose

ex.en: He channels his aggression into sport.
ex.cn: 他把他的好斗劲头倾注于体育比赛之中。

senses.def: to send money, help, etc. using a particular route
senses.chn: （利用某途径）输送资金，提供帮助

ex.cn: 这个项目的资金将由地方政府提供。

senses.def: to carry or send water, light, etc. through a passage

ex.cn: 传感器沿光导纤维输送光信号。

ex.cn: 他相信自己能充当两百年前一位祖先的灵媒。

ex.cn: 他演唱时犹如纳京高附体。

ex.cn: 人群爆发出一阵阵 “下台！下台！” 的呼喊声。

ex.cn: 此起彼伏的足球助威声

senses.def: a religious song or prayer or a way of singing, using only a few notes that are repeated many times

ex.cn: 一群抗议者等候在外面，举着标语牌不停地喊着口号。

ex.cn: 人群不断地呼唤着自己英雄的名字。

ex.cn: 经济／政治／国内的混乱

ex.cn: 大雪导致道路上交通一片混乱。

ex.cn: 在上下班高峰时间，城市的交通混乱不堪。

ex.en: a Mormon chapel
ex.cn: 摩门教教堂

ex.cn: 她总是在星期天去教堂做礼拜。

ex.cn: 我无法提供准确细节，但那是我们所处法律地位的大致情况。

senses.def: the exact details of sth, especially the exact place where particular information may be found
senses.chn: 准确细节；（尤指信息的）确切出处

ex.en: I can't give chapter and verse, but that's the rough outline of our legal position.
ex.cn: 我无法提供准确细节，但那是我们所处法律地位的大致情况。

senses.chn: 座堂会议厅；宗教团体会议厅

senses.def: to become black by burning; to make sth black by burning it

ex.en: She burned all his letters.
ex.cn: 她把他的信全部付之一炬。

ex.en: The house burned down in 1995.
ex.cn: 那所房子在 1995 年烧毁了。

ex.en: The bodies had been charred beyond recognition.
ex.cn: 这些尸体已烧焦，无法辨认。

ex.en: I scorched my dress when I was ironing it.
ex.cn: 我把自己的连衣裙熨焦了。

ex.en: He singed his hair as he tried to light his cigarette.
ex.cn: 他点烟时把头发给燎了。

tea

senses.chn: （人、集体的）品质，性格；（地方的）特点，特性

ex.en: to have a strong/weak character
ex.cn: 个性强／不强

ex.en: character traits/defects
ex.cn: 性格特点／弱点

ex.en: The book gives a fascinating insight into Mrs Obama's character.
ex.cn: 这部书对奥巴马夫人的性格作了生动的剖析。

ex.en: Generosity is part of the American character.
ex.cn: 慷慨是美国人性格的一部分。

ex.en: The character of the neighbourhood hasn't changed at all.
ex.cn: 这片街区的风貌依旧。

senses.chn: （事物、事件或地方的）特点，特征，特色

ex.en: the delicate character of the light in the evening
ex.cn: 夜间灯火所具有的那种柔和的特点

ex.en: buildings that are very simple in character
ex.cn: 造型很简洁的建筑物

senses.def: strong personal qualities such as the ability to deal with difficult or dangerous situations

ex.en: Everyone admires her strength of character and determination.
ex.cn: 每一个人都钦佩她坚强的性格和决心。

ex.en: He showed great character returning to the sport after his accident.
ex.cn: 他在出了事故后仍能重返体坛表现出他顽强的毅力。

ex.en: Adventure camps are considered to be character-building (= meant to improve sb's strong qualities).
ex.cn: 冒险野营生活被认为能磨炼意志。

senses.def: the interesting or unusual quality that a place or a person has
senses.chn: （地方或人的）与众不同之处，特色

ex.en: The modern hotels here have no real character.
ex.cn: 此处的现代化旅馆毫无特色可言。

ex.en: a face with a lot of character
ex.cn: 与众不同的面孔

senses.def: a person, particularly an unpleasant or strange one

ex.en: There were some really strange characters hanging around the bar.
ex.cn: 有些不三不四的人在酒吧周围游荡。

senses.def: an interesting or unusual person

ex.en: She's a character!
ex.cn: 她真是个有趣的人！

senses.def: the opinion that people have of you, particularly of whether you can be trusted or relied on

ex.en: She was a victim of character assassination (= an unfair attack on the good opinion people had of her).
ex.cn: 她是诽谤行为的受害者。

ex.en: a slur/attack on his character
ex.cn: 对他名誉的诋毁／攻击

ex.en: My teacher agreed to be a character witness for me in court.
ex.cn: 我的老师同意出庭做我的品德信誉见证人。

ex.en: a character reference (= a letter that a person who knows you well writes to an employer to tell them about your good qualities)
ex.cn: 品德证明书

senses.def: a person or an animal in a book, play or film/movie
senses.chn: （书籍、戏剧或电影中的）人物，角色

ex.en: a major/minor character in the book
ex.cn: 书中的主要／次要人物

ex.en: cartoon characters
ex.cn: 动画片中的角色

senses.def: a letter, sign, mark or symbol used in writing, in printing or on computers
senses.chn: （书写、印刷或计算机上的）文字，字母，符号

ex.en: Chinese characters
ex.cn: 汉字

ex.en: a line 30 characters long
ex.cn: 长达 30 字符的一行

ex.en: The URL contained non-standard characters like question marks.
ex.cn: URL 地址包含问号等非标准字符。

ex.cn: 她昨晚的举止与她的性格截然不符。

ex.en: The new wing of the museum was not really in character with the rest of the building.
ex.cn: 博物馆新建的配楼与大楼其他部分的风格有些不一样。

senses.def: an actor who always takes the parts of interesting or unusual people
a combination of numbers that is used to represent a particular letter, number or symbol

senses.def: very interesting and unusual
very typical of sth or of sb's character

ex.cn: 她说话带着特有的热情。

senses.def: a typical feature or quality that sth/sb has

ex.cn: 需要交流是人类社会最重要的一个特征。

ex.en: The two groups of children have quite different characteristics.
ex.cn: 这两组儿童具有截然不同的特点。

ex.en: Personal characteristics, such as age and sex are taken into account.
ex.cn: 个人的特征，如年龄和性别等，都要考虑进去。

ex.en: genetic characteristics
ex.cn: 遗传特征

senses.def: the way that a writer makes characters in a book or play seem real
senses.chn: （对书或戏剧中人物的）刻画，描绘，塑造

senses.def: the way in which sb/sth is described or defined

ex.en: This is an unfair characterization of the Prime Minister.
ex.cn: 这是对首相不公正的描述。

senses.def: to be typical of a person, place or thing

ex.en: the rolling hills that characterize this part of England
ex.cn: 成为英格兰这一地区特征的绵延起伏的丘陵地

senses.def: to give sb/sth its typical or most noticeable qualities or features
senses.chn: 使…具有特点（或最引人注目的特征）

ex.en: The city is characterized by tall modern buildings in steel and glass.
ex.cn: 这座城市的特点是钢铁和玻璃建造的现代化高楼大厦林立。

senses.def: to describe or show the qualities of sb/sth in a particular way
senses.chn: 描述，刻画，表现（…的特征、特点）

ex.en: activities that are characterized as 'male' or 'female' work
ex.cn: 被描述为 “男性” 或 “女性” 工作的各种活动

senses.def: having no interesting qualities
senses.chn: 无特征的；无个性的；平凡的

senses.def: the ability of a computer to read numbers or letters that are printed or written by hand
senses.chn: 字符识别（计算机读取印刷或手写数字或字母的能力）

ex.cn: 他们的整个婚姻都是在做戏，他们从未相爱过。

ex.cn: 咱们来玩打哑谜猜字游戏吧。
