senses.chn: 环绕…航行；（尤指）环绕地球航行

senses.def: to limit sb/sth's freedom, rights, power, etc.
senses.chn: 限制，约束（自由、权利、权力等）

ex.en: The power of the monarchy was circumscribed by the new law.
ex.cn: 君主统治的权力受到了新法律的制约。

senses.def: to draw a circle around another shape
thinking very carefully about sth before doing it, because there may be risks involved
senses.chn: 小心谨慎的；考虑周密的；慎重的

senses.def: the conditions and facts that are connected with and affect a situation, an event or an action

ex.en: The company reserves the right to cancel this agreement in certain circumstances.
ex.cn: 本公司保留在一定条件下取消这项协议的权利。

ex.en: changing social and political circumstances
ex.cn: 正在变化的社会和政治环境

ex.en: I know I can trust her in any circumstance.
ex.cn: 我知道我在任何情况下都能信任她。

ex.en: Police said there were no suspicious circumstances surrounding the boy's death.
ex.cn: 警方说关于男孩死亡一事没有发现可疑的情况。

ex.en: The ship sank in mysterious circumstances.
ex.cn: 那艘船神秘地沉没了。

ex.en: She never discovered the true circumstances of her birth.
ex.cn: 她从未弄清她身世的真相。

senses.def: the conditions of a person's life, especially the money they have
senses.chn: 境况；境遇；（尤指）经济状况

ex.en: Grants are awarded according to your financial circumstances.
ex.cn: 补助金根据经济状况发给。

ex.en: family/domestic/personal circumstances
ex.cn: 家庭／个人经济状况

senses.def: situations and events that affect and influence your life and that are not in your control

ex.en: a victim of circumstance (= a person who has suffered because of a situation that they cannot control)
ex.cn: 客观环境的牺牲品

ex.en: He had to leave the country through force of circumstance (= events made it necessary).
ex.cn: 为势所迫，他不得不离开这个国家。

senses.def: used before or after a statement to show that you have thought about the conditions that affect a situation before making a decision or a statement
senses.chn: 在这种情况下；既然如此

ex.en: Under the circumstances, it seemed better not to tell him about the accident.
ex.cn: 在这种情况下，不告诉他有关这次事故的情况似乎更好。

ex.en: She did the job very well in the circumstances.
ex.cn: 她在那种情况下仍把工作干得很出色。

senses.def: used to emphasize that sth should never happen or be allowed

ex.en: Under no circumstances should you lend Paul any money.
ex.cn: 你无论如何都不能借钱给保罗。

ex.en: Don't open the door, in any circumstances.
ex.cn: 在任何情况下都不要开门。

senses.def: formal and impressive ceremony
the state of being poorer than you were before. People say 'living in reduced circumstances' to avoid saying 'poor'.
senses.chn: （委婉说法，与 poor 同义）境况不济

senses.def: containing information and details that strongly suggest that sth is true but do not prove it
senses.chn: 按情况推测的；视情况而定的；间接的

ex.en: circumstantial evidence
ex.cn: 情况证据

ex.en: The case against him was largely circumstantial.
ex.cn: 对他不利的案情大多为间接推测的。

senses.def: connected with particular circumstances
senses.chn: 与特定条件（或环境、情况）有关的

ex.en: Their problems were circumstantial rather than personal.
ex.cn: 他们的困难是环境而非个人所致。

senses.def: to find a way of avoiding a difficulty or a rule

ex.en: They found a way of circumventing the law.
ex.cn: 他们找到了规避法律的途径。

senses.def: to go or travel around sth that is blocking your way
a group of entertainers, sometimes with trained animals, who perform skilful or amusing acts in a show that travels around to different places
a show performed by circus entertainers, usually in a large tent called the big top

ex.en: We took the children to the circus.
ex.cn: 我们带孩子去看了马戏表演。

senses.def: a group of people or an event that attracts a lot of attention
senses.chn: 引人注意的人（或事）；热闹场面

ex.en: A media circus surrounded the royal couple wherever they went.
ex.cn: 无论王室夫妇走到何处，他们的身后都会跟着一大群媒体记者。

ex.en: the American electoral circus
ex.cn: 美国大选的热闹场面

senses.def: (used in some place names) a round open area in a town where several streets meet
senses.chn: （用于一些地名）圆形广场，环形交叉路口

ex.en: Piccadilly Circus
ex.cn: 皮卡迪利广场

senses.def: a place like a big round outdoor theatre for public games, races, etc.
a serious disease of the liver, caused especially by drinking too much alcohol
a broken layer of small clouds
a thin layer of fairly flat clouds very high up in the sky
a type of light cloud that forms high in the sky
Commonwealth of Independent States (a group of independent countries that were part of the Soviet Union until 1991)
senses.chn: 独立国家联合体，独联体（由 1991 年之前原属苏联的主权国家组成）

senses.def: a container in which water is stored in a building, especially one in the roof or connected to a toilet
senses.chn: （尤指屋顶上的）蓄水箱，贮水箱；（抽水马桶的）水箱

senses.def: (in the past) a castle on high ground in or near a city where people could go when the city was being attacked

ex.en: citadels of private economic power
ex.cn: 私人经济力量的堡垒

senses.def: words or lines taken from a book or a speech
an official statement about sth special that sb has done, especially about acts of courage in a war
senses.chn: 表彰；表扬；（尤指对战争中英勇表现的）嘉奖令

ex.en: a citation for bravery
ex.cn: 因勇敢而受到的嘉奖

senses.def: an act of citing or being cited

ex.en: Space does not permit the citation of the examples.
ex.cn: 篇幅有限，示例从略。

senses.def: to mention sth as a reason or an example, or in order to support what you are saying
senses.chn: 提及（原因）；举出（示例）；列举

ex.en: He cited his heavy workload as the reason for his breakdown.
ex.cn: 他提到巨大的工作负荷是导致他精神崩溃的原因。

ex.en: Nobody mentioned anything to me about it.
ex.cn: 没人跟我提过这事。

ex.en: I promised not to refer to the matter again.
ex.cn: 我答应过再不提这事了。

ex.en: Witnesses spoke of a great ball of flame.
ex.cn: 目击者都谈到有个大火球。

ex.en: He cited his heavy workload as the reason for his breakdown.
ex.cn: 他提到繁重的工作负荷是导致他累垮的原因。

ex.en: Can you quote me an instance of when this happened?
ex.cn: 你能否给我举例说明一下发生这事的情况？

senses.def: to speak or write the exact words from a book, an author, etc.
to order sb to appear in court; to name sb officially in a legal case

ex.en: She was cited in the divorce proceedings.
ex.cn: 她在离婚诉讼中被传唤。

senses.def: to mention sb officially or publicly because they deserve special praise

ex.en: He was cited for bravery.
ex.cn: 他因表现勇敢而得到嘉奖。

senses.def: characteristic of a city
senses.chn: 有城市特征的；城市气的

ex.en: his citified surroundings
ex.cn: 他那充满市井气息的环境

senses.def: a person who has the legal right to belong to a particular country

ex.en: She's Italian by birth but is now an Australian citizen.
ex.cn: 她生于意大利，但现在是澳大利亚公民。

ex.en: British citizens living in other parts of the European Union
ex.cn: 居住在欧盟其他地区的英国公民

senses.def: a person who lives in a particular place

ex.en: the citizens of Budapest
ex.cn: 布达佩斯市民

ex.en: When you're old, people treat you like a second-class citizen.
ex.cn: 当你年迈时，人们会把你当成二等公民对待。

senses.def: reports and pictures of events recorded by ordinary people and shown on the Internet

ex.en: citizen journalism websites
ex.cn: 公民新闻网站

senses.def: all the citizens of a particular town, country, etc.
an arrest made by a member of the public, not by the police
the legal right to belong to a particular country

ex.en: French citizenship
ex.cn: 法国国籍

ex.en: You can apply for citizenship after five years' residency.
ex.cn: 居住满五年可申请公民身份。

senses.def: the state of being a citizen and accepting the responsibilities of it

ex.en: an education that prepares young people for citizenship
ex.cn: 培养年轻人履行公民义务的教育

senses.def: relating to fruit such as lemons, oranges and limes
senses.chn: 柠檬的；酸橙的；柑橘类水果的

ex.en: a citric flavour
ex.cn: 柠檬味

senses.def: a weak acid found in the juice of lemons and other sour fruits
a yellow fruit like a large lemon
a type of grass from which an oil used in perfumes and soap is obtained
senses.chn: 香茅（香茅油用于香水和肥皂）

senses.def: fruit belonging to the group of fruit that includes oranges, lemons, limes and grapefruit

ex.en: citrus fruit/trees/growers
ex.cn: 柑橘果实／果树／种植者

ex.en: fabric in bright citrus shades (= orange, yellow or green)
ex.cn: 色调鲜艳的橙黄色布料

senses.def: a large and important town

ex.en: the city centre
ex.cn: 市中心

ex.en: one of the world's most beautiful cities
ex.cn: 世界上最优美的城市之一

ex.en: a major city
ex.cn: 大城市

ex.en: the country's capital city
ex.cn: 这个国家的首都

ex.en: Mexico City
ex.cn: 墨西哥城

senses.def: a town that has been given special rights by a king or queen, usually one that has a cathedral
senses.chn: （由国王或女王授予特权，通常有大教堂的）特许市

ex.en: the city of York
ex.cn: 约克特许市

senses.def: a town that has been given special rights by the state government
all the people who live in a city

ex.en: The city turned out to welcome the victorious team home.
ex.cn: 全市居民倾城而出欢迎凯旋的队伍。

senses.def: Britain's financial and business centre, in the oldest part of London
senses.chn: 伦敦商业区，伦敦城（伦敦最古老的金融商务中心）

ex.en: a City stockbroker
ex.cn: 伦敦商业区的证券经纪人

ex.en: What is the City's reaction to the cut in interest rates?
ex.cn: 伦敦金融界对削减利率的反应如何？

senses.def: used after other nouns to say that a place is full of a particular thing
senses.chn: （用于其他名词之后）充满…的地方

ex.en: It's not exactly fun city here is it?
ex.cn: 这里并不是好玩的地方，对吧？

senses.def: (in Britain) an honour that is given to sb by a city as a reward for work they have done
the department of a newspaper that deals with financial news
the department of a newspaper that deals with local news
a journalist who is responsible for financial news in a newspaper or magazine
a journalist who is responsible for local news in a newspaper or magazine
a person with experience of governing a city
senses.chn: 城市元老（有城市管理经验者）

senses.def: a business person, especially a man who works in the financial area of London
senses.chn: （尤指在伦敦金融区工作的）商人

senses.def: the local government of a city and the offices it uses
the appearance of a city or urban area, especially in a picture; a picture of a city
senses.chn: （尤指图画中的）城市景象，城市风光；城市风光画（或照片）

senses.def: a person who behaves in a way that is typical of people who live in big cities
senses.chn: 油头滑脑的城里人；城里老油子；城里滑头

senses.def: (especially in the past) an independent state consisting of a city and the area around it (for example, Athens in ancient times)
senses.chn: （尤指旧时的）城邦（如古代雅典）

senses.def: a wild animal like a cat, that lives in central Africa and Asia
senses.chn: 灵猫，麝猫（分布于中非和亚洲）

senses.def: a substance with a strong smell, obtained from a civet, and used in making perfume
senses.chn: 麝猫香，灵猫香（用于制作香水）

senses.def: officially connected with a town or city

ex.en: civic buildings/leaders
ex.cn: 市政建筑物／领导人

senses.def: connected with the people who live in a town or city

ex.en: a sense of civic pride (= pride that people feel for their town or city)
ex.cn: 作为某市市民的自豪感

ex.en: civic duties/responsibilities
ex.cn: 市民的义务／职责

senses.def: the area where the public buildings are, in a town
a large building where public entertainments and meetings are held

ex.en: Atlanta Civic Center
ex.cn: 亚特兰大市政大厦

senses.def: a holiday that is taken on the first Monday in August in all of Canada apart from Quebec, Alberta and Prince Edward Island
senses.chn: 市政日（八月的第一个星期一，除魁北克、艾伯塔和爱德华王子岛省之外加拿大各地的假日）

senses.def: the school subject which studies the way government works and deals with the rights and duties that you have as a citizen and a member of a particular society
connected with the people who live in a country

ex.en: civil unrest (= that is caused by groups of people within a country)
ex.cn: 民众的骚乱

senses.def: connected with the state rather than with religion or with the armed forces
senses.chn: 国家的，政府的（非宗教或军事的）

ex.en: a civil marriage ceremony
ex.cn: 非宗教仪式的结婚典礼

senses.def: involving personal legal matters and not criminal law

ex.en: a civil court
ex.cn: 民事法庭

senses.def: polite in a formal way but possibly not friendly
the organization and training of ordinary people to protect themselves from attack during a war or, in the US, from natural disasters such as hurricanes
refusal by a large group of people to obey particular laws or pay taxes, usually as a form of peaceful political protest
senses.chn: 非暴力反抗；温和抵抗；不合作主义

senses.def: the design, building and repair of roads, bridges, canals, etc.; the study of this as a subject
a person who is not a member of the armed forces or the police
polite behaviour
senses.chn: 彬彬有礼的行为；礼貌；客气

ex.en: Staff members are trained to treat customers with civility at all times.
ex.cn: 员工经过培训，要做到任何时候都以礼待客。

senses.def: remarks that are said only in order to be polite
a state of human society that is very developed and organized

ex.en: the technology of modern civilization
ex.cn: 现代文明的技术

ex.en: The Victorians regarded the railways as bringing progress and civilization.
ex.cn: 维多利亚时代的人认为铁路带来了进步和文明。

senses.def: a society, its culture and its way of life during a particular period of time or in a particular part of the world
senses.chn: （特定时期或地区的）社会文明

ex.en: the civilizations of ancient Greece and Rome
ex.cn: 古希腊和古罗马的社会文明

ex.en: diseases that are common in Western civilization
ex.cn: 西方文明社会的常见病

senses.def: all the people in the world and the societies they live in, considered as a whole

ex.en: Environmental damage threatens the whole of civilization.
ex.cn: 环境的破坏威胁着整个文明世界。

senses.def: a place that offers you the comfortable way of life of a modern society

ex.en: It's good to be back in civilization after two weeks in a tent!
ex.cn: 在帐篷里住了两个星期后又回到人类文明的生活可真好呀！

senses.def: to educate and improve a person or a society; to make sb's behaviour or manners better
senses.chn: 教化；开化；使文明；使有教养

ex.en: The girls in a class tend to have a civilizing influence on the boys.
ex.cn: 班上的女生往往能让男生文雅起来。

senses.def: well organized socially with a very developed culture and way of life

ex.en: the civilized world
ex.cn: 文明世界

ex.en: rising crime in our so-called civilized societies
ex.cn: 在我们所谓文明社会中日益增多的犯罪行为

ex.en: civilized peoples
ex.cn: 文明的民族

senses.def: having laws and customs that are fair and morally acceptable
senses.chn: 有法制伦理的；有道德的

ex.en: No civilized country should allow such terrible injustices.
ex.cn: 凡有法制伦理的国家都不该允许这种可怕的不公正行为。

senses.def: having or showing polite and reasonable behaviour
senses.chn: 有礼貌的；有教养的；举止得体的

ex.en: We couldn't even have a civilized conversation any more.
ex.cn: 我们之间甚至连礼貌的寒暄都没有了。

senses.def: typical of a comfortable and pleasant way of life

ex.en: Breakfast on the terrace—how civilized!
ex.cn: 在阳台上用早餐，真是惬意无比！

senses.def: law that deals with the rights of private citizens rather than with crime
the right of people to be free to say or do what they want while respecting others and staying within the law
a marriage with no religious ceremony
senses.chn: 公证结婚，世俗结婚（不采用宗教仪式）

senses.def: (in some countries) a legal relationship between two people of the same sex, with the same legal status as marriage
senses.chn: （某些国家）合法伴侣关系（同性伴侣享有与婚姻同等的法律地位）

senses.def: the rights that every person in a society has, for example to be treated equally, to be able to vote, work, etc. whatever their sex, race or religion

ex.en: the civil rights leader Martin Luther King
ex.cn: 民权领袖马丁 · 路德 · 金

senses.def: a person who works in the civil service
a war between groups of people in the same country

ex.en: the Spanish Civil War
ex.cn: 西班牙内战

ex.en: 30 years of bitter civil war
ex.cn: 30 年惨烈的内战

senses.def: the war fought in the US between the northern and the southern states in the years 1861 to 1865
senses.chn: 美国内战，美国南北战争（1861–1865 年）

senses.def: (used by people in the armed forces) ordinary clothes, not military uniform
ordinary life outside the armed forces
senses.chn: （非军队的）平民生活，老百姓生活

senses.def: Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease
senses.chn: 克罗伊茨费尔特–雅各布病；克–雅脑病

senses.def: centilitre

ex.en: 75cl
ex.cn: 75 厘升

senses.def: if two hard objects clack, they make a short loud sound when they hit each other
senses.chn: 发出啪嗒声；噼啪作响；使咔哒地响

ex.en: Her heels clacked on the marble floor.
ex.cn: 她的鞋后跟在大理石地面上发出咔哒咔哒的响声。

senses.def: wearing a particular type of clothing

ex.en: She was clad in blue velvet.
ex.cn: 她身着蓝色的天鹅绒服装。

ex.en: warmly/scantily clad
ex.cn: 衣着暖和／暴露

ex.en: leather-clad motorcyclists
ex.cn: 穿皮外套的摩托车手

senses.def: covered in a particular thing

ex.en: snow-clad hills
ex.cn: 白雪覆盖的山峦

senses.def: a covering of a hard material, used as protection
to say that sth is true although it has not been proved and other people may not believe it

ex.en: He claims (that) he was not given a fair hearing.
ex.cn: 他声称他未得到公正的申诉机会。

ex.en: I don't claim to be an expert.
ex.cn: 我不敢自称为专家。

ex.en: Scientists are claiming a major breakthrough in the fight against cancer.
ex.cn: 科学家宣称治疗癌症已有重大的突破。

ex.en: It was claimed that some doctors were working 80 hours a week.
ex.cn: 据说有些医生每周工作 80 小时。

ex.en: Some critics argue that Picasso remained a great master all his life.
ex.cn: 一些评论家认为毕加索毕生都是一位大师。

ex.en: Others maintain that there is a significant deterioration in quality in his post-war work.
ex.cn: 其他人坚称他战后的作品质量明显下降。

senses.def: to demand or ask for sth because you believe it is your legal right to own or to have it

ex.en: A lot of lost property is never claimed.
ex.cn: 许多失物从未被认领。

ex.en: He claimed political asylum.
ex.cn: 他要求政治避难。

senses.def: to ask for money from the government or a company because you have a right to it

ex.en: He's not entitled to claim unemployment benefit.
ex.cn: 他无权要求领取失业救济金。

ex.en: She claimed damages from the company for the injury she had suffered.
ex.cn: 她因受伤向公司要求获得损害赔偿金。

ex.en: You could have claimed the cost of the hotel room from your insurance.
ex.cn: 你本可以从你的保险中索取旅馆住房费。

ex.en: You can claim on your insurance for that coat you left on the train.
ex.cn: 你可按你的保险索赔你遗忘在火车上的大衣。

senses.def: to get or take sb's attention

ex.en: A most unwelcome event claimed his attention.
ex.cn: 一件非常讨厌的事情需要他去考虑。

senses.def: to gain, win or achieve sth

ex.en: She has finally claimed a place on the team.
ex.cn: 她终于成了那支队的队员。

senses.def: to cause sb's death

ex.en: The car crash claimed three lives.
ex.cn: 那次撞车事故导致三人死亡。

senses.def: to ask or demand to have sth returned because you have a right to it

ex.en: You can claim back the tax on your purchases.
ex.cn: 你可以要求退回购物时缴纳的税款。

senses.def: a statement that sth is true although it has not been proved and other people may not agree with or believe it

ex.en: The singer has denied the magazine's claim that she is leaving the band.
ex.cn: 这名歌手已否认那家杂志有关她要离开乐队的说法。

senses.def: a right that sb believes they have to sth, especially property, land, etc.
senses.chn: （尤指对财产、土地等要求拥有的）所有权

ex.en: They had no claim on the land.
ex.cn: 他们无权索要那块土地。

ex.en: She has more claim to the book's success than anybody (= she deserves to be praised for it).
ex.cn: 她为这本书的成功立了头功。

senses.def: a request for a sum of money that you believe you have a right to, especially from a company, the government, etc.
senses.chn: （尤指向公司、政府等）索款，索赔

ex.en: You can make a claim on your insurance policy.
ex.cn: 你可按保险单索赔。

ex.en: to put in a claim for an allowance
ex.cn: 提出领取津贴的要求

ex.en: a claim for £2 000
ex.cn: 要求 2 000 英镑的索赔

ex.en: Make sure your claims for expenses are submitted by the end of the month.
ex.cn: 你的费用一定要在月底以前办理报销。

ex.en: a three per cent pay claim
ex.cn: 提高工资 3% 的要求

senses.def: a type of lawsuit that is started by a group of people who have the same problem

ex.cn: 她显现出了抑郁症的典型症状。

ex.cn: 我犯了一个常见错误，在乐曲演奏暂停的间歇鼓起掌来。

senses.def: elegant, but simple and traditional in style or design; not affected by changes in fashion
senses.chn: （风格或设计）典雅的，古朴的；传统的

ex.cn: 一套典雅的灰色服装

ex.en: classic design
ex.cn: 古朴典雅的设计

ex.en: classic cars (= cars which are no longer made, but which are still popular)
ex.cn: 古典雅致的老式车

ex.en: a classic movie/work

ex.cn: 典型的例子／错误

ex.cn: 典雅的设计

ex.cn: 她不来帮忙？哦，那不足为奇！

senses.chn: （书、电影或歌曲的）经典作品，名著，杰作

ex.cn: 英语经典作品如《艾丽丝漫游奇境记》

ex.cn: 这部小说可能会成为现代名著。

ex.en: That match was a classic.
ex.cn: 那场比赛堪称经典。

senses.def: the study of ancient Greek and Roman culture, especially their languages and literature
senses.chn: 古希腊与古罗马的文化研究（尤指对其语言与文学的研究）

ex.cn: 古希腊与古罗马文化研究的学位

senses.def: widely accepted and used for a long time; traditional in style or idea

ex.cn: 斯密与李嘉图的古典经济学

ex.en: the classical theory of unemployment
ex.cn: 传统的失业理论

ex.en: classical and modern ballet
ex.cn: 古典与现代芭蕾舞

senses.def: connected with or influenced by the culture of ancient Greece and Rome
senses.chn: 和古希腊与古罗马文化相关的；受古希腊与古罗马文化影响的

ex.en: classical studies
ex.cn: 古希腊与古罗马的文化研究

ex.en: a classical scholar (= an expert in Latin and Greek)
ex.cn: 研究拉丁文与希腊文的学者

ex.en: He plays classical music, as well as pop and jazz.
ex.cn: 他演奏流行音乐和爵士乐，同时也演奏古典音乐。

ex.cn: 古典音乐作曲家／小提琴手

senses.def: ancient in its form and no longer used in a spoken form

ex.en: classical Arabic
ex.cn: 古阿拉伯语

senses.def: simple and attractive
senses.chn: 简洁优美的；朴实美观的

ex.en: the classical elegance of the design
ex.cn: 设计简洁典雅

senses.def: a style of art and literature that is simple and elegant and is based on the styles of ancient Greece and Rome. Classicism was popular in Europe in the 18th century.
senses.chn: 古典主义（基于古希腊与古罗马风格，18 世纪盛行于欧洲）

senses.def: a style or form that has simple, natural qualities and pleasing combinations of parts
a person who studies ancient Greek or Latin
senses.chn: 古希腊文化研究者；拉丁文化研究者；古典学者

senses.def: a person who follows classicism in art or literature
senses.chn: （艺术或文学上的）古典主义者

senses.def: that you can or should classify
senses.chn: 可分类（或级别）的；应分类（或级别）的

ex.cn: 此信息不易分类。

ex.en: top-secret or classifiable information
ex.cn: 绝密或机密信息

senses.def: the act or process of putting people or things into a group or class (= of classifying them)

ex.en: a style of music that defies classification (= is like no other)
ex.cn: 独特的音乐风格

senses.def: a group, class, division, etc. into which sb or sth is put
the act of putting animals, plants, etc. into groups, classes or divisions according to their characteristics
a system of arranging books, tapes, magazines, etc. in a library into groups according to their subject
senses.chn: （图书馆的书、磁带、杂志等的）分类系统，编目

senses.def: officially secret and available only to particular people

ex.en: classified information/documents/material
ex.cn: 机密信息／文件／材料

senses.def: with information arranged in groups according to subjects

ex.en: a classified catalogue
ex.cn: 分类目录

senses.def: the section in a newspaper with small advertisements arranged in groups according to their subject, that are placed by people or small companies who want to buy or sell sth, find or offer a job, etc.

senses.chn: 分类成分，分类词（能显示同义所属关系，如前缀 un 是表示反义的分类成分）

ex.en: The books in the library are classified according to subject.
ex.cn: 图书馆的书按学科分类。

ex.en: Patients are classified into three categories.
ex.cn: 病人被归为三种类型。

ex.en: Only eleven of these accidents were classified as major.
ex.cn: 这些事故中只有十一例被判定为重大事故。

senses.def: with no divisions into social classes

ex.en: Will Britain ever become a classless society?
ex.cn: 英国会有可能成为无阶级的社会吗？

senses.def: not clearly belonging to a particular social class
senses.chn: 不明显属于社会某阶级（或阶层）的

ex.en: a classless accent
ex.cn: 不带社会阶层特征的口音

senses.def: a person who is or was in the same class as you at school or college
a room where a class of children or students is taught

ex.en: classroom activities
ex.cn: 课堂活动

ex.en: the use of computers in the classroom
ex.cn: 在课堂使用计算机

senses.def: opposition between the different social classes in society, especially that described in Marxist theory
senses.chn: （尤指马克思主义理论描述的）阶级斗争

senses.def: of high quality; expensive and/or fashionable

ex.en: a classy player
ex.cn: 优秀选手

ex.en: a classy hotel/restaurant
ex.cn: 豪华的旅馆／餐馆

senses.def: if hard objects clatter, they knock together and make a loud noise
senses.chn: （硬物相碰）发出响亮的撞击声

ex.en: He dropped the knife and it clattered on the stone floor.
ex.cn: 他一失手，刀子当啷一声掉到石头地面上。

ex.en: Her cup clattered in the saucer.
ex.cn: 她的杯子把茶碟碰得叮当响。

senses.def: to move making a loud noise like hard objects knocking together
senses.chn: 移动发出（像硬物碰撞）的响声

ex.en: The cart clattered over the cobbles.
ex.cn: 马车哐当哐当地行驶在卵石路上。

ex.en: She heard him clattering around downstairs.
ex.cn: 她听到他在楼下咔哒咔哒地走来走去。

senses.def: a group of words that includes a subject and a verb, and forms a sentence or part of a sentence

ex.en: In the sentence 'They often go to Italy because they love the food', 'They often go to Italy' is the main clause and 'because they love the food' is a subordinate clause.
ex.cn: 在 They often go to Italy because they love the food 这个句子里，They often go to Italy 是主句，because they love the food 是从句。

senses.def: an item in a legal document that says that a particular thing must or must not be done

senses.chn: 幽闭恐怖（症）；因受限制而产生的不适感

ex.en: to suffer from claustrophobia
ex.cn: 患幽闭恐怖症

ex.en: She felt she had to escape from the claustrophobia of family life.
ex.cn: 她感到她得摆脱家庭生活的那种幽闭感觉了。

senses.def: giving you claustrophobia; suffering from claustrophobia
senses.chn: 引起幽闭恐怖的；患幽闭恐怖症的

ex.en: the claustrophobic atmosphere of the room
ex.cn: 房间里的幽闭恐怖气氛

ex.en: to feel claustrophobic
ex.cn: 感到幽闭恐怖

senses.def: one of a pair of wooden sticks that are hit together to make a sound
a rhythm that forms the basis of Latin music
senses.chn: 响棒节奏（拉丁音乐的一个基本节奏）

senses.def: an early type of musical instrument, like a piano with a very soft tone
the collarbone
one of the sharp curved nails on the end of an animal's or a bird's foot
a long, sharp curved part of the body of some types of shellfish, used for catching and holding things

ex.en: the claws of a crab
ex.cn: 螃蟹的螯

senses.def: part of a tool or machine, like a claw, used for holding, pulling or lifting things
if a woman gets her claws into a man, she tries hard to make him marry her or to have a relationship with her
to criticize sb severely

ex.en: Wait until the media gets its claws into her.
ex.cn: 等着媒体来严厉批驳她吧。

senses.def: involving opposition or competition that is violent and without pity
senses.chn: 残酷无情；血淋淋；决不宽容

ex.en: nature, red in tooth and claw
ex.cn: 残酷无情的大自然

senses.def: to scratch or tear sb/sth with claws or with your nails

ex.en: The cat was clawing at the leg of the chair.
ex.cn: 那只猫在抓挠椅子腿。

ex.en: She had clawed Stephen across the face.
ex.cn: 她抓过斯蒂芬的脸。

ex.en: His hands clawed the air.
ex.cn: 他的双手在空中乱抓。

senses.def: to gradually achieve sth or move somewhere by using a lot of determination and effort
senses.chn: 努力逐步获得；艰难地移动

ex.en: She clawed her way to the top of her profession.
ex.cn: 她努力不懈，终于爬到了职业的顶峰。

ex.en: Slowly, he clawed his way out from under the collapsed building.
ex.cn: 他艰难地从倒塌的大楼废墟底下慢慢爬了出来。

senses.def: to get sth back that you have lost, usually by using a lot of effort
to get back money that has been paid to people, usually by taxing them
senses.chn: （常通过税收手段）收回（已支付给民众的钱款）

senses.def: the act of getting money back from people it has been paid to; the money that is paid back
a hammer with one split, curved side that is used for pulling out nails
senses.chn: 鱼尾锤；拔钉锤；羊角榔头

senses.def: a type of heavy, sticky earth that becomes hard when it is baked and is used to make things such as pots and bricks

ex.en: Plant the seedlings in damp soil.
ex.cn: 把幼苗种在湿润的土壤里。

ex.en: The car wheels got stuck in the mud.
ex.cn: 汽车轮子陷到泥里去了。

ex.en: A cloud of dust rose as the truck set off.
ex.cn: 卡车起动时扬起一片灰尘。

ex.en: The tiles are made of clay.
ex.cn: 这些砖是用陶土制成的。

ex.en: an area of rich, fertile land
ex.cn: 土地富饶肥沃的地域

ex.en: She put some earth into the pot.
ex.cn: 她在花盆里放了一些泥土。

senses.def: a tennis court that has a surface made of clay
senses.chn: 红土网球场；沙地网球场

senses.def: containing clay; like clay
senses.chn: 含黏土的；黏土质的；似黏土的

ex.en: clayey soil
ex.cn: 黏性土壤

senses.def: a large sword with a broad blade with two sharp edges that was used in Scotland in the past
a sport in which a disc of baked clay (called a clay pigeon) is thrown into the air for people to shoot at
not dirty

ex.en: Are your hands clean?
ex.cn: 你的手干净吗？

ex.en: to wipe sth clean
ex.cn: 把某物擦干净

ex.en: The hotel was spotlessly (= extremely) clean.
ex.cn: 这家旅馆干净得一尘不染。

ex.en: It is your responsibility to keep the room clean and tidy.
ex.cn: 保持房间整洁是你的职责。

ex.en: Keep your room neat and clean.
ex.cn: 保持房间整洁。

ex.en: I can't find a clean shirt (= one I haven't worn since it was washed).
ex.cn: 我找不到一件干净的衬衫。

senses.def: having a clean appearance and clean surroundings

ex.en: Cats are very clean animals.
ex.cn: 猫是很爱干净的动物。

senses.def: free from harmful or unpleasant substances

ex.en: clean drinking water
ex.cn: 洁净的饮用水

ex.en: clean air
ex.cn: 清洁的空气

ex.en: cleaner cars (= not producing so many harmful substances)
ex.cn: 环保型汽车

senses.def: with nothing written on it

ex.en: a clean sheet of paper
ex.cn: 一张空白纸

senses.def: not offensive or referring to sex; not doing anything that is considered immoral or bad
senses.chn: 文明的；无色情的；正派的

ex.en: The entertainment was good clean fun for the whole family.
ex.cn: 这种娱乐文明有趣，对全家老少都适合。

ex.en: Keep the jokes clean please!
ex.cn: 开玩笑请文明点！

ex.en: The sport has a very clean image.
ex.cn: 这项运动享有很文明的声誉。

senses.def: not showing or having any record of doing sth that is against the law
senses.chn: 无犯罪记录的；守法的；清白的

ex.en: a clean driving licence/driver's license
ex.cn: 无违章记录的驾驶执照

ex.en: a clean police record
ex.cn: 无犯罪记录

senses.def: not owning or carrying anything illegal such as drugs or weapons
senses.chn: 没有私藏（或携带）违禁品（如毒品、武器等）的

ex.en: The police searched her but she was clean.
ex.cn: 警察搜了她的身，但未发现她携带任何违禁品。

senses.def: played or done in a fair way and within the rules
senses.chn: 公平的；守规则的；不违例的

ex.en: It was a tough but clean game.
ex.cn: 这是一场打得艰苦但却是规规矩矩的比赛。

senses.def: having a smooth edge, surface or shape; simple and regular
senses.chn: 边缘平整的；表面平滑的；简洁规则的

ex.cn: 快刀切得整齐。

ex.en: a modern design with clean lines and a bright appearance
ex.cn: 线条流畅、外观明快的现代设计

senses.def: done in a skilful and accurate way
senses.chn: 动作熟练而准确的；干净利落的

ex.en: The plane made a clean take-off.
ex.cn: 飞机起飞得干净利落。

senses.def: tasting, smelling or looking pleasant and fresh

ex.en: The wine has a clean taste and a lovely golden colour.
ex.cn: 这葡萄酒味道清醇，色泽金黄。

senses.def: very clean
a report that says sb is healthy or that sth is in good condition
a complete separation from a person, an organization, a way of life, etc.
senses.chn: （与人、组织、生活方式等的）彻底决裂

ex.en: She wanted to make a clean break with the past.
ex.cn: 她想与过去完全断绝。

senses.def: a break in a bone in one place
a record of your work or behaviour that does not show any mistakes or bad things that you have done
senses.chn: 无过错记录；清白的历史

ex.en: No government operates with a completely clean sheet.
ex.cn: 没有任何政府执政一点也不失误。

ex.en: They kept a clean sheet in the match (= no goals were scored against them).
ex.cn: 他们在比赛中未失一球。

senses.def: to tell the truth about sth so that you no longer feel guilty
senses.chn: 彻底坦白；如实供认；把…和盘托出

senses.def: to remove all the people or things from an organization that are thought to be unnecessary or need changing
to win all the prizes or parts of a game or competition; to win an election completely
senses.chn: （比赛或竞赛中）大获全胜，包揽（所有奖项）；获得选举全胜

ex.en: China made a clean sweep of the medals in the gymnastics events.
ex.cn: 中国队在体操比赛中包揽了所有的奖牌。

ex.en: The opinion poll suggests a clean sweep for the Democrats.
ex.cn: 民意测验表明民主党有可能大获全胜。

senses.def: to avoid doing anything wrong or illegal
senses.chn: 循规蹈矩；不做违法的事

ex.en: Since leaving prison, he's managed to keep his nose clean.
ex.cn: 自从出狱以来，他已做到规规矩矩。

senses.def: to agree to forget about past mistakes or arguments and start again with a relationship
senses.chn: 把以往过错一笔勾销；一消前愆；捐弃前嫌

senses.def: to make sth free from dirt or dust by washing or rubbing it
senses.chn: 除去…的灰尘；使…干净；打扫

ex.en: to clean the windows/bath/floor
ex.cn: 擦窗户／浴缸／地板

ex.en: to clean a wound
ex.cn: 洗净伤口

ex.en: Have you cleaned your teeth?
ex.cn: 你刷牙了吗？

ex.en: The villa is cleaned twice a week.
ex.cn: 这栋别墅一周打扫两次。

ex.en: I spent all day cooking and cleaning.
ex.cn: 我一整天都忙着做饭和打扫卫生。

senses.def: to become clean

ex.en: This oven cleans easily (= is easy to clean).
ex.cn: 这烤箱容易擦洗。

senses.def: to remove the inside parts of a fish, chicken, etc. before you cook it
to remove people or things that are not necessary or wanted
senses.chn: 清除不必要的人（或事物）；裁减

ex.en: The new manager said he wanted to clean house.
ex.cn: 新上任的经理说他要裁员。

senses.def: to make your house clean
to start behaving in a moral or responsible way

ex.en: He cleaned up his act and came off drugs.
ex.cn: 他已改邪归正戒掉了毒品。

senses.def: to clean sth thoroughly

ex.en: All the equipment should be cleaned down regularly.
ex.cn: 所有设备都应该定期彻底打扫。

senses.def: to remove sth from sth by brushing, rubbing, etc.

ex.en: I cleaned the mud off my shoes.
ex.cn: 我刷掉了鞋子上的泥土。

senses.def: to clean the inside of sth thoroughly
senses.chn: 把（某物）内部彻底打扫干净

ex.en: I must clean the fish tank out.
ex.cn: 我必须把养鱼缸彻底清洗干净。

senses.def: to use all of sb's money
senses.chn: 耗尽（某人的）钱；用光（某人的）钱

ex.en: Paying for all those drinks has cleaned me out.
ex.cn: 购买那些饮料把我的钱花得一干二净。

senses.def: to steal everything from a person or place

ex.en: The burglars totally cleaned her out.
ex.cn: 窃贼把她洗劫一空。

senses.def: to win or make a lot of money

ex.en: This film should clean up at the box offices.
ex.cn: 这部电影在票房收入上应该能赚大钱。

senses.def: to make yourself clean, usually by washing

ex.en: I need to change and clean up.
ex.cn: 我需要换洗一下。

ex.en: Go and clean yourself up.
ex.cn: 去梳洗干净吧。

ex.en: You'd better get cleaned up.
ex.cn: 你最好去梳洗一下。

senses.def: to remove dirt, etc. from somewhere

ex.en: He always expected other people to clean up after him (= when he had made the place dirty or untidy).
ex.cn: 他总是指望别人来打扫他弄脏了的地方。

ex.en: Who's going to clean up this mess?
ex.cn: 这么又脏又乱的，谁来清理？

ex.en: to clean up beaches after an oil spillage
ex.cn: 清理石油泄漏后被污染的海滩

senses.def: to remove crime and immoral behaviour from a place or an activity
senses.chn: 清除（某地或某活动中的）犯罪及不道德行为；清理；整顿

ex.en: The new mayor is determined to clean up the city.
ex.cn: 新上任的市长决心要整治好这座城市。

ex.en: Soccer needs to clean up its image.
ex.cn: 足球界的形象需要改善。

senses.def: used to emphasize that an action takes place completely

ex.en: The thief got clean away.
ex.cn: 那小偷已逃之夭夭。

ex.en: I clean forgot about calling him.
ex.cn: 我把给他打电话的事忘得一干二净。

senses.def: to admit and explain sth that you have kept as a secret

ex.en: Isn't it time the government came clean about their plans for education?
ex.cn: 这难道不是政府彻底说明教育计划的时候了吗？

senses.def: the act or process of cleaning sth

ex.en: The house needed a good clean.
ex.cn: 这房子需要彻底打扫。

senses.def: an exercise in weightlifting in which a bar with weights is lifted to the shoulder, and then raised above the head
looking neat and clean and therefore socially acceptable

ex.en: Simon's clean-cut good looks
ex.cn: 西蒙整洁英俊的外表

senses.def: a person whose job is to clean other people's houses or offices, etc.

ex.en: an office cleaner
ex.cn: 办公室清洁工

senses.def: a machine or substance that is used for cleaning

ex.en: a vacuum cleaner
ex.cn: 真空吸尘器

ex.en: a bottle of kitchen cleaner
ex.cn: 一瓶厨房清洁剂

senses.def: a shop/store where clothes, curtains, etc. are cleaned, especially with chemicals

ex.en: Can you pick up my suit from the cleaner's?
ex.cn: 你能帮我从干洗店取回我的套装吗？

senses.def: to steal all of sb's money, etc., or to get it using a trick
senses.chn: 将某人洗劫一空；偷光（或骗尽）某人的钱财

senses.def: to defeat sb completely

ex.en: Our team got taken to the cleaners.
ex.cn: 我们队被打得一败涂地。

senses.def: to remove people or things that are not necessary or wanted
senses.chn: 清除不必要的人（或事物）；裁减

ex.en: The new manager said he wanted to clean house.
ex.cn: 新上任的经理说他要裁员。

senses.def: to make your house clean
the work of making the inside of a house, etc. clean

ex.en: They pay someone to do the cleaning.
ex.cn: 他们花钱雇人打扫。

senses.def: a woman whose job is to clean the rooms and furniture in an office, a house, etc.
thin and with a good shape
senses.chn: 体形修长优美的；苗条的

ex.en: a clean-limbed model
ex.cn: 身材苗条的模特儿

senses.def: the state of being clean or the habit of keeping things clean
senses.chn: 清洁；干净；爱干净的习惯

ex.en: Some people are obsessive about cleanliness.
ex.cn: 有些人有洁癖。

senses.def: living a healthy life, by not drinking alcohol, not having sex with a lot of different people, etc.
easily and smoothly in one movement

ex.en: The boat moved cleanly through the water.
ex.cn: 小船在水面上轻快地行进。

senses.def: in a clean way

ex.en: fuel that burns cleanly
ex.cn: 环保型的燃料

senses.def: to use all of sb's money
senses.chn: 耗尽（某人的）钱；用光（某人的）钱

ex.en: Paying for all those drinks has cleaned me out.
ex.cn: 购买那些饮料把我的钱花得一干二净。

senses.def: to clean your skin or a wound

ex.en: a cleansing cream
ex.cn: 洁肤霜

ex.en: The villa is cleaned twice a week.
ex.cn: 这栋别墅一周打扫两次。

ex.en: Have you cleaned your teeth?
ex.cn: 你刷牙了吗？

ex.en: This coat is filthy. I'll have it cleaned(= dry-cleaned).
ex.cn: 这件大衣脏了，我得送去干洗。

ex.en: He quickly washed his hands and face.
ex.cn: 他很快把手和脸洗了。

ex.en: These jeans need washing.
ex.cn: 这条牛仔裤该洗了。

senses.def: to take away sb's guilty feelings or sin
a liquid or cream for cleaning your face, especially for removing make-up
senses.chn: （尤指用于清除脸上化妆的）洁肤液，洁肤霜

senses.def: a substance that contains chemicals and is used for cleaning things
a man who is clean-shaven does not have a beard or moustache (= hair that has been allowed to grow on the face)
to remove dirt, etc. from somewhere

ex.en: He always expected other people to clean up after him (= when he had made the place dirty or untidy).
ex.cn: 他总是指望别人来打扫他弄脏了的地方。

ex.en: Who's going to clean up this mess?
ex.cn: 这么又脏又乱的，谁来清理？

ex.en: to clean up beaches after an oil spillage
ex.cn: 清理石油泄漏后被污染的海滩

senses.def: the process of removing dirt, pollution, or things that are considered bad or immoral from a place
senses.chn: 清扫；清除（污染物）；清理；整顿

ex.en: the clean-up of the river
ex.cn: 河流清理

ex.en: a clean-up campaign
ex.cn: 整顿运动

senses.def: to start behaving in a moral or responsible way

ex.en: He cleaned up his act and came off drugs.
ex.cn: 他已改邪归正戒掉了毒品。

senses.def: easy to understand and not causing any confusion
senses.chn: 清晰易懂的；明白清楚的；不含混的

ex.en: She gave me clear and precise directions.
ex.cn: 她给了我清晰而准确的指示。

ex.en: Are these instructions clear enough?
ex.cn: 这些说明够清楚了吗？

ex.en: You'll do as you're told, is that clear?
ex.cn: 叫你做什么你就去做什么，明白吗？

ex.en: This behaviour must stop—do I make myself clear (= express myself clearly so there is no doubt about what I mean)?
ex.cn: 这种行为必须停止。我讲清楚了吧？

ex.en: I hope I made it clear to him that he was no longer welcome here.
ex.cn: 我希望我已经给他讲清楚他在这里不再受欢迎。

senses.def: obvious and leaving no doubt at all

ex.en: This is a clear case of fraud.
ex.cn: 这无疑是一桩诈骗案。

ex.en: She won the election by a clear majority.
ex.cn: 她以明显的多数赢得选举。

ex.en: His height gives him a clear advantage.
ex.cn: 他的身高使他具有明显的优势。

ex.en: It was quite clear to me that she was lying.
ex.cn: 我十分清楚她在撒谎。

ex.en: It is not clear what they want us to do.
ex.cn: 我们不清楚他们要我们做什么。

ex.en: It was quite clear to me that she was lying.
ex.cn: 我十分清楚她在撒谎。

senses.def: having or feeling no doubt or confusion

ex.en: Are you clear about the arrangements for tomorrow?
ex.cn: 你清楚明天的安排吗？

ex.en: My memory is not clear on that point.
ex.cn: 那一点我记不清了。

ex.en: I'm still not clear what the job involves.
ex.cn: 我仍然不明白这项工作包括哪些内容。

ex.en: We need a clear understanding of the problems involved.
ex.cn: 我们需要了解清楚所涉及的各种问题。

ex.en: 'Is that John over there?' 'I'm not sure.'
ex.cn: “那边那个人是约翰吗？” “我说不准。”

ex.en: Are you sure about that?
ex.cn: 这事你肯定吗？

senses.def: thinking in a sensible and logical way, especially in a difficult situation
senses.chn: （尤指在困境中）思维敏锐而有逻辑的，头脑清醒的

ex.en: a clear thinker
ex.cn: 思维清晰的人

ex.en: You'll need to keep a clear head for your interview.
ex.cn: 你面试时要保持清醒的头脑。

senses.def: easy to see or hear

ex.en: The photo wasn't very clear.
ex.cn: 这张照片不太清晰。

ex.en: The voice on the phone was clear and strong.
ex.cn: 电话上的声音清晰洪亮。

ex.en: She was in Australia but I could hear her voice as clear as a bell.
ex.cn: 她虽然在澳大利亚，但我却能非常清楚地听到她的声音。

senses.def: that you can see through

ex.en: The water was so clear we could see the bottom of the lake.
ex.cn: 湖水清澈见底。

ex.en: clear glass
ex.cn: 透明的玻璃

ex.en: a clear colourless liquid
ex.cn: 透明的无色液体

senses.def: without cloud or mist

ex.en: a clear blue sky
ex.cn: 晴朗的碧空

ex.en: On a clear day you can see France.
ex.cn: 天气晴朗时你可以看见法国。

senses.def: without spots or marks

ex.en: clear skin
ex.cn: 没有丝毫斑点的皮肤

ex.en: a clear complexion
ex.cn: 无瑕的面庞

senses.def: bright and lively
free from things that are blocking the way or covering the surface of sth
senses.chn: 畅通无阻的；无障碍的；（表面）收拾干净的

ex.en: The road was clear and I ran over.
ex.cn: 路上没有东西挡着，我就跑了过来。

ex.en: All exits must be kept clear of baggage.
ex.cn: 所有出口必须保持通畅，不得堆放行李。

ex.en: You won't get a clear view of the stage from here.
ex.cn: 从这里看舞台，你的视野会受到遮挡。

ex.en: I always leave a clear desk at the end of the day.
ex.cn: 每天工作结束时，我总是把桌面收拾干净。

senses.def: if you have a clear conscience or your conscience is clear, you do not feel guilty
senses.chn: 无罪的；清白的；问心无愧的

senses.def: free from sth that is unpleasant

ex.en: They were still not clear of all suspicion.
ex.cn: 他们仍未解除所有的嫌疑。

ex.en: We are finally clear of debt.
ex.cn: 我们终于偿清了债务。

senses.def: not touching sth; a distance away from sth

ex.en: The plane climbed until it was clear of the clouds.
ex.cn: 飞机爬升直至穿出了云层。

ex.en: Make sure you park your car clear of the entrance.
ex.cn: 切莫把车停在入口处。

senses.def: whole or complete

ex.en: Allow three clear days for the letter to arrive.
ex.cn: 信要整整三天才能寄到。

senses.def: remaining when taxes, costs, etc. have been taken away
senses.chn: （扣除税项、成本等后）净的，纯的

ex.en: They had made a clear profit of £2 000.
ex.cn: 他们已赚得 2 000 英镑的净利。

senses.def: produced with the central part of the tongue close to the top of the mouth. In many accents of English, clear /l/ is used before a vowel, as in leave.
easy to see or understand
not clear at all; not easy to understand

ex.en: Oh well, that's all as clear as mud, then.
ex.cn: 哎呀，那么一来这真是成了一本糊涂账了。

senses.def: to enable sb to be successful in a particular area of activity because other people or groups have given up competing with them
senses.chn: 为…的胜利铺平道路；为…的成功扫清障碍

senses.def: to remain calm in a difficult situation
in a way that is very easy to understand

ex.en: The message is coming through loud and clear.
ex.cn: 消息传达得清楚明白。

senses.def: to remove sth that is not wanted or needed from a place
senses.chn: 移走，搬走，清除（不需要的东西）

ex.en: I had cleared my desk before I left.
ex.cn: 离开前我清理干净了办公桌。

ex.en: It was several hours before the road was cleared after the accident.
ex.cn: 事故过去几小时后这条道路才被疏通。

ex.en: It's your turn to clear the table (= to take away the dirty plates, etc. after a meal).
ex.cn: 该轮到你收拾餐桌了。

ex.en: She cleared a space on the sofa for him to sit down.
ex.cn: 她在沙发上清出一个空位让他坐下。

ex.en: I cleared my desk of papers.
ex.cn: 我清理好了写字台上的文件。

ex.en: The streets had been cleared of snow.
ex.cn: 街道上的积雪已被清除干净。

senses.def: to make people leave a place

ex.en: After the bomb warning, police cleared the streets.
ex.cn: 接到有炸弹的警告后，警察疏散了街上的行人。

senses.def: to move freely again; to no longer be blocked

ex.en: The traffic took a long time to clear after the accident.
ex.cn: 事故后很久交通才恢复畅通。

ex.en: The boy's lungs cleared and he began to breathe more easily.
ex.cn: 男孩的肺部恢复通畅后，呼吸开始比较轻松。

senses.def: when a liquid clears, it becomes transparent and you can see through it

ex.en: The muddy water slowly cleared.
ex.cn: 浑浊的水慢慢变得清澈起来。

senses.def: when smoke, fog, etc. clears, it disappears so that it is easier to see things

ex.en: The mist will clear by mid-morning.
ex.cn: 雾将在上午十时左右消散。

senses.def: when the sky or the weather clears, it becomes brighter and free of cloud or rain

ex.en: The sky cleared after the storm.
ex.cn: 暴风雨过后，天转晴了。

ex.en: The rain is clearing slowly.
ex.cn: 雨渐渐停下来。

senses.def: if your head or mind clears, or you clear it, you become free of thoughts that worry or confuse you or the effects of alcohol, a blow, etc. and you are able to think clearly

ex.en: As her mind cleared, she remembered what had happened.
ex.cn: 头脑清醒之后，她想起了所发生的一切。

ex.en: I went for a walk to clear my head.
ex.cn: 我去散一会儿步，好清醒清醒头脑。

senses.def: if your face or expression clears, you stop looking angry or worried
to prove that sb is innocent

ex.en: She was cleared of all charges against her.
ex.cn: 对她的所有指控均已撤销。

ex.en: Throughout his years in prison, he fought to clear his name.
ex.cn: 在整个服刑期间，他奋力证明自己名誉的清白。

senses.def: to give or get official approval for sth to be done

ex.en: His appointment had been cleared by the board.
ex.cn: 他的任命已由董事会批准。

ex.en: I'll have to clear it with the manager.
ex.cn: 这事我须要获得经理的准许。

senses.def: to give official permission for a person, a ship, a plane or goods to leave or enter a place
senses.chn: 批准（人、船只、飞机或货物）离境（或入境）；使通过（海关）

ex.en: The plane had been cleared for take-off.
ex.cn: 飞机已获准起飞。

ex.en: to clear goods through customs
ex.cn: 给货物结关

senses.def: to decide officially, after finding out information about sb, that they can be given special work or allowed to see secret papers
senses.chn: （经审查后）正式批准（某人）做机密工作（或阅读机密文件）

ex.en: She hasn't been cleared by security.
ex.cn: 她未获保安部门批准做机要工作。

senses.def: if a payment that is made into your bank account clears, or a bank clears it, the money is available for you to use
senses.chn: （付款）到账；（银行）将（付款）划入账户

ex.en: Cheques usually take three working days to clear.
ex.cn: 兑现支票通常需要三个工作日。

senses.def: to gain or earn a sum of money as profit

ex.en: She cleared £1 000 on the deal.
ex.cn: 她在那笔交易中净赚 1 000 英镑。

senses.def: if you clear a debt or a loan, you pay all the money back
to jump over or get past sth without touching it

ex.en: The horse cleared the fence easily.
ex.cn: 那匹马轻松地跃过了栅栏。

ex.en: The car only just cleared (= avoided hitting) the gatepost.
ex.cn: 那辆汽车通过时险些撞上门柱。

senses.def: if you clear a ball, or a ball clears, it is kicked or hit away from the area near your own goal
senses.chn: 将（球）击离己方球门区；（球）滚离己方球门区

senses.def: to improve a difficult or tense situation by talking about worries, doubts, etc.
senses.chn: （通过倾诉）改变困境，缓解紧张状态，改善气氛

senses.def: to prepare for an activity, event, etc. by removing anything that is not essential to it
to cough so that you can speak clearly
to remove things that are stopping the progress or movement of sth

ex.en: The ruling could clear the way for extradition proceedings.
ex.cn: 这项裁决也许能为引渡程序铺平道路。

senses.def: there is no danger of being seen or caught
senses.chn: 没有被发现（或抓住）的危险

ex.en: As soon as the coast was clear he climbed in through the window.
ex.cn: 等到四下无人，他便从窗户爬了进去。

senses.def: to help sb start sth in a fresh, lively state of mind
senses.chn: 使头脑清醒；使振作精神

ex.en: A brisk walk should blow the cobwebs away.
ex.cn: 轻快的散步可以使人头脑清醒。

senses.def: to remove sth because it is not wanted or needed, or in order to leave a clear space

ex.en: He cleared away and made coffee.
ex.cn: 他把东西收拾好以后煮了咖啡。

ex.en: It's time your toys were cleared away.
ex.cn: 现在该收走你的玩具了。

senses.def: to go or run away

ex.en: He cleared off when he heard the police siren.
ex.cn: 他听到警笛便逃之夭夭。

ex.en: You've no right to be here. Clear off!
ex.cn: 你无权在这里，走开！

senses.def: to leave a place quickly

ex.en: He cleared out with all the money and left her with the kids.
ex.cn: 他卷款而逃，把孩子丢给她。

senses.def: to make sth empty and clean by removing things or throwing things away

ex.en: to clear out a drawer/room
ex.cn: 把抽屉／房间腾空

ex.en: We cleared out all our old clothes.
ex.cn: 我们扔掉了所有的旧衣服。

ex.en: I found the letters when I was clearing out after my father died.
ex.cn: 我在父亲去世后清理遗物时发现了这些信件。

senses.def: to become fine or bright

ex.en: I hope it clears up this afternoon.
ex.cn: 我希望今天下午天气放晴。

senses.def: to disappear

ex.en: Has your rash cleared up yet?
ex.cn: 你的皮疹消失了吗？

senses.def: to make sth clean and neat

ex.en: It's time to clear up.
ex.cn: 该打扫了。

ex.en: I'm fed up with clearing up after you!
ex.cn: 你弄脏了的地方总是要我来打扫，我受够了！

ex.en: Clear up your own mess!
ex.cn: 看你把这里弄得又脏又乱的，你自己来收拾吧！

senses.def: to solve or explain sth

ex.en: to clear up a mystery/difficulty/misunderstanding
ex.cn: 揭开谜团；解决困难；消除误会

senses.def: away from sth; not near or touching sth

ex.en: Stand clear of the train doors.
ex.cn: 不要靠近列车门站立。

ex.en: He injured his arm as he jumped clear of the car.
ex.cn: 他跳离汽车时手臂受了伤。

ex.en: By lap two Walker was two metres clear of the rest of the runners.
ex.cn: 跑第二圈时，沃克已领先了其他赛跑者两米。

senses.def: all the way to sth that is far away

ex.en: She could see clear down the highway into the town.
ex.cn: 她顺着公路一直望去，能看到远处的那座城镇。

senses.def: to avoid a person or thing because it may cause problems
to find that it is possible or convenient to do sth
senses.chn: 觉得有可能做某事；认为便于做某事

ex.en: Small builders cannot see their way clear to take on many trainees.
ex.cn: 小建筑商认为不可能招收很多见习生。

senses.def: no longer in danger or thought to be guilty of sth
senses.chn: 不再有危险；不再被认为有罪

ex.en: It seems that the original suspect is in the clear.
ex.cn: 好像原先的嫌疑犯已被认定无罪。

senses.def: the removal of things that are not wanted

ex.en: forest clearances
ex.cn: 伐空的林地

ex.en: slum clearance (= the removal of houses that are in very bad condition in an area of a town)
ex.cn: 拆除贫民窟

ex.en: a clearance sale (= in a shop/store, when goods are sold cheaply to get rid of them quickly)
ex.cn: 清仓大甩卖

senses.def: the amount of space or distance that is needed between two objects so that they do not touch each other

ex.en: There is not much clearance for vehicles passing under this bridge.
ex.cn: 车辆在这座桥下通过时没有多少余隙。

ex.en: a clearance of one metre
ex.cn: 一米的间距

senses.def: official permission that is given to sb before they can work somewhere, have particular information, or do sth they want to do
senses.chn: （录用或准许接触机密以前的）审查许可，审核批准

ex.en: I'm waiting for clearance from headquarters.
ex.cn: 我在等待总部的录用审查许可。

ex.en: All employees at the submarine base require security clearance.
ex.cn: 所有潜水艇基地的雇员必须得到安全部门的审查许可方可录用。

senses.def: official permission for a person or vehicle to enter or leave an airport or a country
senses.chn: （人、交通工具进出机场或出入境的）许可，准许

ex.en: The pilot was waiting for clearance for take-off.
ex.cn: 飞行员在等待起飞的许可。

senses.def: the process of a payment into a bank account being confirmed by the bank, so the money is available for you to use
a clearance in football (soccer) and some other sports is when a player kicks or hits the ball away from the goal of his or her own team
senses.chn: （足球及其他一些体育运动中的）解围

senses.def: to remove sth because it is not wanted or needed, or in order to leave a clear space

ex.en: He cleared away and made coffee.
ex.cn: 他把东西收拾好以后煮了咖啡。

ex.en: It's time your toys were cleared away.
ex.cn: 现在该收走你的玩具了。

senses.def: definite and easy to see or identify
senses.chn: 明确的；明显的；易辨认的

ex.en: There is no clear-cut answer to this question.
ex.cn: 这个问题没有确切的答案。

senses.def: able to think in a clear and sensible way, especially in a difficult situation
senses.chn: （尤指在困境中）头脑清醒的，明白事理的

senses.def: an open space in a forest where there are no trees
(in Britain) the system used by universities to find students for the places on their courses that have not been filled shortly before the beginning of the academic year
senses.chn: （英国大学的）补录（学年开始前补招学生填补空缺名额）

ex.en: She got into university through clearing.
ex.cn: 她通过补录上了大学。

ex.en: You can apply for a place through the clearing system.
ex.cn: 你可以通过补录系统申请一个名额。

ex.en: The university has a limited number of clearing places this year.
ex.cn: 今年这所大学的补录名额有限。

senses.def: (in Britain) a bank that uses a clearing house when dealing with other banks
senses.chn: （英国）清算银行，票据交换银行

senses.def: a central office that banks use in order to pay each other money and exchange cheques, etc.
senses.chn: （银行）票据交换所，清算中心，结算所

senses.def: an organization that collects and exchanges information on behalf of people or other organizations
senses.chn: 信息交换机构；信息交流所

senses.def: in a way that is easy to see or hear

ex.en: Please speak clearly after the tone.
ex.cn: 请听到信号后清楚地讲话。

senses.def: in a way that is sensible and easy to understand

ex.en: She explained everything very clearly.
ex.cn: 她把一切都解释得很明白。

senses.def: to make the distance or difference between two people or things smaller; to become smaller or narrower

ex.en: These measures are aimed at closing the gap between rich and poor.
ex.cn: 这些措施旨在缩小贫富差距。

ex.en: The gap between the two top teams is closing all the time.
ex.cn: 两支顶尖球队的差距一直在缩小。

senses.def: to hold sth/sb firmly
senses.chn: 把…牢牢抱住（或抓住、握住）

ex.en: She closed her hand over his.
ex.cn: 她牢牢抓住他的手不放。

ex.en: Her hand closed over his.
ex.cn: 她牢牢抓住他的手不放。

senses.def: to stop doing sth because you no longer believe you will be successful or will find a solution
senses.chn: （因相信不会成功或没有结论而）放弃

ex.en: The police have closed the book on the case (= they have stopped trying to solve it).
ex.cn: 警方已经放弃侦破此案。

senses.def: to stop trading

ex.en: The factory closed its doors for the last time in 2009.
ex.cn: 这家工厂最后于 2009 年关闭。

senses.def: to refuse to think about sth as a possibility
senses.chn: 对…拒不考虑（或置之不理、置若罔闻）

senses.def: if a group of people close ranks, they work closely together to defend themselves, especially when they are being criticized
senses.chn: （尤指受到批评时）抱团，携手合作

ex.en: It's not unusual for the police to close ranks when one of their officers is being investigated.
ex.cn: 在一位警员受到调查时，警察抱团的事并不罕见。

senses.def: if soldiers close ranks, they move closer together in order to defend themselves
to make it unlikely that sth will happen
senses.chn: 使不可能；拒…于门外；把…的门堵死

ex.en: She was careful not to close the door on the possibility of further talks.
ex.cn: 她小心翼翼不让进一步谈判的大门关上。

senses.def: to refuse to listen to sth

ex.en: She decided to shut her ears to all the rumours.
ex.cn: 她拿定主意对所有的谣言置之不理。

senses.def: to pretend that you have not noticed sth so that you do not have to deal with it
senses.chn: （对…）视而不见，熟视无睹，置若罔闻

senses.def: having enough experience to be able to do sth easily

ex.en: I've made this trip so often, I could do it with my eyes shut.
ex.cn: 我经常走这条路，闭着眼睛都能找到。

senses.def: when a radio or television station closes down, it stops broadcasting at the end of the day
senses.chn: （电台或电视台在一天的播送后）结束播放，停止播音

senses.def: when the days close in, they become gradually shorter during the autumn/fall
if the weather closes in, it gets worse
when the night closes in, it gets darker

ex.en: They huddled around the fire as the night closed in.
ex.cn: 夜幕降临的时候，他们聚拢在炉火旁。

senses.def: to move nearer to sb/sth, especially in order to attack them

ex.en: The lions closed in on their prey.
ex.cn: 狮子逼近它们的猎物。

senses.def: to separate sth from other parts so that people cannot use it

ex.en: The entrance to the train station was closed off following the explosion.
ex.cn: 爆炸发生后随即封锁了火车站入口。

senses.def: to finish or settle sth

ex.en: The band closes the album out with an instrumental track.
ex.cn: 乐队在这张专缉的最后以一首器乐曲收尾。

ex.en: A rock concert closed out the festivities.
ex.cn: 一场摇滚音乐会为庆典活动画下句点。

senses.def: to sell goods very cheaply in order to get rid of them quickly
senses.chn: 削价销售；清仓处理；大甩卖

senses.def: to surround and cover sb/sth

ex.en: The water closed over his head.
ex.cn: 水没过他的头顶。

senses.def: when a wound closes up, it heals
to hide your thoughts or emotions

ex.en: She closed up when I asked about her family.
ex.cn: 我问起她的家人时她避而不谈。

senses.def: to shut and lock sth such as a shop/store or a building, especially for a short period of time

ex.en: Why don't we close up and go out for lunch?
ex.cn: 我们何不关上门出去吃顿午饭？

ex.en: Can the last one out close up the office?
ex.cn: 最后离开的人把办公室锁上好吗？

senses.def: to come closer together; to bring people or things closer together

ex.en: Traffic was heavy and cars were closing up behind each other.
ex.cn: 交通拥挤不堪，汽车一辆紧挨一辆地前行。

senses.def: to become narrower and less open

ex.en: Every time he tried to speak, his throat closed up with fear.
ex.cn: 每当他试图讲话时，他都害怕得喉咙发紧说不出话来。

senses.def: the end of a period of time or an activity
senses.chn: （一段时间或活动的）结束，终结，终了

ex.en: at the close of the 17th century
ex.cn: 在 17 世纪末

ex.en: His life was drawing to a close.
ex.cn: 他的生命正走向终点。

ex.en: Can we bring this meeting to a close?
ex.cn: 我们可以结束会议了吗？

senses.def: near in space or time

ex.en: Our new house is close to the school.
ex.cn: 我们的新房子离学校很近。

ex.en: I had no idea the beach was so close.
ex.cn: 我不知道海滩会这么近。

ex.en: The two buildings are close together.
ex.cn: 两座建筑物相距很近。

ex.en: This is the closest we can get to the beach by car.
ex.cn: 开车去海滩到了这儿就再也不能往前走了。

ex.en: We all have to work in close proximity (= near each other).
ex.cn: 我们都不得不紧挨在一起工作。

ex.en: The President was shot at close range (= from a short distance away).
ex.cn: 总统遭到了近距离的枪击。

senses.def: almost in a particular state; likely to do sth soon
senses.chn: 几乎（处于某种状态）；可能（快要做某事）

ex.en: He was close to tears.
ex.cn: 他几乎掉眼泪了。

ex.en: The new library is close to completion.
ex.cn: 新图书馆快要竣工了。

ex.en: She knew she was close to death.
ex.cn: 她知道自己将不久于人世。

ex.en: We are close to signing the agreement.
ex.cn: 我们可能很快要签订协议。

senses.def: knowing sb very well and liking them very much

ex.en: Jo is a very close friend.
ex.cn: 乔是一个很亲密的朋友。

ex.en: She is very close to her father.
ex.cn: 她和父亲的关系很亲密。

ex.en: She and her father are very close.
ex.cn: 她和父亲的关系很亲密。

ex.en: We're a very close family.
ex.cn: 我们全家彼此亲密无间。

senses.def: near in family relationship

ex.en: close relatives, such as your mother and father, and brothers and sisters
ex.cn: 近亲，如父母和兄弟姊妹

senses.def: very involved in the work or activities of sb else, usually seeing and talking to them regularly
senses.chn: （与某人的工作或活动）紧密相关的，密切的

ex.en: He is one of the prime minister's closest advisers.
ex.cn: 他是首相最亲信的顾问之一。

ex.en: The college has close links with many other institutions.
ex.cn: 这所学院与其他许多的机构有着紧密的联系。

ex.en: She has kept in close contact with the victims' families.
ex.cn: 她与受害者的家人一直保持着密切的联系。

ex.en: We keep in close touch with the police.
ex.cn: 我们与警方保持着密切联系。

senses.def: careful and thorough

ex.en: Take a close look at this photograph.
ex.cn: 仔细看看这张照片。

ex.en: On closer examination the painting proved to be a fake.
ex.cn: 经过更加仔细的查看，那幅画被证实是件赝品。

ex.en: Pay close attention to what I am telling you.
ex.cn: 要认真听我给你讲的话。

senses.def: very similar to sth else or to an amount

ex.en: There's a close resemblance (= they look very similar).
ex.cn: 彼此间有酷似之处。

ex.en: His feeling for her was close to hatred.
ex.cn: 他对她的感情近乎仇恨。

ex.en: The total was close to 20% of the workforce.
ex.cn: 总数接近劳动力的 20%。

ex.en: We tried to match the colours, but this is the closest we could get.
ex.cn: 我们尽量使颜色搭配协调，但最好也只能做到这样了。

senses.def: won by only a small amount or distance
senses.chn: 实力相差无几的；仅以些微之差获胜的

ex.en: a close contest/match/election
ex.cn: 双方实力很接近的竞赛／比赛；胜负双方差距很小的选举

ex.en: It was a very close finish.
ex.cn: 比赛结果的胜负双方差距极小。

ex.en: I think it's going to be close.
ex.cn: 我认为这将是一场势均力敌的角逐。

ex.en: Our team came a close second (= nearly won).
ex.cn: 我们队以微弱差距屈居第二。

ex.en: The game was closer than the score suggests.
ex.cn: 双方实力比得分所显示的要更接近。

ex.en: The result is going to be too close to call (= either side may win).
ex.cn: 双方实力非常接近，因此结果无法预料。

senses.def: used to describe sth, usually a dangerous or unpleasant situation, that nearly happens
senses.chn: （通常指危险或不愉快的情况几乎发生）差一点儿，险些

ex.en: Phew! That was close—that car nearly hit us.
ex.cn: 啊！好险！那辆车差点儿撞上我们。

ex.en: We caught the bus in the end but it was close (= we nearly missed it).
ex.cn: 虽然我们最后总算赶上了那趟公共汽车，但也是够悬的。

senses.def: with little or no space in between
senses.chn: 空隙极小的；无空隙的；密集的；紧凑的

ex.en: over 1 000 pages of close print
ex.cn: 1 000 多页字体密集的印刷品

ex.en: The soldiers advanced in close formation.
ex.cn: 士兵排着密集的队形前进。

senses.def: cut very short, near to the skin
senses.chn: 剪到齐根的；剪得很短的

ex.en: a close haircut/shave
ex.cn: 剪到齐根的头发；刮剃干净

senses.def: carefully guarded
senses.chn: 严加戒备的；守卫严密的

ex.en: The donor's identity is a close secret.
ex.cn: 捐赠人的身份是保密的。

ex.en: She was kept under close arrest.
ex.cn: 她被严密监禁。

senses.def: warm in an uncomfortable way because there does not seem to be enough fresh air
not willing to give personal information about yourself
senses.chn: （对自己的个人信息）守口如瓶

ex.en: He was close about his past.
ex.cn: 他对他的过去守口如瓶。

senses.def: not liking to spend money

ex.en: She's always been very close with her money.
ex.cn: 她用钱总是很吝啬。

senses.def: produced with the mouth in a relatively closed position
senses.chn: 闭塞音的，闭的（发音时口形相对闭合的）

senses.def: very near

ex.en: fighting at close quarters
ex.cn: 近距离作战

senses.def: used to tell sb that their attempt or guess was almost but not quite successful
senses.chn: 很接近，但还是输了；猜得差不多，但不完全对

senses.def: a situation in which you only just manage to avoid an accident, etc.
senses.chn: 侥幸避免事故；侥幸脱险；幸免于难

senses.def: a situation in which success or failure is equally possible

ex.en: We got him out in the end, but it was a close thing.
ex.cn: 我们最后总算把他救了出来，可那是真险啊。

senses.def: if a remark or topic of discussion is close to home, it is accurate or connected with you in a way that makes you uncomfortable or embarrassed
senses.chn: （话语或讨论的话题）因点中要害而使人局促不安（或尴尬）

ex.en: Her remarks about me were embarrassingly close to home.
ex.cn: 她说我的那些话使我尴尬不已。

senses.def: to watch sb/sth carefully

ex.en: Over the next few months we will keep a close eye on sales.
ex.cn: 在今后的几个月里我们将密切关注销售情况。

senses.def: close to you in time or distance

ex.en: Help was at hand.
ex.cn: 援助近在咫尺。

ex.en: The property is ideally located with all local amenities close at hand.
ex.cn: 这处房地产的位置很理想，离当地的生活设施都近。

senses.def: having a lot of importance and interest for sb
senses.chn: 为某人所重视关心；为某人所爱

senses.def: near; not far away
senses.chn: 接近；靠近；紧挨着；不远地

ex.en: They sat close together.
ex.cn: 他们紧挨着坐在一起。

ex.en: Don't come too close!
ex.cn: 别靠得太近！

ex.en: She held Tom close and pressed her cheek to his.
ex.cn: 她紧紧地抱着汤姆，并把脸紧贴在他的脸上。

ex.en: I couldn't get close enough to see.
ex.cn: 我无法靠得很近去看清楚。

ex.en: A second police car followed close behind.
ex.cn: 第二辆警车紧紧跟在后面。

senses.def: near; in a place where sb/sth can be reached easily
senses.chn: 在附近；在触手可及的地方

ex.en: There are good cafes and a restaurant close at hand.
ex.cn: 附近有几家挺不错的咖啡馆和一家餐馆。

senses.def: at a short distance (from sb/sth)

ex.en: Our friends live close by.
ex.cn: 我们的朋友住得不远。

ex.en: The route passes close by the town.
ex.cn: 这条路离那座城镇不远。

senses.def: almost; nearly

ex.en: She is close on sixty.
ex.cn: 她快满六十岁了。

ex.en: It is close on midnight.
ex.cn: 时近午夜。

ex.en: a profit close to £200 million
ex.cn: 接近 2 亿英镑的利润

senses.def: a situation in which sb only just wins or loses, for example in a competition or an election
senses.chn: （比赛或选举等中的）险胜，差距很小的败北

senses.def: in a position very near to sth

ex.en: The picture looks very different when you see it close to.
ex.cn: 这幅画贴近看时就很不一样。

senses.def: very near in space to sb/sth

ex.en: She snuggled close up to him.
ex.cn: 她紧紧地依偎着他。

senses.def: to almost reach or do sth

ex.en: He'd come close to death.
ex.cn: 他曾与死神擦肩而过。

ex.en: We didn't win but we came close.
ex.cn: 我们输了，但离赢只差了那么一小点儿。

senses.def: to be nearly as good, fast, successful, etc. as sb/sth else

ex.en: Germany ran Argentina very close in the final.
ex.cn: 在决赛中，德国队发挥得几乎和阿根廷队一样出色。

senses.def: to keep your ideas, plans, etc. secret
to be fairly accurate in a guess, statement, etc.
senses.chn: （猜测、陈述等）接近准确，几乎无误

senses.def: to take a risk by doing sth that is dangerous or that may be illegal
senses.chn: 冒风险（干危险或可能违法的事）

senses.def: a street that is closed at one end
senses.chn: 一端不通的街道；死胡同；死巷道

ex.en: Brookside Close
ex.cn: 布鲁克赛德巷

senses.def: the grounds and buildings that surround and belong to a cathedral
senses.chn: 大教堂所属的周围场地及建筑物

senses.def: near; in a place where sb/sth can be reached easily
senses.chn: 在附近；在触手可及的地方

ex.en: There are good cafes and a restaurant close at hand.
ex.cn: 附近有几家挺不错的咖啡馆和一家餐馆。

senses.def: cut very short
shut

ex.en: Keep the door closed.
ex.cn: 让门关着吧。

senses.def: shut, especially of a shop/store or public building that is not open for a period of time
senses.chn: 关闭；（尤指一段时间）停止营业，不开放

ex.en: The museum is closed on Mondays.
ex.cn: 博物馆每逢星期一闭馆。

ex.en: This road is closed to traffic.
ex.cn: 这条道路暂停通行。

senses.def: not willing to accept outside influences or new ideas
senses.chn: 封闭的；闭关自守的；不愿接受新思想的

ex.en: a closed society
ex.cn: 闭关自守的社会

ex.en: He has a closed mind.
ex.cn: 他思想僵化守旧。

senses.def: limited to a particular group of people; not open to everyone
senses.chn: 只限于某些人的；仅为少数人的；不向公众开放的

ex.en: a closed membership
ex.cn: 只限于少数人的成员资格

senses.def: without the public being allowed to attend or know what is happening; in private
senses.chn: 与外界隔绝；秘密地；暗地里

senses.def: a subject or person that you know nothing about
senses.chn: 对之一窍不通的事物；不了解的人

senses.def: having captions that can only be read if you have a special machine (= a decoder )
senses.chn: 闭路字幕的（用解码器才能阅读）

senses.def: a television system that works within a limited area, for example a public building, to protect it from crime
when a radio or television station closes down, it stops broadcasting at the end of the day
senses.chn: （电台或电视台在一天的播送后）结束播放，停止播音

senses.def: the stopping of work, especially permanently, in an office, a factory, etc.
a factory, business, etc. in which employees must all be members of a particular trade/labor union
senses.chn: 只雇用某工会会员的工厂（或企业等）

senses.def: a syllable which ends with a consonant, for example sit
senses.chn: 闭音节（以辅音结束的音节，如 sit）

senses.def: fitting tightly, showing the shape of the body
a style of singing in harmony in which the different notes are close together
senses.chn: 密集和声（声部紧靠在一起）

senses.def: when the days close in, they become gradually shorter during the autumn/fall
if the weather closes in, it gets worse
when the night closes in, it gets darker

ex.en: They huddled around the fire as the night closed in.
ex.cn: 夜幕降临的时候，他们聚拢在炉火旁。

senses.def: to stop trading

ex.en: The factory closed its doors for the last time in 2009.
ex.cn: 这家工厂最后于 2009 年关闭。

senses.def: having strong relationships with each other and taking a close, friendly interest in each other's activities and problems
senses.chn: 紧密结合在一起的；志同道合的；意气相投的

ex.en: the close-knit community of a small village
ex.cn: 小村庄里抱团的村民

senses.def: not willing to say much about sth because you want to keep a secret
senses.chn: 守口如瓶；口紧；缄口不言

senses.def: almost; nearly

ex.en: She is close on sixty.
ex.cn: 她快满六十岁了。

ex.en: It is close on midnight.
ex.cn: 时近午夜。

ex.en: a profit close to £200 million
ex.cn: 接近 2 亿英镑的利润

senses.def: an occasion when goods are sold cheaply in order to get rid of them quickly
senses.chn: 削价销售；清仓处理；大甩卖

senses.def: at or from a short distance

ex.en: The close-range shot was blocked by the goalkeeper.
ex.cn: 那次近距离的射门被守门员截住了。

senses.def: if a group of people close ranks, they work closely together to defend themselves, especially when they are being criticized
senses.chn: （尤指受到批评时）抱团，携手合作

ex.en: It's not unusual for the police to close ranks when one of their officers is being investigated.
ex.cn: 在一位警员受到调查时，警察抱团的事并不罕见。

senses.def: if soldiers close ranks, they move closer together in order to defend themselves
won by a very small amount or distance

ex.en: The election was a close-run thing.
ex.cn: 这次选举是一次险胜。

senses.def: the time of year when it is illegal to kill particular kinds of animal, bird and fish because they are breeding
the time during the summer when teams do not play important games
very close together

ex.en: close-set eyes
ex.cn: 长得距离很近的眼睛

senses.def: a small room or a space in a wall with a door that reaches the floor, used for storing things

ex.en: a walk-in closet
ex.cn: 步入式衣帽间

senses.def: to admit sth openly that you kept secret before, especially because of shame or embarrassment
senses.chn: 公开承认秘密（尤指因耻辱或尴尬而一直保守着的秘密）；“出柜”

ex.en: Homosexuals in public life are now coming out of the closet.
ex.cn: 公众人物中的同性恋者如今逐渐公开自己的性取向。

senses.def: something shocking, embarrassing, etc. that has happened to you or your family in the past that you want to keep secret
used to describe people who want to keep some fact about themselves secret
senses.chn: 隐藏（身份等）的；不公开（个人信息）的

ex.en: closet gays
ex.cn: 不公开表明的同性恋者

ex.en: I suspect he's a closet fascist.
ex.cn: 我怀疑他是秘密的法西斯分子。

senses.def: to put sb in a room away from other people, especially so that they can talk privately with sb, or so that they can be alone
senses.chn: 把…关在房间里（尤指为了私下会谈或避免他人打扰）

ex.en: He was closeted with the President for much of the day.
ex.cn: 他与总统闭门进行了几乎一整天的密谈。

ex.en: She had closeted herself away in her room.
ex.cn: 她把自己关在房间里不见任何人。

senses.def: to stop doing sth because you no longer believe you will be successful or will find a solution
senses.chn: （因相信不会成功或没有结论而）放弃

ex.en: The police have closed the book on the case (= they have stopped trying to solve it).
ex.cn: 警方已经放弃侦破此案。

senses.def: almost; nearly

ex.en: She is close on sixty.
ex.cn: 她快满六十岁了。

ex.en: It is close on midnight.
ex.cn: 时近午夜。
