ex.cn: 女生占学生人数的 56%。

ex.en: People under the age of 40 constitute the majority of the labour force. *
ex.cn: 40 岁以下的人占劳动力的大多数。

senses.def: to form a group legally or officially

ex.en: The committee was constituted in 1974 by an Act of Parliament.
ex.cn: 该委员会是根据议会法于 1974 年设立的。

senses.def: the system of laws and basic principles that a state, a country or an organization is governed by

ex.en: your right to vote under the constitution
ex.cn: 根据宪法所拥有的选举权

ex.en: According to the constitution…
ex.cn: 依照宪法…

ex.en: to propose a new amendment to the Constitution
ex.cn: 提出一项新的宪法修正案

ex.en: the South African Constitution
ex.cn: 南非宪法

senses.def: the condition of a person's body and how healthy it is

ex.en: to have a healthy/strong/weak constitution
ex.cn: 体质健康／强壮／虚弱

senses.def: the way sth is formed or organized

ex.en: the genetic constitution of cells
ex.cn: 细胞的基因构造

senses.def: the act of forming sth

ex.en: He recommended the constitution of a review committee.
ex.cn: 他建议设立审查委员会。

senses.def: connected with the constitution of a country or an organization

ex.en: constitutional government/reform
ex.cn: 立宪政体；宪法的修改

ex.en: a constitutional amendment
ex.cn: 宪法修正案

senses.def: allowed or limited by the constitution of a country or an organization
senses.chn: 宪法准许的；受宪法限制的；受章程限制的

ex.en: They can't pass this law. It's not constitutional.
ex.cn: 他们无法通过这项法律，它不符合宪法。

ex.en: constitutional rights
ex.cn: 宪法规定的权利

ex.en: a constitutional monarchy (= a country with a king or queen whose power is controlled by a set of laws and basic principles)
ex.cn: 君主立宪国家

senses.def: related to the body's ability to stay healthy, be strong and fight illness
senses.chn: 身体素质的；体质的；体格的

ex.en: constitutional remedies
ex.cn: 体质顺势疗法

senses.def: a short walk that people take because it is good for their health
in South Africa, the highest court dealing with cases related to the constitution
senses.chn: 宪法法院（南非处理与宪法相关案件的最高法院）

senses.def: a belief in constitutional government
the fact that sth is acceptable according to a constitution

ex.en: They questioned the constitutionality of the law.
ex.cn: 他们质疑这项法律是否符合宪法。

senses.def: forming a part, often an essential part, of sth
senses.chn: 组成部分的；本质的；基本的

ex.en: Memory is constitutive of identity.
ex.cn: 记忆是身份的一个重要构成部分。

senses.def: to force sb to do sth or behave in a particular way

ex.en: The evidence was so compelling that he felt constrained to accept it.
ex.cn: 证据是那样的令人折服，他觉得不得不接受。

senses.def: to restrict or limit sb/sth

ex.en: Research has been constrained by a lack of funds.
ex.cn: 研究工作因经费不足而受限制。

ex.en: She felt constrained from continuing by the threat of losing her job.
ex.cn: 由于受到失去工作的威胁，她感到很难再坚持下去。

senses.def: not natural; forced or too controlled
senses.chn: 不自然的；强迫的；过于受约束的

ex.en: constrained emotions
ex.cn: 受压抑的情感

senses.def: a thing that limits or restricts sth, or your freedom to do sth

ex.en: constraints of time/money/space
ex.cn: 时间／资金／空间的限制

ex.en: financial/economic/legal/political constraints
ex.cn: 财政／经济／法律／政治约束

ex.en: This decision will impose serious constraints on all schools.
ex.cn: 这项决定将使所有的学校受到各种严格的限制。

ex.en: The EU has set strict limits on pollution levels.
ex.cn: 欧盟对污染程度作了严格的限定。

ex.en: the speed limit
ex.cn: 速度限制

ex.en: There are no restrictions on the amount of money you can withdraw.
ex.cn: 取款没有限额。

senses.def: strict control over the way that you behave or are allowed to behave

ex.en: At last we could relax and talk without constraint.
ex.cn: 我们终于可以放松下来，无拘无束地谈话了。

senses.def: to become tighter or narrower; to make sth tighter or narrower

ex.en: Her throat constricted and she swallowed hard.
ex.cn: 她喉咙发紧，使劲地咽了一下唾沫。

ex.en: a drug that constricts the blood vessels
ex.cn: 收缩血管的药

senses.def: to limit or restrict what sb is able to do

ex.en: Film-makers of the time were constricted by the censors.
ex.cn: 那时的电影制作人受到了审查官的限制。

ex.en: constricting rules and regulations
ex.cn: 具有约束性的规章制度

senses.def: to build or make sth such as a road, building or machine

ex.en: When was the bridge constructed?
ex.cn: 那座桥是何时修建的？

ex.en: They constructed a shelter out of fallen branches.
ex.cn: 他们用落下的枯树枝搭了个窝棚。

ex.en: a house built of stone
ex.cn: 用石头建造的房子

ex.en: They're going to build on the site of the old power station.
ex.cn: 他们要在老发电站那里盖房子。

ex.en: The cupboard is easy to assemble.
ex.cn: 这个橱柜容易组装。

ex.en: Police had to erect barriers to keep crowds back.
ex.cn: 警察只得设立路障来阻截人群。

senses.def: to form sth by putting different things together

ex.en: You must learn how to construct a logical argument.
ex.cn: 你必须学会怎样确立合乎逻辑的论点。

ex.en: to construct a theory
ex.cn: 创立一种理论

ex.en: a well-constructed novel
ex.cn: 构思巧妙的小说

senses.def: to draw a line or shape according to the rules of mathematics

ex.en: to construct a triangle
ex.cn: 画一个三角形

senses.def: an idea or a belief that is based on various pieces of evidence which are not always true
senses.chn: （根据不总是真实的各种证据得出的）构想，观念，概念

ex.en: a contrast between lived reality and the construct held in the mind
ex.cn: 现实生活与头脑所持概念之间的明显差别

senses.def: a group of words that form a phrase
a thing that is built or made
the process or method of building or making sth, especially roads, buildings, bridges, etc.

ex.en: the construction industry
ex.cn: 建筑业

ex.en: road construction
ex.cn: 道路的施工

ex.en: Work has begun on the construction of the new airport.
ex.cn: 新机场的修建已经开工。

ex.en: Our new offices are still under construction (= being built).
ex.cn: 我们的新办公楼尚在修建中。

ex.en: the construction of a new database
ex.cn: 新数据库的建立

senses.def: the way that sth has been built or made

ex.en: strong in construction
ex.cn: 结构坚固

ex.en: ships of steel construction
ex.cn: 钢结构船

ex.en: the structure of the building/human body
ex.cn: 建筑物／人体结构

ex.en: the social structure of society
ex.cn: 社会的社会结构

ex.en: the grammatical structures of a language
ex.cn: 一种语言的语法结构

ex.en: a salary structure
ex.cn: 工资结构

senses.def: a thing that has been built or made

ex.en: The summer house was a simple wooden construction.
ex.cn: 那座避暑别墅是简单的木结构建筑。

senses.def: the way in which words are used together and arranged to form a sentence, phrase, etc.

ex.en: grammatical constructions
ex.cn: 语法结构

senses.def: the creating of sth from ideas, opinions and knowledge
senses.chn: （理念、观点和知识的）创造，创立，建立

ex.en: the construction of a new theory
ex.cn: 新理论的创立

senses.def: the way in which words, actions, statements, etc. are understood by sb
senses.chn: （对词语、行为、陈述等的）解释，说明，理解

ex.en: What construction do you put on this letter (= what do you think it means)?
ex.cn: 你对这封信如何理解？

senses.def: connected with the making or building of things
thick coloured paper that people cut out to make designs, models, etc.
senses.chn: （做设计、模型等的）彩色美术纸

senses.def: having a useful and helpful effect rather than being negative or with no purpose
senses.chn: 建设性的；有助益的；积极的

ex.en: constructive criticism/suggestions/advice
ex.cn: 建设性的批评／提议／忠告

ex.en: His work involved helping hyperactive children to use their energy in a constructive way.
ex.cn: 他的工作包括帮助患有多动症的儿童建设性地利用他们的精力。

ex.en: The government is encouraging all parties to play a constructive role in the reform process.
ex.cn: 政府鼓励所有的政党在改革过程中发挥建设性的作用。

senses.def: a situation in which you are forced to leave your job because it is changed in a way that makes it impossible for you to continue doing it
senses.chn: 推定解雇，变工解雇（指通过改变工作条件而迫使雇员自动离职）

senses.def: a person or company that builds things, especially cars or aircraft
senses.chn: （尤指汽车或飞机的）建造者，制造者，建造商

senses.def: to understand the meaning of a word, a sentence or an action in a particular way

ex.en: He considered how the remark was to be construed.
ex.cn: 他考虑这话该如何理解。

ex.en: Her words could hardly be construed as an apology.
ex.cn: 她的话怎么想都不像是道歉。

senses.def: a government official who is the representative of his or her country in a foreign city

ex.en: the British consul in Miami
ex.cn: 英国驻迈阿密领事

senses.def: the building where a consul works
to go to sb for information or advice

ex.en: If the pain continues, consult your doctor.
ex.cn: 如果疼痛持续不消退，要请医生诊治。

ex.en: Have you consulted your lawyer about this?
ex.cn: 你就此事咨询过你的律师吗？

ex.en: a consulting engineer (= one who has expert knowledge and gives advice)
ex.cn: 顾问工程师

ex.en: Consult with your physician about possible treatments.
ex.cn: 向你的医生咨询可行的治疗方案。

senses.def: to discuss sth with sb to get their permission for sth, or to help you make a decision
senses.chn: （与某人）商议，商量（以得到许可或帮助决策）

ex.en: You shouldn't have done it without consulting me.
ex.cn: 你不该不和我商量就做了这件事。

ex.en: I expect to be consulted about major issues.
ex.cn: 我认为重大问题必须找我商量。

ex.en: I need to consult with my colleagues on the proposals.
ex.cn: 我需要和我的同事商讨这些建议。

ex.en: We talked on the phone for over an hour.
ex.cn: 我们在电话里谈了一个多小时。

ex.en: Have you discussed the problem with anyone?
ex.cn: 你与谁商量过这个问题吗？

ex.en: I've spoken to the manager about it.
ex.cn: 那件事我已经和经理谈过了。

senses.def: to look in or at sth to get information

ex.en: He consulted the manual.
ex.cn: 他查阅了使用说明书。

senses.def: a company that gives expert advice on a particular subject to other companies or organizations

ex.en: a management/design/computer, etc. consultancy
ex.cn: 管理／设计／计算机等咨询公司

senses.def: expert advice that a company or person is paid to provide on a particular subject

ex.en: consultancy fees
ex.cn: 咨询费

senses.def: a person who knows a lot about a particular subject and is employed to give advice about it to other people

ex.en: a firm of management consultants
ex.cn: 管理咨询公司

ex.en: the President's consultant on economic affairs
ex.cn: 总统的经济事务顾问

senses.def: a hospital doctor of the highest rank who is a specialist in a particular area of medicine
senses.chn: 高级顾问医师；会诊医师

ex.en: a consultant in obstetrics
ex.cn: 产科顾问医师

ex.en: a consultant surgeon
ex.cn: 外科顾问医师

senses.def: the act of discussing sth with sb or with a group of people before making a decision about it

ex.en: a consultation document/paper/period/process
ex.cn: 咨询文件／论文／期／过程

ex.en: acting in consultation with all the departments involved
ex.cn: 和所有有关部门磋商后行事

ex.en: The decision was taken after close consultation with local residents.
ex.cn: 这项决定是在与当地居民仔细磋商后作出的。

ex.en: Discussions are still taking place between the two leaders.
ex.cn: 两位领导人仍在进行讨论。

ex.en: a telephone conversation
ex.cn: 电话交谈

ex.en: The novel has long descriptions and not much dialogue.
ex.cn: 这部小说描述多，对话少。

senses.def: a formal meeting to discuss sth

ex.en: extensive consultations between the two countries
ex.cn: 两国之间的广泛磋商

ex.en: Discussions are still taking place between the two leaders.
ex.cn: 两位领导人仍在进行讨论。

ex.en: a telephone conversation
ex.cn: 电话交谈

ex.en: The novel has long descriptions and not much dialogue.
ex.cn: 这部小说描述多，对话少。

ex.en: The President told waiting reporters there had been a constructive dialogue.
ex.cn: 总统告诉等候的记者，刚才进行了一次富有建设性的对话。

ex.en: I had a long talk with my boss about my career prospects.
ex.cn: 我和老板就我的事业前景进行了一次长谈。

senses.def: a meeting with an expert, especially a doctor, to get advice or treatment
senses.chn: （向专家请教的）咨询会；（尤指）就诊

ex.en: a job interview
ex.cn: 求职面试

ex.en: He confessed after four days under interrogation.
ex.cn: 他在受讯问四天之后招认了。

ex.en: The Pope granted her a private audience.
ex.cn: 教皇同意私下接见她。

senses.def: the act of looking for information in a book, etc.

ex.en: There is a large collection of texts available for consultation on-screen.
ex.cn: 有大量的文本可通过电脑查阅。

senses.def: giving advice or making suggestions

ex.en: a consultative committee/body/document
ex.cn: 咨询委员会／机构／文件

senses.def: a room where a doctor talks to and examines patients
intended to be bought, used and then replaced

ex.en: consumable electronic goods
ex.cn: 电子消费品

senses.def: goods that are intended to be used fairly quickly and then replaced

ex.en: computer consumables such as CD-Rs and printer cartridges
ex.cn: 可录光盘、打印机墨盒之类的电脑耗材

senses.def: to use sth, especially fuel, energy or time
senses.chn: 消耗，耗费（尤指燃料、能量或时间）

ex.en: The electricity industry consumes large amounts of fossil fuels.
ex.cn: 电力工业消耗大量的化石燃料。

senses.def: to eat or drink sth

ex.en: Before he died he had consumed a large quantity of alcohol.
ex.cn: 他死亡前喝了大量的酒。

senses.def: to fill sb with a strong feeling

ex.en: Carolyn was consumed with guilt.
ex.cn: 卡罗琳深感内疚。

ex.en: Rage consumed him.
ex.cn: 他无比愤怒。

senses.def: to completely destroy sth

ex.en: The hotel was quickly consumed by fire.
ex.cn: 那座旅馆很快被大火吞噬。

senses.def: a person who buys goods or uses services

ex.en: consumer demand/choice/rights
ex.cn: 消费者的需求／选择／权利

ex.en: Health-conscious consumers want more information about the food they buy.
ex.cn: 注重身体健康的消费者想得到更多有关他们所购买的食物的信息。

ex.en: a consumer society (= one where buying and selling is considered to be very important)
ex.cn: 消费社会

ex.en: Tax cuts will boost consumer confidence after the recession.
ex.cn: 减税将增强消费者在经济衰退后的信心。

senses.def: goods which are expected to last for a long time after they have been bought, such as cars, televisions, etc.
senses.chn: 耐用消费品（如汽车、电视机等）

senses.def: goods such as food, clothing, etc. bought by individual customers
the buying and using of goods and services; the belief that it is good for a society or an individual person to buy and use a large quantity of goods and services
senses.chn: 消费；消费主义（认为高消费对社会和个人有利）

senses.def: a list of the prices of some ordinary goods and services which shows how much these prices change each month
senses.chn: 居民消费价格指数；消费价格指数

senses.def: so strong or important that it takes up all your time and energy
senses.chn: 强烈的；重要的；令人着迷的

ex.en: Basketball is his consuming passion.
ex.cn: 篮球令他着迷。

senses.def: extremely skilled; perfect

ex.en: She was a consummate performer.
ex.cn: 她是个技艺非凡的表演者。

ex.en: He played the shot with consummate skill.
ex.cn: 他以高超的技巧投球进篮。

ex.en: a consummate liar
ex.cn: 撒谎高手

senses.def: to make a marriage or a relationship complete by having sex
senses.chn: （初次）行房；通过性交使（婚姻或两人的关系）圆满

ex.en: The marriage lasted only a week and was never consummated.
ex.cn: 那段婚姻仅维持了一星期，期间从未行房。

senses.def: to make sth complete or perfect
the act of making a marriage or relationship complete by having sex
senses.chn: （初次）行房；通过性交使婚姻或两人关系圆满

senses.def: the fact of making sth complete or perfect

ex.en: The paintings are the consummation of his life's work.
ex.cn: 这些画是他毕生努力的完美结晶。

senses.def: the act of using energy, food or materials; the amount used
senses.chn: （能量、食物或材料的）消耗，消耗量

ex.en: the production of fuel for domestic consumption (= to be used in the country where it is produced)
ex.cn: 供国内消耗的燃料生产

ex.en: Gas and oil consumption always increases in cold weather.
ex.cn: 燃气和燃油的消耗量在天冷时总会增加。

ex.en: The meat was declared unfit for human consumption.
ex.cn: 这种肉被宣布不适于人食用。

ex.en: He was advised to reduce his alcohol consumption.
ex.cn: 他被劝告减少饮酒。

ex.en: Her speech to party members was not intended for public consumption (= to be heard by the public).
ex.cn: 她对党员发表的讲话并不打算公诸大众。

senses.def: the act of buying and using products

ex.en: Consumption rather than saving has become the central feature of contemporary societies.
ex.cn: 现代社会的主要特征是消费而不是储蓄。

senses.def: a serious infectious disease of the lungs
a person who suffers from consumption (= a disease of the lungs)
the act of communicating with sb, especially regularly

ex.en: I don't have much contact with my uncle.
ex.cn: 我和叔父甚少联系。

ex.en: There is little contact between the two organizations.
ex.cn: 这两个机构相互之间没有什么联系。

ex.en: Have you kept in contact with any of your friends from college (= do you still see them or speak or write to them)?
ex.cn: 你和你大学里的朋友还保持联系吗？

ex.en: She's lost contact with (= no longer sees or writes to) her son.
ex.cn: 她和儿子失去了联系。

ex.en: I finally made contact with (= succeeded in speaking to or meeting) her in Paris.
ex.cn: 我最终在巴黎与她取得了联系。

ex.en: The organization put me in contact with other people in a similar position (= gave me their addresses or telephone numbers).
ex.cn: 这家机构为我提供了其他和我情况相似的人的联系方法。

senses.def: the state of touching sth

ex.en: His fingers were briefly in contact with the ball.
ex.cn: 他的手指稍稍地碰了一下球。

ex.en: This substance should not come into contact with food.
ex.cn: 这种物质切莫与食物接触。

ex.en: a fear of physical contact
ex.cn: 对身体接触的恐惧感

ex.en: This pesticide kills insects on contact (= as soon as it touches them).
ex.cn: 这种杀虫剂昆虫一触即死。

senses.def: the state of meeting sb or having to deal with sth
senses.chn: 遇见（某人）；碰上（要处理的事）

ex.en: In her job she often comes into contact with (= meets) lawyers.
ex.cn: 她在工作中常与律师接触。

ex.en: Children should be brought into contact with poetry at an early age.
ex.cn: 儿童应该在幼年就接触诗歌。

senses.def: an occasion on which you meet or communicate with sb; a relationship with sb

ex.en: We have good contacts with the local community.
ex.cn: 我们与当地社区关系甚好。

ex.en: The company has maintained trade contacts with India.
ex.cn: 这家公司和印度一直保持着贸易往来。

senses.def: a person that you know, especially sb who can be helpful to you in your work

ex.en: social/personal contacts
ex.cn: 社会上的／私下的熟人

ex.en: I've made some useful contacts in journalism.
ex.cn: 我在新闻界结交了一些有用的人。

senses.def: an electrical connection

ex.en: The switches close the contacts and complete the circuit.
ex.cn: 这些开关可接通形成闭合电路。

senses.def: a person who may be infectious because he or she has recently been near to sb with a contagious disease
a place where you go or a person that you speak to when you are dealing with an organization

ex.en: The receptionist is the first point of contact most people have with the clinic.
ex.cn: 多数人与诊所接触的第一个人是接待员。

senses.def: to communicate with sb, for example by telephone or letter
senses.chn: 联系，联络（如用电话或信件）

ex.en: I've been trying to contact you all day.
ex.cn: 我一整天都在设法与你联系。

senses.def: a small round piece of thin plastic that you put on your eye to help you see better

ex.en: to wear contact lenses
ex.cn: 戴隐形眼镜

senses.def: relating to the technology that allows a smart card (= a small plastic card used to store information electronically), mobile/cell phone, etc. to contact an electronic device that it is not connected to, usually in order to make a payment
senses.chn: 无触点感应的；非接触式（技术）的

ex.en: contactless cards
ex.cn: 非接触式卡

ex.en: a contactless payment
ex.cn: 一笔非接触式支付款项

senses.def: a sport in which players have physical contact with each other
senses.chn: 接触式运动（运动员之间有身体接触）

senses.def: the spreading of a disease by people touching each other

ex.en: There is no risk of contagion.
ex.cn: 没有接触传染的风险。

senses.def: a disease that can be spread by people touching each other
something bad that spreads quickly by being passed from person to person
senses.chn: （不良事物的快速）传播，蔓延，扩散

senses.def: a contagious disease spreads by people touching each other

ex.en: Scarlet fever is highly contagious.
ex.cn: 猩红热的接触传染性很强。

ex.en: His enthusiasm was contagious (= spread quickly to other people).
ex.cn: 他的热情富有感染力。

ex.en: a contagious laugh
ex.cn: 有感染力的笑声

senses.def: if a person is contagious, they have a disease that can be spread to other people by touch
if sth contains sth else, it has that thing inside it or as part of it

ex.en: This drink doesn't contain any alcohol.
ex.cn: 这种饮料不含任何酒精。

ex.en: Her statement contained one or two inaccuracies.
ex.cn: 她的陈述有一两处不准确。

ex.en: a brown envelope containing dollar bills
ex.cn: 装有钞票的棕色信封

ex.en: The bottle contains (= can hold) two litres.
ex.cn: 此瓶容量为两升。

senses.def: to keep your feelings under control

ex.en: She was unable to contain her excitement.
ex.cn: 她无法抑制内心的激动。

ex.en: I was so furious I just couldn't contain myself (= I had to express my feelings).
ex.cn: 我气愤极了，简直无法克制自己。

senses.def: to prevent sth harmful from spreading or getting worse

ex.en: to contain an epidemic
ex.cn: 防止流行病的蔓延

ex.en: Government forces have failed to contain the rebellion.
ex.cn: 政府军未能遏止叛乱。

senses.def: a box, bottle, etc. in which sth can be stored or transported

ex.en: Food will last longer if kept in an airtight container.
ex.cn: 如果贮藏在密封的容器里，食物能保存比较久的时间。

senses.def: a large metal or wooden box of a standard size in which goods are packed so that they can easily be lifted onto a ship, train, etc. to be transported

ex.en: a container ship (= one designed to transport such containers)
ex.cn: 集装箱船

senses.def: packed and transported in containers
senses.chn: 封装运输的；集装箱装运的；货柜装运的

ex.en: containerized cargo
ex.cn: 集装箱载运的货物

senses.def: the act of keeping sth under control so that it cannot spread in a harmful way

ex.en: the containment of the epidemic
ex.cn: 对流行病的控制

senses.def: the act of keeping another country's power within limits so that it does not become too powerful

ex.en: a policy of containment
ex.cn: 遏制政策

senses.def: a substance that makes sth impure

ex.en: Filters do not remove all contaminants from water.
ex.cn: 过滤器无法过滤掉水中的所有污染物。

senses.def: to make a substance or place dirty or no longer pure by adding a substance that is dangerous or carries disease

ex.en: The drinking water has become contaminated with lead.
ex.cn: 饮用水被铅污染了。

ex.en: contaminated blood/food/soil
ex.cn: 受到污染的血液／食物／土壤

senses.def: to influence people's ideas or attitudes in a bad way
senses.chn: 玷污，毒害，腐蚀（人的思想或品德）

ex.en: They were accused of contaminating the minds of our young people.
ex.cn: 他们被指控毒害我们青少年的心灵。

senses.def: to think about whether you should do sth, or how you should do sth

ex.en: You're too young to be contemplating retirement.
ex.cn: 你考虑退休还太年轻。

ex.en: I have never contemplated living abroad.
ex.cn: 我从未考虑过去国外居住。

ex.en: He continued while she contemplated how to answer.
ex.cn: 她还在考虑如何回答时，他就继续往下说了。

senses.def: to think carefully about and accept the possibility of sth happening
senses.chn: 考虑接受（发生某事的可能性）

ex.en: The thought of war is too awful to contemplate.
ex.cn: 战争太可怕了，真不敢去想。

ex.en: I can't contemplate what it would be like to be alone.
ex.cn: 我不能想象独自一人会是个什么样子。

ex.en: She contemplated that things might get even worse.
ex.cn: 她想到事情可能会变得更糟。

senses.def: to think deeply about sth for a long time
senses.chn: 深思熟虑；沉思；苦思冥想

ex.en: to contemplate your future
ex.cn: 仔细盘算未来

ex.en: She lay in bed, contemplating.
ex.cn: 她躺在床上冥思苦想。

senses.def: to look at sb/sth in a careful way for a long time

ex.en: She contemplated him in silence.
ex.cn: 她默默地注视着他。

senses.def: the act of thinking deeply about sth

ex.en: He sat there deep in contemplation.
ex.cn: 他坐在那里沉思着。

ex.en: a few moments of quiet contemplation
ex.cn: 默默沉思的片刻

ex.en: a life of prayer and contemplation
ex.cn: 祈祷与冥思的生活

senses.def: the act of looking at sth in a calm and careful way

ex.en: She turned from her contemplation of the photograph.
ex.cn: 她从凝视着的那张照片上移开目光。

senses.def: being considered

ex.en: By 1613 even more desperate measures were in contemplation.
ex.cn: 到 1613 年，甚至考虑要采取更为孤注一掷的措施。

senses.def: thinking quietly and seriously about sth
senses.chn: 沉思默想的；深思熟虑的

ex.en: She was in contemplative mood.
ex.cn: 她陷入沉思之中。

senses.def: spending time thinking deeply about religious matters
senses.chn: （对宗教问题）冥想的，敛心默祷的

ex.en: the contemplative life (= life in a religious community)
ex.cn: 宗教上的默观生活

senses.def: happening or existing at the same time
senses.chn: 同时发生（或存在）的；同时期的；同时代的

ex.en: How do we know that the signature is contemporaneous with the document?
ex.cn: 我们怎样才能知道这个签字和文件是同一个时间的呢？

ex.en: contemporaneous events/accounts
ex.cn: 同一时期的事情／记述

senses.def: belonging to the same time
senses.chn: 属同时期的；同一时代的

ex.en: We have no contemporary account of the battle (= written near the time that it happened).
ex.cn: 我们没有当时人们对这一战役的记载。

ex.en: He was contemporary with the dramatist Congreve.
ex.cn: 他与剧作家康格里夫属于同一时代。

senses.def: belonging to the present time

ex.en: life in contemporary Britain
ex.cn: 当代英国的生活

ex.en: contemporary fiction/music/dance
ex.cn: 当代小说／音乐／舞蹈

senses.def: a person who lives or lived at the same time as sb else, especially sb who is about the same age

ex.en: She and I were contemporaries at college.
ex.cn: 她和我在大学是同学。

ex.en: He was a contemporary of Freud and may have known him.
ex.cn: 他是弗洛伊德的同代人，可能认识弗洛伊德。

senses.def: the feeling that sb/sth is without value and deserves no respect at all

ex.en: She looked at him with contempt.
ex.cn: 她轻蔑地看着他。

ex.en: I shall treat that suggestion with the contempt it deserves.
ex.cn: 我对那项建议当然会不屑一顾。

ex.en: His treatment of his children is beneath contempt (= so unacceptable that it is not even worth feeling contempt for).
ex.cn: 他对待自己子女的那种行径为人所不齿。

ex.en: Politicians seem to be generally held in contempt by ordinary people.
ex.cn: 一般百姓似乎普遍看不起从政者。

ex.en: They had shown a contempt for the values she thought important.
ex.cn: 他们对她所认为重要的价值表示蔑视。

senses.def: a lack of worry or fear about rules, danger, etc.

ex.en: The firefighters showed a contempt for their own safety.
ex.cn: 那些消防队员已把他们自己的安全置之度外。

ex.en: His remarks betray a staggering contempt for the truth (= are completely false).
ex.cn: 他的话表明他完全无视事情的真相。

senses.def: knowing sb/sth very well may cause you to lose admiration and respect for them/it
senses.chn: 过分亲密就会有所侮慢

senses.def: not deserving any respect at all
senses.chn: 可轻蔑的；可鄙的；卑劣的

ex.en: contemptible behaviour
ex.cn: 卑劣的行为

senses.def: the crime of refusing to obey an order made by a court; not showing respect for a court or judge

ex.en: Any person who disregards this order will be in contempt of court.
ex.cn: 凡漠视本法令者将被判藐视法庭罪。

senses.def: feeling or showing that you have no respect for sb/sth
senses.chn: 蔑视的；鄙视的；表示轻蔑的

ex.en: She gave him a contemptuous look.
ex.cn: 她鄙夷地看了他一眼。

ex.en: He was contemptuous of everything I did.
ex.cn: 他对我所做的一切都不屑一顾。

senses.def: to say that sth is true, especially in an argument
senses.chn: （尤指在争论中）声称，主张，认为

ex.en: I would contend that the minister's thinking is flawed on this point.
ex.cn: 我倒认为部长的想法在这一点上有漏洞。

senses.def: to compete against sb in order to gain sth

ex.en: Three armed groups were contending for power.
ex.cn: 三个武装集团在争夺权力。

senses.def: to have to deal with a problem or with a difficult situation or person

ex.en: Nurses often have to contend with violent or drunken patients.
ex.cn: 护士经常不得不应付粗暴的或喝醉酒的病人。

senses.def: a person who takes part in a competition or tries to win sth

ex.en: a contender for a gold medal in the Olympics
ex.cn: 奥运金牌的争夺者

ex.en: a leading/serious/strong contender for the party leadership
ex.cn: 该党领导权最重要的／强劲的／有实力的角逐者

senses.def: the things that are contained in sth
senses.chn: 所容纳之物；所含之物；内容

ex.en: He tipped the contents of the bag onto the table.
ex.cn: 他把提包里的东西倒在桌子上。

ex.en: Fire has caused severe damage to the contents of the building.
ex.cn: 大火导致那栋大楼里的东西严重损毁。

ex.en: She hadn't read the letter and so was unaware of its contents.
ex.cn: 她没有看过那封信，所以对其内容一无所知。

senses.def: the different sections that are contained in a book

ex.en: a table of contents (= the list at the front of a book)
ex.cn: 目录

ex.en: a contents page
ex.cn: 目录页

senses.def: the subject matter of a book, speech, programme, etc.
senses.chn: （书、讲话、节目等的）主题，主要内容

ex.en: Your tone of voice is as important as the content of what you have to say.
ex.cn: 你的讲话声调和你要讲的内容同样重要。

ex.en: The content of the course depends on what the students would like to study.
ex.cn: 课程的内容取决于学生愿意学什么。

ex.en: Her poetry has a good deal of political content.
ex.cn: 她的诗歌包含大量的政治内容。

senses.def: the amount of a substance that is contained in sth else

ex.en: food with a high fat content
ex.cn: 脂肪含量高的食物

ex.en: the alcohol content of a drink
ex.cn: 饮料的酒精含量

senses.def: the information or other material contained on a website or other digital media
senses.chn: （网站或其他数字媒介上的）内容

ex.en: online content providers
ex.cn: 网络内容提供商

senses.def: happy and satisfied with what you have

ex.en: Not content with stealing my boyfriend (= not thinking that this was enough), she has turned all my friends against me.
ex.cn: 她偷走了我的男朋友还不满足，又挑起我所有的朋友和我作对。

ex.en: He seemed more content, less bitter.
ex.cn: 他看起来比较满意，不那么愤愤不平。

ex.en: He had to be content with third place.
ex.cn: 他只好屈居第三名。

ex.en: a happy marriage/memory/childhood
ex.cn: 幸福的婚姻／回忆／童年

ex.en: I said I'd go, just to keep him happy.
ex.cn: 我说我要去只是为了让他高兴。

ex.en: She's never satisfied with what she's got.
ex.cn: 她对自己所得到的从不感到满足。

senses.def: willing to do sth

ex.en: I was content to wait.
ex.cn: 我愿意等候。

senses.def: to accept and be satisfied with sth and not try to have or do sth better

ex.en: Martina contented herself with a bowl of soup.
ex.cn: 马丁娜喝了一碗汤就心满意足了。

senses.def: to make sb feel happy or satisfied

ex.en: My apology seemed to content him.
ex.cn: 我的道歉好像使他感到满意。

senses.def: as much as you want

ex.en: a supervised play area where children can run around to their heart's content
ex.cn: 一处能让孩子们尽情游玩且有人看管的地方

senses.def: showing or feeling happiness or satisfaction, especially because your life is good
senses.chn: （尤指因生活好而）满意的，惬意的，满足的

ex.en: a contented smile
ex.cn: 惬意的微笑

ex.en: He was a contented man.
ex.cn: 他是个心满意足的人。

ex.en: a happy marriage/memory/childhood
ex.cn: 幸福的婚姻／回忆／童年

ex.en: I said I'd go, just to keep him happy.
ex.cn: 我说我要去只是为了让他高兴。

ex.en: She's never satisfied with what she's got.
ex.cn: 她对自己所得到的从不感到满足。

ex.en: a satisfied smile
ex.cn: 满意的微笑

senses.def: a website that includes a large quantity of material, which may be of low quality or taken from other sources, but which enables the site to appear high on the list of results given by a search engine
senses.chn: 内容农场，文字工厂（资料繁杂的网站，其内容或许低质或许东拼西凑，但在搜索引擎的结果列表上排位靠前）

senses.def: angry disagreement between people

ex.en: One area of contention is the availability of nursery care.
ex.cn: 争论的一个方面是提供幼儿照顾的问题。

ex.en: a point of contention
ex.cn: 争论点

senses.def: a belief or an opinion that you express, especially in an argument

ex.en: It is our client's contention that the fire was an accident.
ex.cn: 我们当事人的看法是这场火灾属于意外事故。

ex.en: I would reject that contention.
ex.cn: 我不会同意那种观点。

senses.def: with a chance of winning sth

ex.en: Only three teams are now in contention for the title.
ex.cn: 现在只有三个队有机会夺冠。

senses.def: without a chance of winning sth
a subject which causes disagreement and arguments between people
likely to cause disagreement between people

ex.en: a contentious issue/topic/subject
ex.cn: 有争议的问题／话题／主题

ex.en: Both views are highly contentious.
ex.cn: 两种观点都很有争议。

senses.def: liking to argue; involving a lot of arguing

ex.en: a contentious meeting
ex.cn: 争论不休的会议

senses.def: a feeling of happiness or satisfaction

ex.en: He has found contentment at last.
ex.cn: 他最终得到了满足。

ex.en: a sigh of contentment
ex.cn: 满足地舒一口气

ex.en: He derived great satisfaction from knowing that his son was happy.
ex.cn: 得知儿子很幸福他深感欣慰。

ex.en: Money can't buy you happiness.
ex.cn: 金钱不能为你买到幸福。

ex.en: The sight of her son graduating filled her with pride.
ex.cn: 儿子毕业的情景让她充满了自豪。

ex.en: They found contentment in living a simple life.
ex.cn: 他们在简朴的生活中得到满足。

senses.def: an organization that supplies information that can be used on a website
senses.chn: （互联网）内容提供者，内容供应商

senses.def: a noun, a verb, an adjective or an adverb whose main function is to express meaning
a competition in which people try to win sth

ex.en: a singing contest
ex.cn: 歌咏比赛

ex.en: a talent contest
ex.cn: 新秀大奖赛

ex.en: to enter/win/lose a contest
ex.cn: 参加／赢得竞赛；竞赛失败

senses.def: a struggle to gain control or power

ex.en: a contest for the leadership of the party
ex.cn: 争夺政党的领导权

senses.def: used to say that one side in a competition is so much stronger or better than the other that it is sure to win easily
senses.chn: （表示竞争中的一方过于强大或出色）完全不是对手，毫无竞争可言

senses.def: to take part in a competition, election, etc. and try to win it

ex.en: Three candidates contested the leadership.
ex.cn: 有三位候选人角逐领导权。

ex.en: a hotly/fiercely/keenly contested game (= one in which the players try very hard to win and the scores are close)
ex.cn: 竞争十分激烈的比赛

senses.def: to formally oppose a decision or statement because you think it is wrong

ex.en: to contest a will (= try to show that it was not correctly made in law)
ex.cn: 对遗嘱提出质疑

ex.en: The divorce was not contested.
ex.cn: 这桩离婚案没有人提出异议。

senses.def: a person who takes part in a contest

ex.en: Please welcome our next contestant.
ex.cn: 请欢迎我们的下一位竞赛选手。

senses.def: the situation in which sth happens and that helps you to understand it
senses.chn: （事情发生的）背景，环境，来龙去脉

ex.en: This speech needs to be set in the context of Britain in the 1960s.
ex.cn: 这篇演说需要放到 20 世纪 60 年代的英国这一背景之下来看待。

ex.en: His decision can only be understood in context.
ex.cn: 只有了解来龙去脉才能明白他的决定。

senses.def: the words that come just before and after a word, phrase or statement and help you to understand its meaning

ex.en: You should be able to guess the meaning of the word from the context.
ex.cn: 你应该能从上下文猜出这个词的含义。

ex.en: This quotation has been taken out of context (= repeated without referring to the rest of the text).
ex.cn: 这条引文断章取义。

senses.def: connected with a particular context
senses.chn: 上下文的；与上下文有关的；与语境相关的

ex.en: contextual information
ex.cn: 与上下文有关的信息

ex.en: contextual clues to the meaning
ex.cn: 上下文提供的理解其含义的线索

senses.def: to consider sth in relation to the situation in which it happens or exists
senses.chn: 将…置于背景中考虑；将…置于上下文中理解

senses.def: touching or next to sth

ex.en: The countries are contiguous.
ex.cn: 这些国家互相接壤。

ex.en: The bruising was not contiguous to the wound.
ex.cn: 这青肿块不在伤口边上。

senses.def: the control of your feelings, especially your desire to have sex
senses.chn: （感情的）节制，自制；（尤指）性欲的节制

senses.def: the ability to control the bladder and bowels
one of the large land masses of the earth such as Europe, Asia or Africa

ex.en: the continent of Africa
ex.cn: 非洲大陆

ex.en: the African continent
ex.cn: 非洲大陆

senses.def: the main part of the continent of Europe, not including Britain or Ireland
senses.chn: 欧洲大陆（不包括英国和爱尔兰）

ex.en: We're going to spend a weekend on the Continent.
ex.cn: 我们要去欧洲大陆度周末。

senses.def: of or in the continent of Europe, not including Britain and Ireland
senses.chn: 欧洲大陆的（不包括英国和爱尔兰）

ex.en: a popular continental holiday resort
ex.cn: 受欢迎的欧洲大陆度假胜地

ex.en: Britain's continental neighbours
ex.cn: 英国的欧洲大陆邻国

senses.def: following the customs of countries in western and southern Europe
senses.chn: 随（西、南欧国家）大陆风俗的

ex.en: a continental lifestyle
ex.cn: 西、南欧大陆的生活方式

ex.en: The shutters and the balconies make the street look almost continental.
ex.cn: 活动护窗和阳台使这条街看起来颇具欧洲大陆风格。

senses.def: connected with the main part of the N American continent

ex.en: Prices are often higher in Hawaii than in the continental United States.
ex.cn: 夏威夷的物价常常比美国大陆高。

senses.def: forming part of, or typical of, any of the seven main land masses of the earth

ex.en: continental Antarctica/Asia/Europe
ex.cn: 南极洲／亚洲／欧洲大陆

ex.en: to study continental geography
ex.cn: 研究大陆地理学

senses.def: a person who lives in the continent of Europe

ex.en: The continentals have never understood our preference for warm beer.
ex.cn: 欧洲大陆人根本不理解我们为什么喜欢喝温啤酒。

senses.def: a light breakfast, usually consisting of coffee and bread rolls with butter and jam
senses.chn: 欧陆式早餐，简易早餐（通常包括咖啡和黄油果酱圆面包）

senses.def: a fairly dry pattern of weather with very hot summers and very cold winters, that is typical of the central regions of the US, Canada and Russia, for example
the slow movement of the continents towards and away from each other during the history of the earth
the area of land on the edge of a continent that slopes into the ocean
the steep surface that goes down from the outer edge of the continental shelf to the ocean floor
an event that may or may not happen
senses.chn: 可能发生的事；偶发（或不测、意外）事件

ex.en: We must consider all possible contingencies.
ex.cn: 我们必须考虑一切可能发生的事。

ex.en: to make contingency plans (= plans for what to do if a particular event happens or does not happen)
ex.cn: 拟订应变计划

ex.en: a contingency fund (= to pay for sth that might happen in the future)
ex.cn: 意外开支准备金

senses.def: (in the US) an amount of money that is paid to a lawyer only if the person he or she is advising wins in court
senses.chn: （美国）成功酬金（胜诉才付给律师）

senses.def: a group of people at a meeting or an event who have sth in common, especially the place they come from, that is not shared by other people at the event
senses.chn: （志趣相投、尤指来自同一地方的）一组与会者，代表团

ex.en: The largest contingent was from the United States.
ex.cn: 最大的会议代表团来自美国。

ex.en: A strong contingent of local residents were there to block the proposal.
ex.cn: 由当地居民组成的强大的代表团在那里阻止通过这项提案。

senses.def: a group of soldiers that are part of a larger force

ex.en: the French contingent in the UN peacekeeping force
ex.cn: 联合国维和部队的法国分队

senses.def: depending on sth that may or may not happen

ex.en: All payments are contingent upon satisfactory completion dates.
ex.cn: 所有的付款须视是否如期完成。

senses.def: a person, or work done by a person, who does not have a permanent contract with a company

ex.en: the spread of contingent work throughout the economy
ex.cn: 临时工作在整个经济领域的扩展

senses.def: repeated many times in a way that is annoying
senses.chn: （令人厌烦地）多次重复的，频繁的

ex.en: continual complaints/interruptions
ex.cn: 反复的抱怨／打搅

senses.def: continuing without interruption
senses.chn: 接连不断的；连续的；频频的

ex.en: He was in a continual process of rewriting his material.
ex.cn: 他一直在不断地改写他的材料。

ex.en: We lived in continual fear of being discovered.
ex.cn: 我们长期生活在害怕被发现的恐惧中。

ex.en: Her daughter was a continual source of delight to her.
ex.cn: 她的女儿是她无限快乐的源泉。

senses.def: the state of continuing to exist or function

ex.en: We can no longer support the President's continuance in office.
ex.cn: 我们不能再支持总统继续任职。

senses.def: a decision that a court case should be heard later

ex.en: The judge refused his motion for a continuance.
ex.cn: 法官拒绝他要求延期审理的动议。

senses.def: a consonant that is pronounced with the breath passing through the throat, so that the sound can be continued. /f/ , /l/ and /m/ are examples of continuants.
an act or the state of continuing

ex.en: They are anxious to ensure the continuation of the economic reform programme.
ex.cn: 他们渴望确保经济改革计划持续下去。

ex.en: This year saw a continuation in the upward trend in sales.
ex.cn: 今年销售呈持续增长的趋势。

senses.def: something that continues or follows sth else

ex.en: Her new book is a continuation of her autobiography.
ex.cn: 她的新书是她自传的续篇。

senses.def: something that is joined on to sth else and forms a part of it

ex.en: There are plans to build a continuation of the bypass next year.
ex.cn: 已有计划明年修建这条支路的延长线。

senses.def: to keep existing or happening without stopping
senses.chn: 持续；继续存在；不断发生

ex.en: The exhibition continues until 25 July.
ex.cn: 展览举行至 7 月 25 日为止。

ex.en: The trial is expected to continue for three months.
ex.cn: 预计审判要持续三个月。

ex.en: The rain continued to fall all afternoon.
ex.cn: 这场雨整整一下午都下个不停。

ex.en: The rain continued falling all afternoon.
ex.cn: 这场雨整整一下午都下个不停。

senses.def: to keep doing sth without stopping

ex.en: She wanted to continue working until she was 60.
ex.cn: 她想要继续工作到 60 岁。

ex.en: He continued to ignore everything I was saying.
ex.cn: 他仍对我所说的一切置若罔闻。

ex.en: Are you going to continue with the project?
ex.cn: 你要继续做这个项目吗？

ex.en: The board of inquiry is continuing its investigations.
ex.cn: 调查委员会在继续做调查。

senses.def: to go or move further in the same direction

ex.en: The path continued over rough, rocky ground.
ex.cn: 这条小路穿过了崎岖不平的石头地。

ex.en: He continued on his way.
ex.cn: 他继续走他的路。

senses.def: to remain in a particular job or condition

ex.en: I want you to continue as project manager.
ex.cn: 我要你留任项目经理。

ex.en: She will continue in her present job until a replacement can be found.
ex.cn: 在找到替换人员以前，她将继续做她目前的工作。

senses.def: to start or start sth again after stopping for a time

ex.en: The story continues in our next issue.
ex.cn: 这篇故事我们将在下一期里继续刊载。

ex.en: The story will be continued in our next issue.
ex.cn: 这篇故事我们将在下一期里继续刊载。

senses.def: to start speaking again after stopping

ex.en: Please continue—I didn't mean to interrupt.
ex.cn: 请继续往下说，我并非有意打断你的话。

ex.en: 'In fact,' he continued, 'I'd like to congratulate you.'
ex.cn: “其实，” 他接着说，“我想向你表示祝贺。”

senses.def: existing in the same state without change or interruption
senses.chn: 继续不变的；连续不断的

ex.en: We are grateful for your continued/continuing support.
ex.cn: 我们对你们始终不渝的支持不胜感激。

ex.en: continued interest
ex.cn: 持久的兴趣

ex.en: continuing involvement
ex.cn: 不断的参与

senses.def: the fact of not stopping or not changing

ex.en: to ensure/provide/maintain continuity of fuel supplies
ex.cn: 确保／提供／保持燃料供给的连续性

senses.def: a logical connection between the parts of sth, or between two things

ex.en: The novel fails to achieve narrative continuity.
ex.cn: 这部小说叙述不连贯。

ex.en: There are obvious continuities between diet and health.
ex.cn: 日常饮食与健康之间有着明显的逻辑关联。

senses.def: the organization of a film/movie or television programme, especially making sure that people's clothes, objects, etc. are the same from one scene to the next
senses.chn: （电影或电视节目场景中服装、物体等的）一致性，衔接

senses.def: a musical part played to accompany another instrument, in which a line of low notes is shown with figures to represent the higher notes to be played above them

ex.en: a trio for two violins and continuo
ex.cn: 两小提琴与通奏低音的三声中部

senses.def: happening or existing for a period of time without interruption

ex.en: She was in continuous employment until the age of sixty-five.
ex.cn: 她一直工作到 65 岁。

ex.en: The rain has been continuous since this morning.
ex.cn: 从早上到现在这雨就没停过。

senses.def: spreading in a line or over an area without any spaces

ex.en: a continuous line of traffic
ex.cn: 络绎不绝的车辆

senses.def: repeated many times

ex.en: For four days the town suffered continuous attacks.
ex.cn: 那座城镇连续四天遭到了袭击。

ex.en: Life was a continual struggle for them.
ex.cn: 生活对他们来说就是不断的挣扎。

senses.def: a system of giving a student a final mark/grade based on work done during a course of study rather than on one exam
senses.chn: 连续性评定（学生的最后成绩不是根据一次考试而是根据课程作业）

senses.def: a series of similar items in which each is almost the same as the ones next to it but the last is very different from the first
senses.chn: （相邻两者相似但起首与末尾截然不同的）连续体

ex.en: It is impossible to say at what point along the continuum a dialect becomes a separate language.
ex.cn: 要说出同一语言的方言差异到什么程度才成为另一种语言是不可能的。

senses.def: to become twisted or make sth twisted out of its natural or normal shape

ex.en: His face contorted with anger.
ex.cn: 他脸都气歪了。

ex.en: Her mouth was contorted in a snarl.
ex.cn: 她龇牙咧嘴地怒吼着。

senses.def: the state of the face or body being twisted out of its natural shape
senses.chn: （脸部或躯体的）扭曲，变形，走样

ex.en: Their bodies had suffered contortion as a result of malnutrition.
ex.cn: 由于营养不良他们的躯体都变了形。

senses.def: a movement which twists the body out of its natural shape

ex.en: His facial contortions amused the audience of schoolchildren.
ex.cn: 他扮鬼脸逗得小学生观众都笑起来了。

ex.en: We had to go through all the usual contortions (= a difficult series of actions) to get a ticket.
ex.cn: 我们照例得费尽心机才能弄到一张票。

senses.def: a performer who does contortions of their body to entertain others
the outer edges of sth; the outline of its shape or form

ex.en: The road follows the natural contours of the coastline.
ex.cn: 这条路沿着海岸线的自然轮廓延伸。

ex.en: She traced the contours of his face with her finger.
ex.cn: 她用一根手指拂过他脸部的轮廓。

senses.def: a line on a map that joins points that are the same height above sea level
senses.chn: （地图上连接相同海拔各点的）等高线

ex.en: a contour map (= a map that includes these lines)
ex.cn: 等高线地图

senses.def: with a specially designed outline that makes sth attractive or comfortable

ex.en: It is smoothly contoured to look like a racing car.
ex.cn: 这辆车外形设计流畅，看起来像赛车。

senses.def: having or showing contours

ex.en: contoured hills/maps
ex.cn: 标有等高线的山峦／地图

senses.def: against; opposite

ex.en: contraflow
ex.cn: 一侧双向行驶

ex.en: contradict
ex.cn: 反驳

senses.def: having a pitch an octave below

ex.en: a contrabassoon
ex.cn: 低音大管

senses.def: goods that are illegally taken into or out of a country
senses.chn: （非法带入或带出国境的）禁运品，走私货

ex.en: contraband goods
ex.cn: 违禁货物

ex.en: to smuggle contraband
ex.cn: 走私违禁品

senses.def: the practice of preventing a woman from becoming pregnant; the methods of doing this

ex.en: to give advice about contraception
ex.cn: 就避孕方法提供咨询

senses.def: a drug, device or practice used to prevent a woman from becoming pregnant
senses.chn: 避孕药；避孕用具；避孕措施

ex.en: oral contraceptives
ex.cn: 口服避孕药

senses.def: an official written agreement

ex.en: a contract of employment
ex.cn: 雇佣合同

ex.en: a research contract
ex.cn: 从事研究的合同

ex.en: to enter into/make/sign a contract with the supplier
ex.cn: 与供应商签订合同

ex.en: These clauses form part of the contract between buyer and seller.
ex.cn: 这些条款构成买卖双方所签合同的一部分。

ex.en: a contract for the supply of vehicles
ex.cn: 提供车辆的合约

ex.en: to win/be awarded a contract to build a new school
ex.cn: 获得承建一所新学校的合同

senses.def: an agreement to kill sb for money

ex.en: to take out a contract on sb
ex.cn: 雇凶手杀害某人

senses.def: to become less or smaller; to make sth become less or smaller

ex.en: Glass contracts as it cools.
ex.cn: 玻璃遇冷收缩。

ex.en: a contracting market
ex.cn: 萎缩的市场

ex.en: The heart muscles contract to expel the blood.
ex.cn: 心脏肌肉收缩以挤压出血液。

ex.en: The exercise consists of stretching and contracting the leg muscles.
ex.cn: 此项训练包括伸展和收缩腿部肌肉。

ex.en: 'I will' and 'I shall' are usually contracted (= made shorter) to 'I'll'.
ex.cn: I will 和 I shall 通常缩写成 I'll。

senses.def: to get an illness

ex.en: to contract AIDS/a virus/a disease
ex.cn: 感染艾滋病／病毒／疾病

senses.def: to make a legal agreement with sb for them to work for you or provide you with a service

ex.en: The player is contracted to play until August.
ex.cn: 这位选手签约参加比赛到八月份。

ex.en: Several computer engineers have been contracted to the finance department.
ex.cn: 有几位计算机工程师与财务部门签订了合同。

senses.def: to make a legal agreement to work for sb or provide them with a service

ex.en: She has contracted to work 20 hours a week.
ex.cn: 她已签订每周工作 20 小时的合同。

senses.def: to formally agree to marry sb/form an alliance with sb
to formally agree that you will take part in sth
to formally agree that you will not take part in sth
senses.chn: 订约不参与；退出（或不参加）…合约

ex.en: Many employees contracted out of the pension plan.
ex.cn: 许多雇员退出了养老金计划的合约。

senses.def: to arrange for work to be done by another company rather than your own
the standard form of the card game bridge, in which points are given only for sets of cards that are bid1 and won
senses.chn: 定约桥牌（桥牌的标准形式，只能按叫到的定约取得成局奖分）

senses.def: able to contract or, of an opening or tube, become narrower
senses.chn: 可收缩的；（开口或管）可变窄的

senses.def: the process of becoming smaller

ex.en: the expansion and contraction of the metal
ex.cn: 金属的膨胀与收缩

ex.en: The sudden contraction of the markets left them with a lot of unwanted stock.
ex.cn: 股票市场骤然收缩，让他们剩下了许多无人要的股票。

senses.def: a sudden and painful contracting of muscles, especially of the muscles around a woman's womb, that happens when she is giving birth to a child
senses.chn: （肌肉的）收缩，挛缩；（尤指分娩时的）子宫收缩

ex.en: The contractions started coming every five minutes.
ex.cn: 子宫开始每隔五分钟收缩一次。

senses.def: a short form of a word

ex.en: 'He's' may be a contraction of 'he is' or 'he has'.
ex.cn: he's 可以是 he is 或 he has 的缩写形式。

senses.def: a person or company that has a contract to do work or provide goods or services for another company
senses.chn: 承包人；承包商；承包公司

ex.en: a building/haulage, etc. contractor
ex.cn: 建筑、货运等承包商

ex.en: to employ an outside contractor
ex.cn: 雇用外来承包商

senses.def: connected with the conditions of a legal written agreement; agreed in a contract
senses.chn: 合同的；契约的；按合同（或契约）规定的

senses.def: to say that sth that sb else has said is wrong, and that the opposite is true

ex.en: All evening her husband contradicted everything she said.
ex.cn: 整个晚上她说什么丈夫都反驳。

ex.en: You've just contradicted yourself (= said the opposite of what you said before).
ex.cn: 你恰好与你刚才说的自相矛盾。

ex.en: 'No, it's not,' she contradicted (him).
ex.cn: “不，不是的。” 她反驳（他）说。

senses.def: to be so different from each other that one of them must be wrong

ex.en: The two stories contradict each other.
ex.cn: 这两种说法相互抵触。

ex.en: There is clear evidence that TV advertising influences what children buy.
ex.cn: 有明确的证据表明电视广告影响儿童的购买行为。

ex.en: It is clear from numerous studies that TV advertising influences what children buy.
ex.cn: 众多研究清楚地表明电视广告影响儿童的购买行为。

ex.en: Recent research demonstrates that TV advertising influences children's spending habits.
ex.cn: 最近的研究表明电视广告影响儿童的消费习惯。

ex.en: Many parents think that TV advertising influences their children. This view is supported by the findings of a recent study, which show a clear link between television advertisements and children's spending habits.
ex.cn: 许多家长认为电视广告对他们的孩子会产生影响。这一观点得到近期研究结果的支持，即电视广告和儿童消费习惯之间有明显的关联。

ex.en: The findings also reveal that most children are unaware of the persuasive purpose of advertising.
ex.cn: 这些研究结果还显示大多数儿童没有意识到广告的说服意图。

senses.def: a lack of agreement between facts, opinions, actions, etc.
senses.chn: （事实、看法、行动等的）不一致，矛盾，对立

ex.en: There is a contradiction between the two sets of figures.
ex.cn: 这两组数据相互矛盾。

ex.en: His public speeches are in direct contradiction to his personal lifestyle.
ex.cn: 他的公开言论与他本人的生活方式恰恰相反。

ex.en: How can we resolve this apparent contradiction?
ex.cn: 我们怎样才能解决这个明显的矛盾呢？

senses.def: the act of saying that sth that sb else has said is wrong or not true; an example of this

ex.en: I think I can say, without fear of contradiction, that…
ex.cn: 就算有人反驳，我也敢说…

ex.en: Now you say you both left at ten—that's a contradiction of your last statement.
ex.cn: 你现在说你们俩是十点钟离开的，这可和你上次的说法不一致。

senses.def: a statement containing two words that contradict each other's meaning

ex.en: A 'nomad settlement' is a contradiction in terms.
ex.cn: “游牧者的定居” 是用词上的自相矛盾。

senses.def: containing or showing a contradiction
senses.chn: 相互矛盾的；对立的；不一致的

ex.en: We are faced with two apparently contradictory statements.
ex.cn: 我们面前这两种说法显然是矛盾的。

ex.en: The advice I received was often contradictory.
ex.cn: 我所得到的建议常常是相互矛盾的。

senses.def: in contrast with sth/sb
a system that is used when one half of a large road is closed for repairs, and the traffic going in both directions has to use the other half
senses.chn: （道路一侧关闭维修时实行的）一侧双向行驶

ex.en: A contraflow system is in operation on this section of the motorway.
ex.cn: 这段高速公路的一侧正在实行双向行驶。

senses.def: if a drug or treatment is contraindicated, there is a medical reason why it should not be used in a particular situation
senses.chn: 禁忌使用（某种药物或疗法）

ex.en: This drug is contraindicated in patients with asthma.
ex.cn: 这种药哮喘病人禁用。

senses.def: a possible reason for not giving sb a particular drug or medical treatment
a machine or piece of equipment that looks strange
senses.chn: 奇异的机械；奇特的装置

ex.en: She showed us a strange contraption that looked like a satellite dish.
ex.cn: 她给我们看了一个奇怪的玩意儿，样子像碟形卫星信号接收器。

senses.def: having two or more tunes played together to form a whole
used at the beginning of a sentence or clause to introduce a contrast
senses.chn: （用于句首或从句的开头以引出对比）相反，在另一方面

senses.def: in the opposite way

ex.en: It worked contrariwise—first you dialled the number, then you put the money in.
ex.cn: 这部电话的操作方式相反，要先拨号码，然后投入钱币。

senses.def: different from sth; against sth
senses.chn: 与之相异的；相对立的；相反的

ex.en: Contrary to popular belief, many cats dislike milk.
ex.cn: 与普遍的看法相反，许多猫不喜欢牛奶。

ex.en: The government has decided that the publication of the report would be 'contrary to the public interest'.
ex.cn: 政府认为发表这份报告将会 “违背公众的利益”。

senses.def: completely different in nature or direction
senses.chn: （在性质或方向上）截然不同的，完全相反的

ex.en: contrary advice/opinions/arguments
ex.cn: 完全相反的建议／观点／论点

ex.en: The contrary view is that prison provides an excellent education—in crime.
ex.cn: 截然不同的看法是监狱可以提供极好的教育——在犯罪方面。

senses.def: the opposite fact, event or situation
senses.chn: 相反的事实（或事情、情况）

ex.en: In the end the contrary was proved true: he was innocent and she was guilty.
ex.cn: 最后证明事实正好相反：他是无辜的，而她则有罪。

senses.def: used to introduce a statement that says the opposite of the last one

ex.en: 'It must have been terrible.' 'On the contrary, I enjoyed every minute.'
ex.cn: “那一定是很糟糕。” “恰恰相反，我非常喜欢。”

senses.def: used to emphasize that the opposite of what has been said is true

ex.en: I don't find him funny at all. Quite the contrary.
ex.cn: 正相反，我觉得他一点儿也不可笑。

senses.def: showing or proving the opposite

ex.en: Show me some evidence to the contrary (= proving that sth is not true).
ex.cn: 给我看看有什么相反的证据吧。

ex.en: I will expect to see you on Sunday unless I hear anything to the contrary (= that you are not coming).
ex.cn: 我星期天等你，除非你说不来了。

senses.def: behaving badly; choosing to do or say the opposite of what is expected
senses.chn: 乖戾的；好与人作对的；逆反的；犟的

ex.en: She was such a contrary child—it was impossible to please her.
ex.cn: 这孩子老跟人作对，没法让她高兴。

senses.def: a difference between two or more people or things that you can see clearly when they are compared or put close together; the fact of comparing two or more things in order to show the differences between them

ex.en: There is an obvious contrast between the cultures of East and West.
ex.cn: 东西方文化之间有明显的差异。

ex.en: The company lost $7 million this quarter in contrast to a profit of $6.2 million a year earlier.
ex.cn: 这家公司本季度亏损了 700 万美元，与去年同期 620 万美元的盈利形成了对照。

ex.en: The situation when we arrived was in marked contrast to the news reports.
ex.cn: 我们到达时的局势与新闻报道的截然不同。

ex.en: The poverty of her childhood stands in total contrast to her life in Hollywood.
ex.cn: 她孩提时的贫困处境与她在好莱坞的生活有着天壤之别。

ex.en: to show a sharp/stark/striking contrast with sth
ex.cn: 与某事物形成鲜明／明显／显著的对比

ex.en: A wool jacket complements the silk trousers and provides an interesting contrast in texture.
ex.cn: 毛料上衣配真丝长裤，质地上的差异非常有趣。

senses.def: a person or thing that is clearly different from sb/sth else

ex.en: The work you did today is quite a contrast to (= very much better/worse than) what you did last week.
ex.cn: 你今天的表现与上周截然不同。

senses.def: differences in colour or in light and dark, used in photographs and paintings to create a special effect
senses.chn: （摄影或绘画中的）颜色反差，明暗对比

ex.en: The artist's use of contrast is masterly.
ex.cn: 这位艺术家娴熟地运用了明暗对比。

senses.def: the amount of difference between light and dark in a photograph or the picture on a television screen
senses.chn: （照片或电视图像的）明暗对比度，反差

ex.en: Use this button to adjust the contrast.
ex.cn: 用此按钮调节图像明暗的对比度。

senses.def: to compare two things in order to show the differences between them

ex.en: It is interesting to contrast the British legal system with the American one.
ex.cn: 把英国的法制与美国的加以对比很有意思。

ex.en: The poem contrasts youth and age.
ex.cn: 这首诗对比了青年与老年。

senses.def: to show a clear difference when close together or when compared
senses.chn: （靠近或作比较时）显出明显的差异，形成对比

ex.en: Her actions contrasted sharply with her promises.
ex.cn: 她的行为与她的诺言相差甚远。

ex.en: Her actions and her promises contrasted sharply.
ex.cn: 她的行动与她的诺言相差甚远。

senses.def: very different in style, colour or attitude
senses.chn: （在式样、颜色或态度上）极不相同的，差异大的

ex.en: bright, contrasting colours
ex.cn: 鲜艳斑斓的色彩

ex.en: The book explores contrasting views of the poet's early work.
ex.cn: 此书探讨了人们对这位诗人早期作品截然不同的观点。

senses.def: showing the differences between languages

ex.en: a contrastive analysis of British and Australian English
ex.cn: 对英式英语和澳大利亚英语的对比分析

senses.def: to do sth that is not allowed by a law or rule

ex.en: The company was found guilty of contravening safety regulations.
ex.cn: 那家公司被判违反了安全条例。

senses.def: an unfortunate event or embarrassing disagreement with another person
senses.chn: 不幸事情；令人难堪的龃龉

senses.def: to give sth, especially money or goods, to help sb/sth
senses.chn: 捐献，捐赠（尤指金钱或物品）；捐助

ex.en: We contributed £5 000 to the earthquake fund.
ex.cn: 我们向地震基金捐赠了 5 000 英镑。

ex.en: Would you like to contribute to our collection?
ex.cn: 你愿意给我们的募捐捐款吗？

ex.en: Do you wish to contribute?
ex.cn: 你想捐助吗？

senses.def: to be one of the causes of sth

ex.en: Medical negligence was said to have contributed to her death.
ex.cn: 据说医务人员的玩忽职守是她死亡的原因之一。

ex.en: Human error may have been a contributing factor.
ex.cn: 人为过错可能是一个起作用的因素。

ex.en: Childhood obesity can cause / lead to long-term health problems.
ex.cn: 儿童肥胖可能导致长期的健康问题。

ex.en: Changes in lifestyle and diet over the last twenty years have caused / led to / resulted in a sharp increase in childhood obesity.
ex.cn: 过去二十年生活方式及饮食的变化导致肥胖儿童数量急剧上升。

ex.en: Several factors, including changes in diet and lifestyle, have contributed to the increase in childhood obesity.
ex.cn: 包括饮食及生活方式变化在内的多个因素促使肥胖儿童数量增加。

ex.en: Research suggests that fast food and soft drinks directly contribute to childhood obesity.
ex.cn: 研究表明快餐和软饮料会直接导致儿童肥胖。

senses.def: to increase, improve or add to sth

ex.en: Immigrants have contributed to British culture in many ways.
ex.cn: 移民在许多方面都对英国文化有所贡献。

ex.en: This book contributes little to our understanding of the subject.
ex.cn: 此书对我们了解这门学科助益甚少。

senses.def: to write things for a newspaper, magazine, or a radio or television programme; to speak during a meeting or conversation, especially to give your opinion
senses.chn: （为报纸、杂志、电台或电视节目）撰稿；（在会议或会谈期间）讲话，（尤指）发表意见

ex.en: She contributed a number of articles to the magazine.
ex.cn: 她给这家杂志撰写了一些稿件。

ex.en: He contributes regularly to the magazine 'New Scientist'.
ex.cn: 他定期给《新科学家》杂志撰稿。

ex.en: We hope everyone will contribute to the discussion.
ex.cn: 我们希望大家都能参与讨论。

senses.def: a sum of money that is given to a person or an organization in order to help pay for sth

ex.en: to make a contribution to charity
ex.cn: 给慈善事业捐款

ex.en: a substantial contribution
ex.cn: 一笔数额相当大的捐款

ex.en: All contributions will be gratefully received.
ex.cn: 我们对所有捐资表示感谢。

ex.en: valuable contributions towards the upkeep of the cathedral
ex.cn: 对维修大教堂很重要的捐资

senses.def: a sum of money that you pay regularly to your employer or the government in order to pay for benefits such as health insurance, a pension, etc.
senses.chn: （给雇主或政府用作医疗保险、养老金等津贴的）定期缴款

ex.en: monthly contributions to the pension scheme
ex.cn: 养老金计划的每月分摊款额

ex.en: ten monthly payments of $50
ex.cn: 每月付款 50 美元，十次付清

ex.en: payment in advance
ex.cn: 预先付款

ex.en: an insurance premium
ex.cn: 保险费

ex.en: a premium for express delivery
ex.cn: 快递附加费

ex.en: You can increase your monthly contributions to the pension plan.
ex.cn: 你可以增加你的养老金计划每月供款。

senses.def: an action or a service that helps to cause or increase sth

ex.en: He made a very positive contribution to the success of the project.
ex.cn: 他对项目的成功作出了非常积极的贡献。

ex.en: the car's contribution to the greenhouse effect
ex.cn: 汽车对加剧温室效应所起的作用

ex.en: These measures would make a valuable contribution towards reducing industrial accidents.
ex.cn: 这些措施将会对减少工业事故起重要的作用。

senses.def: an item that forms part of a book, magazine, broadcast, discussion, etc.
senses.chn: （书、杂志、广播、讨论等部分内容的）一则，一条，稿件

ex.en: an important contribution to the debate
ex.cn: 这次辩论一项重要的内容

ex.en: All contributions for the May issue must be received by Friday.
ex.cn: 所有要在五月这一期发表的稿件必须在星期五以前寄到。

senses.def: the act of giving sth, especially money, to help a person or an organization

ex.en: We rely entirely on voluntary contribution.
ex.cn: 我们全靠自愿捐赠。

senses.def: a person who writes articles for a magazine or a book, or who talks on a radio or television programme or at a meeting
senses.chn: （杂志或书的）撰稿人，投稿人；（电台、电视节目中的）嘉宾；（会议的）发言人

senses.def: a person or thing that provides money to help pay for sth, or support sth
senses.chn: 捐款者；捐赠者；作出贡献者

ex.en: Older people are important contributors to the economy.
ex.cn: 老一辈人为发展经济作出了重要贡献。

senses.def: something that helps to cause sth

ex.en: Sulphur dioxide is a pollutant and a major contributor to acid rain.
ex.cn: 二氧化硫是一种污染物，并且是形成酸雨的主要因素。

senses.def: helping to cause sth
senses.chn: 促成的；促进的；起作用的

ex.en: Alcohol is a contributory factor in 10% of all road accidents.
ex.cn: 所有交通事故中有 10% 是酒后驾车造成的。

senses.def: involving payments from the people who will benefit

ex.en: a contributory pension scheme/plan (= paid for by both employers and employees)
ex.cn: 由雇主与雇员共同出资的养老金计划

senses.def: very sorry for sth bad that you have done
something that sb has done or written that does not seem natural; the fact of seeming artificial
senses.chn: 非自然之物；人工产物；矫揉造作

ex.en: The film is spoilt by unrealistic contrivances of plot.
ex.cn: 这部电影被不实际的牵强情节给毁了。

ex.en: The story is told with a complete absence of contrivance.
ex.cn: 这故事讲得毫不矫揉造作。

senses.def: a clever or complicated device or tool made for a particular purpose
senses.chn: 精巧（或复杂）的装置；专用工具

senses.def: a clever plan or trick; the act of using a clever plan or trick
senses.chn: 计谋；圈套；采用计谋（或圈套）

ex.en: an ingenious contrivance to get her to sign the document without reading it
ex.cn: 使她未经过目就签署文件的妙计

senses.def: to manage to do sth despite difficulties

ex.en: She contrived to spend a couple of hours with him every Sunday evening.
ex.cn: 每周星期日晚上她都设法与他待上几个小时。

senses.def: to succeed in making sth happen despite difficulties

ex.en: I decided to contrive a meeting between the two of them.
ex.cn: 我决定设法让他们双方见上一面。

senses.def: to think of or make sth, for example a plan or a machine, in a clever way
senses.chn: 巧妙地策划；精巧地制造（如机器）

ex.en: They contrived a plan to defraud the company.
ex.cn: 他们精心策划要欺诈那家公司。

senses.def: planned in advance and not natural or genuine; written or arranged in a way that is not natural or realistic
senses.chn: 预谋的；不自然的；人为的；做作的

ex.en: a contrived situation
ex.cn: 人为的状况

ex.en: The book's happy ending seemed contrived.
ex.cn: 这部书大团圆的结局读来让人感到不真实。

senses.def: the power to make decisions about how a country, an area, an organization, etc. is run
senses.chn: （对国家、地区、机构等的）管理权，控制权，支配权

ex.en: The party is expecting to gain control of the council in the next election.
ex.cn: 该党期待着在下次选举中获得对地方议会的控制权。

ex.en: The Democrats will probably lose control of Congress.
ex.cn: 民主党很可能失去对国会的控制。

ex.en: A military junta took control of the country.
ex.cn: 政变上台的军政府接管了这个国家。

ex.en: The city is in the control of enemy forces.
ex.cn: 那座城市现处于敌军的控制之下。

ex.en: The city is under enemy control.
ex.cn: 那座城市现处于敌人的控制之下。

senses.def: the ability to make sb/sth do what you want

ex.en: The teacher had no control over the children.
ex.cn: 那位老师管不住学生。

ex.en: She struggled to keep control of her voice.
ex.cn: 她竭力控制住自己的声音。

ex.en: She lost control of her car on the ice.
ex.cn: 她在冰上开车失去了控制。

ex.en: He got so angry he lost control (= shouted and said or did things he would not normally do).
ex.cn: 他气得失去了自制。

ex.en: Owing to circumstances beyond our control, the flight to Rome has been cancelled.
ex.cn: 由于出现了我们无法控制的情况，飞往罗马的航班已被取消。

ex.en: The coach made the team work hard on ball control (= in a ball game).
ex.cn: 教练让全队努力练习控球。

senses.def: the act of restricting, limiting or managing sth; a method of doing this
senses.chn: 限制；限定；约束；管理；管制

ex.en: traffic control
ex.cn: 交通管制

ex.en: talks on arms control
ex.cn: 军备控制谈判

ex.en: government controls on trade and industry
ex.cn: 政府对工商业的管理

ex.en: A new advance has been made in the control of malaria.
ex.cn: 在控制疟疾方面已取得新的进展。

ex.en: Price controls on food were ended.
ex.cn: 对食物价格的控制已告结束。

ex.en: a pest control officer
ex.cn: 虫害防治员

senses.def: the switches and buttons, etc. that you use to operate a machine or a vehicle
senses.chn: （机器或车辆的）操纵装置，开关，按钮

ex.en: the controls of an aircraft
ex.cn: 飞机的操纵装置

ex.en: the control panel
ex.cn: 控制面板

ex.en: the volume control of a CD player
ex.cn: 激光唱片机的音量调节器

ex.en: The co-pilot was at the controls when the plane landed.
ex.cn: 副驾驶员操纵着飞机着陆。

senses.def: a person, thing or group used as a standard of comparison for checking the results of a scientific experiment; an experiment whose result is known, used for checking working methods
senses.chn: 对照标准；（检验工作方法的）参照实验

ex.en: One group was treated with the new drug, and the control group was given a sugar pill.
ex.cn: 一组采用新药治疗，而对照检验组服用的则是糖丸。

senses.def: a place where orders are given or where checks are made; the people who work in this place
senses.chn: 指挥（或检查、控制）站；指挥（或检查、控制）人员

ex.en: air traffic control
ex.cn: 空中交通管制中心

ex.en: We went through passport control and into the departure lounge.
ex.cn: 我们通过护照检查站进入了候机大厅。

ex.en: This is Mission Control calling the space shuttle Discovery.
ex.cn: 地面指挥中心现在呼叫航天飞机 “发现号”。

senses.def: (on a computer keyboard) a key that you press when you want to perform a particular operation
to direct or manage an organization, an area or a situation
senses.chn: 掌管，管理，控制，操纵（某机构、地区或局势）

ex.en: He's reached retiring age, but he's still firmly in control.
ex.cn: 他虽然已到退休年龄，但仍大权在握。

ex.en: There has been some violence after the match, but the police are now in control of the situation.
ex.cn: 比赛后发生了一些暴力事件，但是现在警方已控制了局势。

senses.def: to be able to organize your life well and keep calm

ex.en: In spite of all her family problems, she's really in control.
ex.cn: 她虽然家庭问题重重，却能完全处之泰然。

senses.def: to be or become impossible to manage or to control

ex.en: The children are completely out of control since their father left.
ex.cn: 这些孩子自他们的父亲离开后就无法无天了。

ex.en: A truck ran out of control on the hill.
ex.cn: 一辆卡车在山上失去了控制。

senses.def: to be being dealt with successfully
senses.chn: 被控制住；处于控制之下

ex.en: Don't worry—everything's under control!
ex.cn: 别担心，一切都控制住了！

senses.def: to succeed in dealing with sth so that it does not cause any damage or hurt anyone
senses.chn: 控制得住，抑制得住（从而不造成损害）

ex.en: It took two hours to bring the fire under control.
ex.cn: 花了两个小时才控制住火势。

ex.en: Please keep your dog under control!
ex.cn: 请管好你的狗！

senses.def: to have power over a person, company, country, etc. so that you are able to decide what they must do or how it is run

ex.en: By the age of 21 he controlled the company.
ex.cn: 他 21 岁就掌管了公司。

ex.en: The whole territory is now controlled by the army.
ex.cn: 现在全境都在军队的控制之下。

ex.en: Can't you control your children?
ex.cn: 你就不能管管你这些孩子？

senses.def: to limit sth or make it happen in a particular way

ex.en: government attempts to control immigration
ex.cn: 政府试图限制移民的措施

ex.en: Many biological processes are controlled by hormones.
ex.cn: 许多生物变化过程都是由激素控制的。

ex.en: Parents should control what their kids watch on television.
ex.cn: 父母应该限定孩子看什么样的电视节目。

senses.def: to stop sth from spreading or getting worse

ex.en: Firefighters are still trying to control the blaze.
ex.cn: 消防队员仍在尽力控制火势的蔓延。

ex.en: She was given drugs to control the pain.
ex.cn: 给她服用了镇痛药。

senses.def: to make sth, such as a machine or system, work in the way that you want it to
senses.chn: 操纵，控制（机器或系统等）

ex.en: This knob controls the volume.
ex.cn: 此旋钮调节音量。

ex.en: The traffic lights are controlled by a central computer.
ex.cn: 交通信号灯由中心计算机控制。

senses.def: to manage to make yourself remain calm, even though you are upset or angry

ex.en: I was so furious I couldn't control myself and I hit him.
ex.cn: 我气得无法自制，就打了他。

ex.en: He was finding it difficult to control his feelings.
ex.cn: 他觉得很难克制住自己的感情。

senses.def: a person who always wants to be in control of their own and others' lives, and to organize how things are done
senses.chn: 好多管事的人；爱指挥别人的人

senses.def: that can be controlled
senses.chn: 可控制（或管理、操纵、支配）的

senses.def: done or arranged in a very careful way
senses.chn: 十分小心完成的；精心安排的

ex.en: a controlled explosion
ex.cn: 控制爆破

ex.en: a controlled environment
ex.cn: 受到控制的生态环境

senses.def: limited, or managed by law or by rules
senses.chn: （受法律或规则）限制的，控制的，管制的

ex.en: controlled airspace
ex.cn: 管制空域

senses.def: managed by a particular group, or in a particular way
senses.chn: （受某团体或用某种方式）管理的，控制的，操纵的

ex.en: a British-controlled company
ex.cn: 英资公司

ex.en: computer-controlled systems
ex.cn: 用计算机控制的系统

senses.def: remaining calm and not getting angry or upset

ex.en: She remained quiet and controlled.
ex.cn: 她沉默不语保持克制。

senses.def: a type of economic system in which a government controls its country's industries and decides what goods should be produced and in what amounts
senses.chn: 管制经济（由政府控制国家工业并决定产品的种类与数量）

senses.def: an illegal drug

ex.en: to be arrested for possession of a controlled substance
ex.cn: 因藏有毒品而被捕

senses.def: a person who manages or directs sth, especially a large organization or part of an organization
senses.chn: （尤指大型机构或部门的）管理者，控制者，指挥者

senses.def: a device that controls or regulates a machine or part of a machine
senses.chn: （机器或部件的）控制器，调节器

ex.en: a temperature controller
ex.cn: 温控器

senses.def: a person who is in charge of the financial accounts of a business company
the fact of owning enough shares in a company to be able to make decisions about what the company should do
a building at an airport from which the movements of aircraft are controlled
senses.chn: （机场的）指挥塔台，控制塔，指挥调度台

senses.def: causing a lot of angry public discussion and disagreement

ex.en: a highly controversial topic
ex.cn: 颇有争议的话题

ex.en: a controversial plan to build a new road
ex.cn: 有争议的修建新道路计划

ex.en: Winston Churchill and Richard Nixon were both controversial figures.
ex.cn: 温斯顿 · 丘吉尔和理查德 · 尼克松都是有争议的人物。

senses.def: public discussion and argument about sth that many people strongly disagree about, disapprove of, or are shocked by

ex.en: to arouse/cause controversy
ex.cn: 引起争论

ex.en: a bitter controversy over/about the site of the new airport
ex.cn: 有关新机场选址的激烈争论

ex.en: the controversy surrounding his latest movie
ex.cn: 围绕他最近一部电影的争论

ex.en: The President resigned amid considerable controversy.
ex.cn: 总统在激烈的争议中辞职了。

senses.def: to say or prove that sth is not true
lacking respect for authority
senses.chn: 藐视权威的；违抗的；不服从的

senses.def: an injury to part of the body that does not break the skin
a confusing problem or question that is very difficult to solve
senses.chn: 令人迷惑的难题；复杂难解的问题

senses.def: a question, usually involving a trick with words, that you ask for fun
a large area where towns have grown and joined together, often around a city
senses.chn: （有卫星城镇的）大都市，集合城市

senses.def: to spend time getting your health and strength back after an illness

ex.en: She is convalescing at home after her operation.
ex.cn: 手术后她正在家休养康复。

senses.def: a period of time when you get well again after an illness or a medical operation; the process of getting well

ex.en: You need four to six weeks' convalescence.
ex.cn: 你需要四至六个星期的康复期。

senses.def: connected with convalescence; in the process of convalescence
senses.chn: 康复期的；正在康复的；渐愈的

ex.en: a convalescent home (= a type of hospital where people go to get well after an illness)
ex.cn: 康复医院

ex.en: a convalescent child
ex.cn: 逐渐康复的小孩

senses.def: the process in which heat moves through a gas or a liquid as the hotter part rises and the cooler, heavier part sinks
senses.chn: （热通过气体或液体的）运流，对流

senses.def: a device for heating the air in a room using convection
to arrange for people to come together for a formal meeting

ex.en: to convene a meeting
ex.cn: 召开会议

ex.en: A Board of Inquiry was convened immediately after the accident.
ex.cn: 事故后立即成立了调查委员会。

senses.def: to come together for a formal meeting

ex.en: The committee will convene at 11.30 next Thursday.
ex.cn: 委员会将在下星期四上午 11:30 开会。

senses.def: a person who arranges meetings of groups or committees
a senior official of a trade/labor union at a factory or other place of work
senses.chn: （工厂或基层单位的）资深工会领导人

senses.def: the quality of being useful, easy or suitable for sb

ex.en: We have provided seats for the convenience of our customers.
ex.cn: 为方便顾客我们备有座位。

ex.en: For (the sake of) convenience, the two groups have been treated as one in this report.
ex.cn: 为方便起见，这两个组在本报告中被视为一组。

ex.en: In this resort you can enjoy all the comfort and convenience of modern tourism.
ex.cn: 在这个度假胜地你可享受所有现代旅游的舒适与便利。

senses.def: something that is useful and can make things easier or quicker to do, or more comfortable
senses.chn: 便利的事物（或设施）；方便的用具

ex.en: It was a great convenience to have the school so near.
ex.cn: 学校这么近真是太方便了。

ex.en: The house had all the modern conveniences (= central heating, etc.) that were unusual at that time.
ex.cn: 这座房子拥有在当时并不常见的所有现代化设施。

senses.def: at a time or a place which is suitable for sb
senses.chn: 在（某人）方便时；在（某人）适宜的地点

ex.en: Can you telephone me at your convenience to arrange a meeting?
ex.cn: 你能不能在你方便时给我来个电话，安排见一次面？

senses.def: as soon as possible

ex.en: Please telephone at your earliest convenience.
ex.cn: 请尽早打电话。

senses.def: food that you buy frozen or in a box or can, that you can prepare and cook very quickly and easily
a shop/store that sells food, newspapers, etc. and often stays open 24 hours a day
senses.chn: 便利店（常为 24 小时营业）

senses.def: useful, easy or quick to do; not causing problems
senses.chn: 实用的；便利的；方便的；省事的

ex.en: It is very convenient to pay by credit card.
ex.cn: 用信用卡付款非常方便。

ex.en: You'll find these meals quick and convenient to prepare.
ex.cn: 你会发现准备这样的饭既快又省事。

ex.en: Fruit is a convenient source of vitamins and energy.
ex.cn: 水果是维生素和能量的便利来源。

ex.en: A bicycle is often more convenient than a car in towns.
ex.cn: 在城镇骑自行车常常比开车更方便。

ex.en: I can't see him now—it isn't convenient.
ex.cn: 我现在不便见他。

ex.en: I'll call back at a more convenient time.
ex.cn: 在比较方便的时候我会回电话的。

senses.def: near to a particular place; easy to get to
senses.chn: 附近的；近便的；容易到达的

ex.en: The house is very convenient for several schools.
ex.cn: 这座房子离几所学校很近。

ex.en: The hotel is convenient to downtown.
ex.cn: 这家旅馆离市中心很近。

senses.def: a building in which nuns (= members of a female religious community) live together
a school run by nuns
the way in which sth is done that most people in a society expect and consider to be polite or the right way to do it

ex.en: social conventions
ex.cn: 社会习俗

ex.en: By convention the deputy leader was always a woman.
ex.cn: 按惯例，这一领导职务的副职总是由女性担任。

ex.en: She is a young woman who enjoys flouting conventions.
ex.cn: 她是一位喜欢无视传统习俗的年轻女子。

senses.def: a large meeting of the members of a profession, a political party, etc.
senses.chn: （从业者、政党成员等的）大会，集会

ex.en: to hold a convention
ex.cn: 召开大会

ex.en: the Democratic Party Convention (= to elect a candidate for president)
ex.cn: 民主党代表大会（选出总统候选人）

senses.def: an official agreement between countries or leaders
senses.chn: （国家或首脑间的）公约，协定，协议

ex.en: the Geneva convention
ex.cn: 日内瓦公约

ex.en: the United Nations convention on the rights of the child
ex.cn: 联合国儿童权利公约

senses.def: a traditional method or style in literature, art or the theatre
senses.chn: （文学、艺术或戏剧的）传统手法，传统风格

ex.en: the conventions of Greek tragedy
ex.cn: 希腊悲剧的传统手法

senses.def: tending to follow what is done or considered acceptable by society in general; normal and ordinary, and perhaps not very interesting
senses.chn: 依照惯例的；遵循习俗的；墨守成规的；普通平凡的

ex.en: conventional behaviour/morality
ex.cn: 循规蹈矩的行为；传统的道德规范

ex.en: She's very conventional in her views.
ex.cn: 她的观点很守旧。

senses.def: following what is traditional or the way sth has been done for a long time

ex.en: conventional methods/approaches
ex.cn: 传统方法

ex.en: conventional medicine
ex.cn: 传统医学

ex.en: It's not a hotel, in the conventional sense, but rather a whole village turned into a hotel.
ex.cn: 这不是一家传统意义上的旅馆，而是整个村庄变身而成的度假村。

ex.en: You can use a microwave or cook it in a conventional oven.
ex.cn: 你可以用微波炉或传统烤箱烹制。

senses.def: not nuclear

ex.en: conventional forces/weapons
ex.cn: 常规部队／武器

ex.en: a conventional power station (= using oil or coal as fuel, rather than nuclear power)
ex.cn: 常规电站

senses.def: the view or belief that most people hold
senses.chn: 大多数人的看法；普遍信念

ex.en: Conventional wisdom has it that riots only ever happen in cities.
ex.cn: 人们普遍认为，只有城市里才发生暴乱。

senses.def: a person who is attending a convention
to move towards a place from different directions and meet

ex.en: Thousands of supporters converged on London for the rally.
ex.cn: 成千上万的支持者从四面八方汇聚伦敦举行集会。

senses.def: to move towards each other and meet at a point

ex.en: There was a signpost where the two paths converged.
ex.cn: 两条小路的相交处有一路标。

senses.def: if ideas, policies, aims, etc. converge, they become very similar or the same
senses.chn: （思想、政策、目标等）十分相似，相同

senses.def: knowing about sth; familiar with sth

ex.en: You need to become fully conversant with the company's procedures.
ex.cn: 你得对公司的程序了如指掌。

senses.def: an informal talk involving a small group of people or only two; the activity of talking in this way

ex.en: a telephone conversation
ex.cn: 电话交谈

ex.en: I had a long conversation with her the other day.
ex.cn: 前几天我与她作了一次长谈。

ex.en: The main topic of conversation was the likely outcome of the election.
ex.cn: 谈话的主题是选举可能的结果。

ex.en: Don was deep in conversation with the girl on his right.
ex.cn: 唐与他右边的女孩在专心交谈。

ex.en: to get into conversation with sb
ex.cn: 开始与某人攀谈

ex.en: to get into a conversation with sb
ex.cn: 开始与某人攀谈

senses.def: not formal; as used in conversation
senses.chn: 非正式的；用于交谈的；口语的

ex.en: a casual and conversational tone
ex.cn: 不拘礼节的谈话语气

ex.en: I learnt conversational Spanish at evening classes.
ex.cn: 我在夜校学过西班牙语会话。

senses.def: connected with conversation

ex.en: Men have a more direct conversational style.
ex.cn: 男人交谈比较直截了当。

senses.def: a person who is good at talking to others, especially in an informal way
an object that is talked about a lot because it is unusual
a type of painting in which a group of people are shown in the countryside or in a home
senses.chn: 人物风俗画；乡村（或室内）风情画

senses.def: an unexpected or shocking remark, which people do not know how to reply to
senses.chn: 噎人的话；令人瞠目结舌的话

senses.def: to have a conversation with sb

ex.en: Do you mind if I sit here?
ex.cn: 我坐在这儿可以吗？

ex.en: Hello, is this seat taken?
ex.cn: 你好，这个座位有人吗？

ex.en: May I join you? Can I get you a coffee?
ex.cn: 可以和你一起吗？我给你拿杯咖啡好吗？

ex.en: Lovely weather we're having!/Can you believe this rain/wind/cold/sunshine?
ex.cn: 多好的天气呀！／真想不到会下这么大雨／刮这么大风／这么冷／阳光这么灿烂！

ex.en: Excuse me, could I ask you a question?
ex.cn: 打扰一下，可以问您一个问题吗？

ex.en: Shall we make a start? I think it's almost three o'clock.(BrE)
ex.cn: 我们马上开始好吗？我看都快三点了。

senses.def: the opposite or reverse of a fact or statement
senses.chn: 相反的事物；（事实或陈述的）反面

ex.en: Building new roads increases traffic and the converse is equally true: reducing the number and size of roads means less traffic.
ex.cn: 修筑新的道路会增加交通流量，反过来也是同样的道理：减少道路的数量和规模就意味着减少交通流量。

senses.def: in a way that is the opposite or reverse of sth

ex.en: You can add the fluid to the powder, or, conversely, the powder to the fluid.
ex.cn: 可把液体加入粉末，或者相反，把粉末加入液体。

senses.def: the act or process of changing sth from one form, use or system to another

ex.en: the conversion of farm buildings into family homes
ex.cn: 农场建筑物改建为家庭住宅

ex.en: No conversion from analogue to digital data is needed.
ex.cn: 没有必要把模拟转换为数字数据。

ex.en: a metric conversion table (= showing how to change metric amounts into or out of another system)
ex.cn: 公制换算表

ex.en: a firm which specializes in house conversions (= turning large houses into several smaller flats/apartments)
ex.cn: 专营房屋改建的公司

senses.def: the process or experience of changing your religion or beliefs
senses.chn: （宗教或信仰的）改变；皈依；归附

ex.en: the conversion of the Anglo-Saxons by Christian missionaries
ex.cn: 基督教传教士使盎格鲁–撒克逊人的信仰改变

ex.en: his conversion from Judaism to Christianity
ex.cn: 他由犹太教改信基督教

senses.def: a way of scoring extra points after scoring a try or a touchdown
senses.chn: （持球过对方球门线触地或达阵后的）附加得分

senses.def: a building or room that has been changed so that it can be used for a different purpose, especially for living in
a vehicle in which the back part behind the driver has been arranged as a living space
to change or make sth change from one form, purpose, system, etc. to another

ex.en: The hotel is going to be converted into a nursing home.
ex.cn: 那家旅馆将被改建成私人疗养院。

ex.en: What rate will I get if I convert my dollars into euros?
ex.cn: 如果我把美元兑换成欧元，汇率是多少？

ex.en: We've converted from oil to gas central heating.
ex.cn: 我们已经把中央供热系统由燃油改成了燃气。

senses.def: to be able to be changed from one form, purpose, or system to another

ex.en: a sofa that converts into a bed
ex.cn: 可改作床用的沙发

senses.def: to change or make sb change their religion or beliefs
senses.chn: （使）改变（宗教或信仰）；（使）皈依，归附

ex.en: He converted from Christianity to Islam.
ex.cn: 他由基督教改信伊斯兰教。

ex.en: She was soon converted to the socialist cause.
ex.cn: 她不久便转而献身于社会主义事业了。

senses.def: to change an opinion, a habit, etc.

ex.en: I've converted to organic food.
ex.cn: 我改吃有机食物了。

ex.en: I didn't use to like opera but my husband has converted me.
ex.cn: 我过去不喜欢歌剧，但我丈夫改变了我。

senses.def: to score extra points after a try or a touchdown
senses.chn: （在持球过对方球门线触地或达阵后）获得附加分

senses.def: to speak to people in support of views that they already hold
senses.chn: 向教徒宣教；教读书人写大字

senses.def: a person who has changed their religion, beliefs or opinions
senses.chn: 改变宗教（或信仰、观点）的人；皈依者

ex.en: a convert to Islam
ex.cn: 改信伊斯兰教的人

ex.en: converts from other faiths
