ex.cn: 来自其他宗教信仰的皈依者

ex.en: a convert to the cause
ex.cn: 一个转而支持这项事业的人

senses.def: a person or thing that converts sth
senses.chn: 使发生转化的人（或物）；转换器

ex.en: a catalytic converter
ex.cn: 催化转换器

senses.def: a device for converting alternating current into direct current or the other way around
a device for converting a radio signal from one frequency to another
that can be changed to a different form or use
senses.chn: 可改变的；可转换的；可兑换的

ex.en: a convertible sofa (= one that can be used as a bed)
ex.cn: 可当作床用的沙发

ex.en: convertible currencies (= ones that can be exchanged for those of other countries)
ex.cn: 可兑换的货币

ex.en: The bonds are convertible into ordinary shares.
ex.cn: 债券可兑换为普通股。

senses.def: a car with a roof that can be folded down or taken off
curving out

ex.en: a convex lens/mirror
ex.cn: 凸透镜；凸镜

senses.def: to make ideas, feelings, etc. known to sb

ex.en: Colours like red convey a sense of energy and strength.
ex.cn: 红色之类的颜色可给人以充满活力与力量的感觉。

ex.en: Please convey my apologies to your wife.
ex.cn: 请向你的妻子转达我的歉意。

ex.en: He tried desperately to convey how urgent the situation was.
ex.cn: 他不顾一切地试图说明情况是多么紧急。

ex.en: She did not wish to convey that they were all at fault.
ex.cn: 她不愿表示出他们人人都有错。

senses.def: to take, carry or transport sb/sth from one place to another

ex.en: Pipes convey hot water from the boiler to the radiators.
ex.cn: 管道把热水从锅炉输送到暖气片。

senses.def: the process of taking sb/sth from one place to another

ex.en: the conveyance of goods by rail
ex.cn: 由火车运输货物

senses.def: a vehicle

ex.en: horse-drawn conveyances
ex.cn: 马车

senses.def: a legal document that moves property from one owner to another
a lawyer who is an expert in conveyancing
the branch of law concerned with moving property from one owner to another
a person or thing that carries sth or makes sth known
senses.chn: 运送者；传送者；传播者；传达者

senses.def: a continuous moving band used for transporting goods from one part of a building to another, for example products in a factory or suitcases in an airport
senses.chn: 传送带，输送带（如输送工厂的产品或机场的行李）

senses.def: to decide and state officially in court that sb is guilty of a crime

ex.en: a convicted murderer
ex.cn: 已定罪的谋杀犯

ex.en: He was convicted of fraud.
ex.cn: 他被判犯有诈骗罪。

senses.def: a person who has been found guilty of a crime and sent to prison

ex.en: an escaped convict
ex.cn: 越狱犯

senses.def: the act of finding sb guilty of a crime in court; the fact of having been found guilty

ex.en: She has six previous convictions for theft.
ex.cn: 她有六次盗窃前科。

ex.en: He plans to appeal against his conviction.
ex.cn: 他不服判决，准备上诉。

ex.en: an offence which carries, on conviction, a sentence of not more than five years' imprisonment
ex.cn: 定罪后可判处五年或五年以下监禁的罪行

senses.def: a strong opinion or belief

ex.en: strong political/moral convictions
ex.cn: 坚定不移的政治／道德信念

ex.en: She was motivated by deep religious conviction.
ex.cn: 她的行动是出于虔诚的宗教信仰。

ex.en: a conviction that all would be well in the end
ex.cn: 最终一切都会好起来的坚定信念

senses.def: the feeling or appearance of believing sth strongly and of being sure about it

ex.en: 'Not true!' she said with conviction.
ex.cn: “不真实！” 她肯定地说道。

ex.en: He said he agreed but his voice lacked conviction.
ex.cn: 他说他赞同，但语气不坚定。

ex.en: The leader's speech in defence of the policy didn't carry much conviction.
ex.cn: 那位领导人为政策辩护的讲话不是很有说服力。

senses.def: to be/not be brave enough to do what you feel to be right
senses.chn: 有／没有勇气做自己认为正确的事

senses.def: to make sb/yourself believe that sth is true

ex.en: You'll need to convince them of your enthusiasm for the job.
ex.cn: 你要使他们相信你对这份工作的热忱。

ex.en: I'd convinced myself (that) I was right.
ex.cn: 我确信自己是正确的。

senses.def: to persuade sb to do sth

ex.en: I've been trying to convince him to see a doctor.
ex.cn: 我一直劝他去看病。

senses.def: completely sure about sth

ex.en: Sam nodded but he didn't look convinced.
ex.cn: 萨姆点了点头，可他看起来并没有信服。

ex.en: I am convinced of her innocence.
ex.cn: 我坚信她是清白无辜的。

ex.en: I am convinced that she is innocent.
ex.cn: 我坚信她是清白无辜的。

ex.en: 'Is that John over there?' 'I'm not sure.'
ex.cn: “那边那个人是约翰吗？” “我说不准。”

ex.en: Are you sure about that?
ex.cn: 这事你肯定吗？

ex.en: England must win this game to be sure of qualifying.
ex.cn: 英格兰队必须拿下这场比赛才能确保获得资格。

senses.def: believing strongly in a particular religion or set of political ideas
senses.chn: 坚信不移的；有坚定宗教信仰（或政治信念）的

ex.en: a convinced Christian
ex.cn: 虔诚的基督徒

senses.def: that makes sb believe that sth is true
senses.chn: 令人信服的；有说服力的

ex.en: a convincing argument/explanation/case
ex.cn: 有说服力的论点／解释／事例

ex.en: She sounded very convincing to me (= I believed what she said).
ex.cn: 我觉得她的话很有说服力。

ex.en: a convincing victory/win (= an easy one)
ex.cn: 令人折服的胜利

senses.def: cheerful and friendly in atmosphere or character

ex.en: a convivial evening/atmosphere
ex.cn: 欢乐的夜晚／气氛

ex.en: convivial company
ex.cn: 快乐的伙伴

senses.chn: （患病时期）转危为安，脱离危险，好转；渡过难关；脱离困境

senses.def: to defend your/sb's position against other people
a very difficult or dangerous situation
to get a person or an animal into a place or situation from which they cannot escape
senses.chn: 使（人或动物）走投无路；逼…入绝境

ex.en: The man was finally cornered by police in a garage.
ex.cn: 那人最终被警方逼到了车库里。

ex.en: If cornered, the snake will defend itself.
ex.cn: 蛇在被逼得走投无路时会自卫。

senses.def: to go towards sb in a determined way, because you want to speak to them
senses.chn: 硬要走近想与（某人）说话

ex.en: I found myself cornered by her on the stairs.
ex.cn: 我发觉她在楼梯上迎面过来非要与我说话。

senses.def: to get control of the trade in a particular type of goods

ex.en: They've cornered the market in silver.
ex.cn: 他们垄断了白银市场。

senses.def: to go around a corner

ex.en: The car has excellent cornering (= it is easy to steer around corners).
ex.cn: 这汽车的转弯性能极佳。

senses.def: a defending player whose position is outside and behind the linebackers
a free kick that you take from the corner of your opponent's end of the field
a small shop that sells food, newspapers, cigarettes, etc., especially one near people's houses
senses.chn: （尤指住宅区附近的）小商店，街头小店

senses.def: a stone at the corner of the base of a building, often laid in a special ceremony
the most important part of sth that the rest depends on

ex.en: This study is the cornerstone of the whole research programme.
ex.cn: 此项研究是整个研究计划的基础。

senses.def: a brass musical instrument like a small trumpet
an early musical instrument consisting of a curved tube with holes in that you cover with your fingers while blowing into the end
senses.chn: 木管号，科尔内管（早期乐器）

senses.def: a building where grain used to be bought and sold
a field in which corn is grown
small crisp yellow pieces of crushed maize (corn), usually eaten with milk and sugar for breakfast
senses.chn: 脆玉米片（通常加牛奶和糖作早餐）

senses.def: fine white flour made from maize (corn), used especially for making sauces thicker
a small wild plant with blue flowers
a decorative border around the top of the walls in a room or on the outside walls of a building
the Celtic language that was spoken in Cornwall in England. Nobody now uses Cornish as a first language.
senses.chn: 康沃尔语（从前通行于英格兰康沃尔地区）

senses.def: connected with Cornwall, or its people, language or culture
senses.chn: 康沃尔的；康沃尔人（或语言、文化）的

senses.def: clotted cream (= a very thick type of cream) from Cornwall
a small pie in the shape of a half circle, containing meat and vegetables
flour made from corn (maize)
oil produced from maize (corn), used in cooking
maize (corn) that is cooked with all the grains still attached to the inner part and eaten as a vegetable
a type of bread made from corn (maize) and water
a hairstyle worn especially by black women, in which the hair is put into lines of plaits along the head
senses.chn: （尤指黑人妇女梳的）玉米垄发式

senses.def: fine white flour made from corn (maize), used especially for making sauces thicker
a thick sweet liquid made from corn (maize) and used in cooking
a decorative object shaped like an animal's horn, shown in art as full of fruit and flowers
senses.chn: 丰饶角，丰饶角饰（艺术作品中装满水果和鲜花、形似动物角的装饰物）

senses.def: something that is or contains a large supply of good things

ex.en: The book is a cornucopia of good ideas.
ex.cn: 这部书里有无数好主意。

senses.def: not original; used too often to be interesting or to sound sincere
senses.chn: 陈旧的；过时的；陈词滥调的；老生常谈的

ex.en: a corny joke/song
ex.cn: 老掉牙的笑话／歌曲

ex.en: I know it sounds corny, but it really was love at first sight!
ex.cn: 我知道这听起来像陈词滥调，然而的确是一见钟情啊！

senses.def: the ring of petals around the central part of a flower
a situation, an argument or a fact that is the natural and direct result of another one
a ring of light seen around the sun or moon, especially during an eclipse
senses.chn: 华；（尤指在日食或月食期间的）日冕，日华，月华

senses.def: connected with the heart, particularly the arteries that take blood to the heart

ex.en: coronary (heart) disease
ex.cn: 冠状动脉（心脏）病

ex.en: a coronary patient (= sb suffering from coronary disease)
ex.cn: 冠状动脉疾病患者

senses.def: either of the two arteries that supply blood to the heart
a blocking of the flow of blood by a blood clot in an artery supplying blood to the heart
a ceremony at which a crown is formally placed on the head of a new king or queen
an official whose job is to discover the cause of any sudden, violent or suspicious death by holding an inquest
a small crown worn on formal occasions by princes, princesses, lords, etc.
a round decoration for the head, especially one made of flowers
senses.chn: （尤指用花制作的）冠状头饰；花冠

senses.def: a member of one of the lower ranks in the army, the marines or the British air force
senses.chn: （陆军、海军陆战队或英国空军的）下士

ex.en: Corporal Smith
ex.cn: 史密斯下士

senses.def: the physical punishment of people, especially by hitting them
connected with a corporation

ex.en: corporate finance/planning/strategy
ex.cn: 公司的财务／计划／策略

ex.en: corporate identity (= the image of a company, that all its members share)
ex.cn: 公司形象

ex.en: corporate hospitality (= when companies entertain customers to help develop good business relationships)
ex.cn: 公司对顾客的热情招待

senses.def: forming a corporation
senses.chn: 组成公司（或团体）的；法人的

ex.en: The BBC is a corporate body.
ex.cn: 英国广播公司为法人团体。

ex.en: The law applies to both individuals and corporate bodies.
ex.cn: 本法律既适用于个人也适用于法人团体。

senses.def: involving or shared by all the members of a group

ex.en: corporate responsibility
ex.cn: 共同的责任

senses.def: a person or company that regularly buys large numbers of shares in other companies against their wishes, either to control the company or to sell the shares again for a large profit
senses.chn: 公司掠夺者（定期强行大量购买其他公司股份的个人或公司，以对其加以控制或高价出售股份而获利）

senses.def: a large business company

ex.en: multinational corporations
ex.cn: 跨国公司

ex.en: the Chrysler corporation
ex.cn: 克莱斯勒公司

senses.def: an organization or a group of organizations that is recognized by law as a single unit

ex.en: urban development corporations
ex.cn: 城市开发集团公司

senses.def: a group of people elected to govern a large town or city and provide public services
a tax that companies pay on their profits
the control of a country, etc. by large groups, especially businesses
senses.chn: 社团主义（以产业社团等作为政治代表机关支配人民的活动）

senses.def: an elected member of the government of a town or city
that can be touched; physical rather than spiritual

ex.en: his corporeal presence
ex.cn: 他的大驾亲临

senses.def: of or for the body
senses.chn: 身体的；肉体的；身体所需的

ex.en: corporeal needs
ex.cn: 身体的需要

senses.def: a large unit of an army, consisting of two or more divisions
senses.chn: （由两个或以上师组成的）军，兵团

ex.en: the commander of the third army corps
ex.cn: 陆军第三军团的指挥官

senses.def: one of the groups of an army with a special responsibility

ex.en: the Royal Army Medical Corps
ex.cn: 英国皇家陆军医疗队

senses.def: a group of people involved in a particular job or activity
senses.chn: （从事某工作或活动的）一群人，一组人

ex.en: a corps of trained and experienced doctors
ex.cn: 一队训练有素并富有经验的医生

senses.def: dancers in a ballet company who dance together as a group
a dead body, especially of a human
senses.chn: 尸体；（尤指人的）死尸，尸首

senses.def: fat. People say 'corpulent' to avoid saying 'fat'.
senses.chn: 发福的，福态的（委婉说法，与 fat 同义）

senses.def: a collection of written or spoken texts
senses.chn: （书面或口语的）文集，文献，汇编；语料库

ex.en: a corpus of 100 million words of spoken English
ex.cn: 含有 1 亿单词的英语口语语料库

ex.en: the whole corpus of Renaissance poetry
ex.cn: 文艺复兴时期诗歌的总汇

senses.def: a city in the US state of Texas
senses.chn: 科珀斯克里斯蒂（美国得克萨斯州城市）

senses.def: any of the red or white cells found in blood

ex.en: red/white corpuscles
ex.cn: 红血球；白血球

senses.def: the circumstances in which a law is broken, and the facts relating to the case
evidence that can be seen, for example a dead body
senses.chn: 犯罪事实的证据（如尸体）

senses.def: (in N America) a fenced area for horses, cows, etc. on a farm or ranch

ex.en: They drove the ponies into a corral.
ex.cn: 他们把矮种马赶进了畜栏。

senses.def: to force horses or cows into a corral
senses.chn: 把（马或牛）赶入围栏（或关进畜栏）

senses.def: to gather a group of people together and keep them in a particular place
senses.chn: 把（一群人）集中起来关在一起

senses.def: accurate or true, without any mistakes
senses.chn: 准确无误的；精确的；正确的

ex.en: Do you have the correct time?
ex.cn: 你的表走得准吗？

ex.en: the correct answer
ex.cn: 正确答案

ex.en: Please check that these details are correct.
ex.cn: 请检查这些细节是否准确无误。

ex.en: 'Are you in charge here?' 'That's correct.'
ex.cn: “你是这里的负责人吗？” “是的。”

ex.en: Am I correct in saying that you know a lot about wine?
ex.cn: 你对酒了解颇深，我说得对吧？

ex.en: Are the following statements true or false?
ex.cn: 下列说法是对还是错？

senses.def: right and suitable, so that sth is done as it should be done

ex.en: Do you know the correct way to shut the machine down?
ex.cn: 你知道这台机器该怎么关吗？

ex.en: I think you've made the correct decision.
ex.cn: 我认为你的决定是正确的。

ex.en: You're right to be cautious.
ex.cn: 你谨慎是应当的。

ex.en: You made the right decision.
ex.cn: 你的决定是正确的。

ex.en: 'It's not easy.' 'Yes, you're right.'
ex.cn: “这不容易。” “对，你说得没错。”

ex.en: What's the correct way to shut the machine down?
ex.cn: 这台机器应该怎么关？

senses.def: taking care to speak or behave in a way that follows the accepted standards or rules
senses.chn: （举止言谈）符合公认准则的，得体的

ex.en: a correct young lady
ex.cn: 举止得体的年轻女士

ex.en: He is always very correct in his speech.
ex.cn: 他说话总是很有分寸。

senses.def: used to say that all the things or people who should be there are now there
senses.chn: 全到无误；应在场的都在场了

senses.def: to make sth right or accurate, for example by changing it or removing mistakes

ex.en: Read through your work and correct any mistakes that you find.
ex.cn: 从头至尾看一遍你们的作业，发现的错误都要改正过来。

ex.en: Their eyesight can be corrected in just a few minutes by the use of a laser.
ex.cn: 他们的视力用激光只要几分钟就可矫正。

ex.en: They issued a statement correcting the one they had made earlier.
ex.cn: 他们发表了一份声明，更正早先声明中的错误。

senses.def: to mark the mistakes in a piece of work (and sometimes give a mark/grade to the work)

ex.en: I spent all evening correcting essays.
ex.cn: 我整个晚上都在批改论文。

senses.def: to tell sb that they have made a mistake

ex.en: Correct me if I'm wrong, but isn't this last year's brochure?
ex.cn: 这不是去年的小册子吗？若是我说错了就请指出。

ex.en: Yes, you're right— I stand corrected (= I accept that I made a mistake).
ex.cn: 是的，你说得对。承蒙指正。

ex.en: 'It's Yates, not Wates,' she corrected him.
ex.cn: “那是 Yates 而不是 Wates。” 她纠正他道。

ex.en: I'll be there at five fifteen, I mean five fifty—ten to six.
ex.cn: 我会在 5 点 15 分到那儿，不，应该是 5 点 50 分，差 10 分钟 6 点。

ex.en: It'll be Tuesday— sorry, I meant to say Thursday.
ex.cn: 那就是星期二。不对，我想说的是星期四。

ex.en: Sorry, what I mean is, we need two handouts per person.
ex.cn: 抱歉，我的意思是我们每个人需要两份讲义。

senses.def: a change that makes sth more accurate than it was before

ex.en: I've made a few small corrections to your report.
ex.cn: 我对你的报告作了几处小的修改。

ex.en: The paper had to publish a correction to the story.
ex.cn: 这家报纸不得不对这则新闻报道发一个更正。

senses.def: the act or process of correcting sth

ex.en: There are some programming errors that need correction.
ex.cn: 有一些程序错误需要改正。

senses.def: punishment

ex.en: the correction of young offenders
ex.cn: 对失足青少年的管教

senses.def: used when you want to correct sth that you have just said
senses.chn: （想纠正刚说过的话时用）改正，更正

ex.en: I don't know. Correction—I do know, but I'm not going to tell you.
ex.cn: 我不知道。不，我知道不假，但不打算告诉你。

senses.def: concerned with improving the behaviour of criminals, usually by punishing them

ex.en: a correctional center/institution/facility (= a prison)
ex.cn: 监狱

senses.def: a white liquid that you use to cover mistakes that you make when you are writing or typing, and that you can write on top of
designed to make sth right that was wrong before

ex.en: We need to take corrective action to halt this country's decline.
ex.cn: 我们得采取纠偏行动来阻止这个国家的衰落。

ex.en: corrective measures
ex.cn: 纠偏措施

ex.en: corrective surgery/glasses
ex.cn: 矫正外科／眼镜

senses.def: something that helps to give a more accurate or fairer view of sb/sth
senses.chn: 起纠正作用的东西；修改；纠正

ex.en: I should like to add a corrective to what I have written previously.
ex.cn: 我想对我先前写的内容进行补充修改。

senses.def: if two or more facts, figures, etc. correlate or if a fact, figure, etc. correlates with another, the facts are closely connected and affect or depend on each other
senses.chn: 相互关联影响；相互依赖

ex.en: The figures do not seem to correlate.
ex.cn: 这些数字似乎毫不相干。

ex.en: A high-fat diet correlates with a greater risk of heart disease.
ex.cn: 高脂肪饮食与增加心脏病发作的风险密切相关。

senses.def: to show that there is a close connection between two or more facts, figures, etc.
senses.chn: 显示（两个或多个事实或数字等）的紧密联系

ex.en: Researchers are trying to correlate the two sets of figures.
ex.cn: 研究人员正试图展示这两组数字的相关性。

senses.def: a connection between two things in which one thing changes as the other does

ex.en: There is a direct correlation between exposure to sun and skin cancer.
ex.cn: 暴露在太阳下与皮肤癌直接相关。

ex.en: the correlation of social power with wealth
ex.cn: 社会权力与财富的相关性

senses.def: a fact or an idea that is closely related to or depends on another fact or idea
to be the same as or match sth

ex.en: Your account and hers do not correspond.
ex.cn: 你说的情况与她说的不相符。

ex.en: Your account of events does not correspond with hers.
ex.cn: 你对事情的陈述与她说的不相符。

ex.en: The written record of the conversation doesn't correspond to (= is different from) what was actually said.
ex.cn: 那次谈话的文字记录与原话不符。

senses.def: to be similar to or the same as sth else

ex.en: The British job of Lecturer corresponds roughly to the US Associate Professor.
ex.cn: 英国的讲师职位大致相当于美国的副教授。

senses.def: to write letters to sb and receive letters from them
the letters a person sends and receives

ex.en: personal/private correspondence
ex.cn: 私人来往信件

ex.en: The editor welcomes correspondence from readers on any subject.
ex.cn: 编辑欢迎读者有关任何问题的来信。

ex.en: the correspondence column/page (= in a newspaper)
ex.cn: 读者来信专栏／版面

ex.en: Jane Austen's correspondence with her sister
ex.cn: 简 · 奥斯汀与她姐姐的往来信件

senses.def: the activity of writing letters

ex.en: I refused to enter into any correspondence (= to exchange letters) with him about it.
ex.cn: 我拒绝就此问题与他通信联系。

ex.en: We have been in correspondence for months.
ex.cn: 我们通信几个月了。

ex.en: We kept up a correspondence for many years.
ex.cn: 我们保持了很多年的通信联系。

senses.def: a connection between two things; the fact of two things being similar

ex.en: There is a close correspondence between the two extracts.
ex.cn: 这两段摘录如出一辙。

senses.def: a course of study that you do at home, using books and exercises sent to you by post/mail or by email
a person who reports news from a particular country or on a particular subject for a newspaper or a television or radio station

ex.en: the BBC's political correspondent
ex.cn: 英国广播公司的政治新闻记者

ex.en: a foreign/war/sports, etc. correspondent
ex.cn: 驻外、战地、体育等记者

ex.en: our Delhi correspondent
ex.cn: 我们驻德里的通讯员

senses.def: a person who writes letters to another person

ex.en: She's a poor correspondent (= she does not write regularly).
ex.cn: 她是个懒于写信的人。

senses.def: matching or connected with sth that you have just mentioned

ex.en: A change in the money supply brings a corresponding change in expenditure.
ex.cn: 货币供应量的改变随即引起支出的相应改变。

ex.en: Profits have risen by 15 per cent compared with the corresponding period last year.
ex.cn: 与去年同期相比利润增长了 15%。

ex.en: The Redskins lost to the Cowboys in the corresponding game last year.
ex.cn: 在去年两队的交锋中，红皮队输给了牛仔队。

ex.en: Give each picture a number corresponding to its position on the page.
ex.cn: 按所在页面位置给每一幅画编上相对应的号码。

senses.def: equal angles formed on the same side of a line that crosses two parallel lines
a long narrow passage in a building, with doors that open into rooms on either side

ex.en: His room is along the corridor.
ex.cn: 他的房间就在走廊边。

senses.def: a passage on a train
a long narrow strip of land belonging to one country that passes through the land of another country; a part of the sky over a country that planes, for example from another country, can fly through
senses.chn: 走廊（一国领土通过他国境内的狭长地带）；空中走廊（一国领空中允许他国飞机经过的区域）

senses.def: a long narrow strip of land that follows the course of an important road or river
senses.chn: （沿着重要道路或河道的）狭长地带

ex.en: the electronics industry in the M4 corridor
ex.cn: 4 号高速公路沿线一带的电子工业区

senses.def: the higher levels of government, where important decisions are made
senses.chn: 权力走廊（高层政治决策机构）

senses.def: a round hollow area in the side of a mountain
to provide evidence or information that supports a statement, theory, etc.

ex.en: The evidence was corroborated by two independent witnesses.
ex.cn: 此证据被两名独立证人证实。

ex.en: corroborating evidence
ex.cn: 证实的证据

senses.def: giving support to a statement or theory
senses.chn: （对陈述或理论）提供支持的；使确凿的

ex.en: Is there any corroborative evidence for this theory?
ex.cn: 是否有进一步说明问题的论据来支持这个理论？

senses.def: to destroy sth slowly, especially by chemical action; to be destroyed in this way

ex.en: Acid corrodes metal.
ex.cn: 酸腐蚀金属。

ex.en: Corruption corrodes public confidence in a political system.
ex.cn: 腐败可削弱公众对政治制度的信心。

ex.en: The copper pipework has corroded in places.
ex.cn: 铜管有几处受到了腐蚀。

senses.def: tending to destroy sth slowly by chemical action

ex.en: the corrosive effects of salt water
ex.cn: 盐水的腐蚀作用

ex.en: corrosive acid
ex.cn: 具有腐蚀作用的酸

senses.def: tending to damage sth gradually
senses.chn: 损害性的；逐渐起破坏作用的

ex.en: Unemployment is having a corrosive effect on our economy.
ex.cn: 失业对我国的经济起着破坏作用。

senses.def: shaped into a series of regular folds that look like waves

ex.en: a corrugated iron roof
ex.cn: 波纹铁屋顶

ex.en: corrugated cardboard
ex.cn: 瓦楞纸板

senses.def: willing to use their power to do dishonest or illegal things in return for money or to get an advantage
senses.chn: 贪污的；受贿的；腐败的；营私舞弊的

ex.en: a corrupt regime
ex.cn: 贪污腐败的政权

ex.en: corrupt officials accepting bribes
ex.cn: 接受贿赂的贪官污吏

senses.def: dishonest or immoral

ex.en: corrupt practices
ex.cn: 徇私舞弊

ex.en: The whole system is inefficient and corrupt.
ex.cn: 整个体系都效率低下并且腐败堕落。

senses.def: containing changes or faults, and no longer in the original state
senses.chn: 已变换的；有缺陷的；有错误的

ex.en: corrupt software
ex.cn: 已受损的软件

ex.en: The file on the disk seems to be corrupt.
ex.cn: 这张磁盘上的文件好像有错误。

senses.def: to have a bad effect on sb and make them behave in an immoral or dishonest way

ex.en: He was corrupted by power and ambition.
ex.cn: 权力与野心使他腐化堕落。

ex.en: the corrupting effects of great wealth
ex.cn: 巨大财富的腐蚀作用

senses.def: to change the original form of sth, so that it is damaged or spoiled in some way

ex.en: a corrupted form of Buddhism
ex.cn: 一种蜕变了的佛教

senses.def: to cause mistakes to appear in a computer file, etc. with the result that the information in it is no longer correct

senses.def: an act or a sound of coughing

ex.en: She gave a little cough to attract my attention.
ex.cn: 她轻轻地咳了一声以引起我的注意。

senses.def: an illness or infection that makes you cough often

ex.en: to have a dry/persistent/hacking cough
ex.cn: 干咳；顽固的咳嗽；频咳

ex.en: My cold's better, but I can't seem to shake off this cough.
ex.cn: 我感冒好些了，但这咳嗽好像老也不好。

senses.def: the action of coughing

ex.en: Another fit of coughing seized him.
ex.cn: 他那咳嗽又一次发作了。

senses.def: liquid medicine that you take for a cough
to give sth, especially money, unwillingly

ex.en: Steve finally coughed up the money he owed us.
ex.cn: 史蒂夫最终勉强归还了他欠我们的钱。

senses.def: used as the past tense of 'can'

ex.en: She said that she couldn't come.
ex.cn: 她说她来不了。

ex.en: I couldn't hear what they were saying.
ex.cn: 我听不见他们在说些什么。

ex.en: Sorry, I couldn't get any more.
ex.cn: 对不起，我无法弄到更多了。

ex.en: Can you play the piano?
ex.cn: 你会弹钢琴吗？

ex.en: I can hear someone calling.
ex.cn: 我听见有人在呼叫。

ex.en: The podcast can be downloaded here.
ex.cn: 播客可在此下载。

senses.def: used to ask if you can do sth

ex.en: Could I use your phone, please?
ex.cn: 请让我用一下你的电话可以吗？

ex.en: Could we stop by next week?
ex.cn: 我们下周能过来一下吗？

senses.def: used to politely ask sb to do sth for you
senses.chn: （礼貌地请求别人做事）能，可以

ex.en: Could you babysit for us on Friday?
ex.cn: 你星期五帮我们看一下孩子好吗？

senses.def: used to show that sth is or might be possible

ex.en: I could do it now, if you like.
ex.cn: 如果你愿意的话，我现在就可以做这事。

ex.en: Don't worry—they could have just forgotten to call.
ex.cn: 别担心，他们可能只是忘了打电话。

ex.en: You couldn't have left it on the bus, could you?
ex.cn: 你不可能把它落在公共汽车上了吧？

ex.en: 'Have some more cake.' 'Oh, I couldn't, thank you (= I'm too full).'
ex.cn: “再来点蛋糕吧。” “谢谢你，我吃不下了。”

senses.def: used to suggest sth

ex.en: We could write a letter to the director.
ex.cn: 我们不妨给主管写封信。

ex.en: You could always try his home number.
ex.cn: 你总可以试着给他往家里打电话呀。

senses.def: used to show that you are annoyed that sb did not do sth
senses.chn: （对某人未做某事表示恼怒）本来可以

ex.en: They could have let me know they were going to be late!
ex.cn: 他们要晚来，也该早告诉我一声呀！

senses.def: used to emphasize how strongly you want to express your feelings

ex.en: I'm so fed up I could scream!
ex.cn: 我烦透了，非大喊大叫不可！

ex.en: He can speak three languages.
ex.cn: 他会说三种语言。

ex.en: She will try and visit tomorrow.
ex.cn: 她明天将设法去参观。

ex.en: You must find a job.
ex.cn: 你必须找到一份工作。

ex.en: You ought to stop smoking.
ex.cn: 你应当戒烟。

ex.en: I used to smoke but I gave up two years ago.
ex.cn: 我过去抽烟，但两年前就戒了。

senses.def: used to say that you need or would like to have sth

ex.en: I could do with a drink!
ex.cn: 我真想喝一杯！

ex.en: Her hair could have done with a wash.
ex.cn: 她的头发该洗一洗了。

senses.def: used to say that you need or would like to have sth

ex.en: I could do with a drink!
ex.cn: 我真想喝一杯！

ex.en: Her hair could have done with a wash.
ex.cn: 她的头发该洗一洗了。

senses.def: used to say, often rudely, that you do not think that sb/sth is important or worth worrying about
senses.chn: （常用于无礼地表示）不在乎，不在意

ex.en: Quite honestly, I couldn't care less what they do.
ex.cn: 说实在的，我才不在乎他们做什么。

senses.def: a thin fruit sauce
a unit for measuring electric charge
a group of people who are elected to govern an area such as a city or county
senses.chn: （市、郡等的）政务委员会，地方议会

ex.en: a city/county/borough/district council
ex.cn: 市／郡／自治市／区政务委员会

ex.en: She's on the local council.
ex.cn: 她是地方议会的议员。

ex.en: a council member/meeting
ex.cn: 政务委员会委员／会议

senses.def: the organization that provides services in a city or county, for example education, houses, libraries, etc.
senses.chn: 市政（或地方管理）服务机构

ex.en: council workers/services
ex.cn: 市政工作人员／部门

senses.def: a group of people chosen to give advice, make rules, do research, provide money, etc.
senses.chn: （顾问、立法、研究、基金等）委员会

ex.en: the Medical Research Council
ex.cn: 医学研究会

ex.en: In Britain, the Arts Council gives grants to theatres.
ex.cn: 英国的艺术委员会向剧院提供资金。

senses.def: (especially in the past) a formal meeting to discuss what action to take in a particular situation
senses.chn: （尤指旧时讨论采取什么行动的）协商会议

ex.en: The King held a council at Nottingham from 14 to 19 October 1330.
ex.cn: 国王于 1330 年 10 月 14 日至 19 日在诺丁汉召集协商会议。

senses.def: a large room in which a council meets
a large group of houses built by a local council
senses.chn: 地方当局所属地产；地方政府建的住宅群

senses.def: a house or flat rented from the local council
senses.chn: 地方政府出租的住房（或公寓）

senses.def: a house or flat rented from the local council
senses.chn: 地方政府出租的住房（或公寓）

senses.def: a member of a council
senses.chn: 市议员；政务委员会委员

ex.en: Councillor Ann Jones
ex.cn: 安 · 琼斯委员

ex.en: Talk to your local councillor about the problem.
ex.cn: 关于这个问题可与你那里的政务委员谈一谈。

senses.def: a meeting to discuss how to deal with an urgent and difficult situation
senses.chn: （为处理紧急和困难局势而召开的）紧急会议

senses.def: (in Britain) a tax charged by local councils, based on the value of a person's home
senses.chn: （英国根据个人住房的价值而收取的）市政税

senses.def: advice, especially given by older people or experts; a piece of advice
senses.chn: （尤指年长者或专家的）劝告，忠告，建议

ex.en: Listen to the counsel of your elders.
ex.cn: 要听从长辈的忠告。

ex.en: In the end, wiser counsels prevailed.
ex.cn: 高明的建议最终占了上风。

senses.def: a lawyer or group of lawyers representing sb in court

ex.en: to be represented by counsel
ex.cn: 由律师代表

ex.en: the counsel for the defence/prosecution
ex.cn: 被告／原告的律师

ex.en: defence/prosecuting counsel
ex.cn: 被告／原告的律师

ex.en: The court then heard counsel for the dead woman's father.
ex.cn: 法庭接着听取了女死者的父亲所请律师的陈述。

ex.en: district attorney
ex.cn: 地方检察官

ex.en: counsel for the prosecution
ex.cn: 控方律师

senses.def: advice not to try to do sth because it is too difficult
advice that is good but that is difficult or impossible to follow
senses.chn: 听上去完美却难以实行的建议

senses.def: to keep your opinions, plans, etc. secret
senses.chn: 将自己意见（或计划等）保密；不暴露自己的意图

senses.def: to listen to and give support or professional advice to sb who needs help

ex.en: Therapists were brought in to counsel the bereaved.
ex.cn: 请了治疗专家来给死者的亲属做心理辅导。

senses.def: to advise sb to do sth

ex.en: Most experts counsel caution in such cases.
ex.cn: 大多数专家建议在这样的情况下要谨慎从事。

ex.en: He counselled them to give up the plan.
ex.cn: 他建议他们放弃此项计划。

senses.def: professional advice about a problem

ex.en: marriage guidance counselling
ex.cn: 婚姻指导咨询

ex.en: a student counselling service
ex.cn: 学生辅导服务

senses.def: a person who has been trained to advise people with problems, especially personal problems
senses.chn: （尤指针对私人问题的）顾问；辅导顾问

ex.en: a marriage guidance counsellor
ex.cn: 婚姻指导顾问

senses.def: a lawyer
a person who is in charge of young people at a summer camp
to say numbers in the correct order

ex.en: Billy can't count yet.
ex.cn: 比利还不会数数。

ex.en: She can count up to 10 in Italian.
ex.cn: 她可以用意大利语数到 10。

ex.en: to count from 1 to 10
ex.cn: 从 1 数到 10

senses.def: to calculate the total number of people, things, etc. in a particular group

ex.en: The diet is based on counting calories.
ex.cn: 这个饮食安排以热量统计为根据。

ex.en: She began to count up how many guests they had to invite.
ex.cn: 她开始计算他们得邀请多少位客人。

ex.en: There are 12 weeks to go, counting from today.
ex.cn: 从今天算起还有 12 个星期。

senses.def: to include sb/sth when you calculate a total

ex.en: We have invited 50 people, not counting the children.
ex.cn: 不算小孩，我们邀请了 50 人。

senses.def: to be important

ex.en: Every point in this game counts.
ex.cn: 这场比赛每一分都很重要。

ex.en: It's the thought that counts (= used about a small but kind action or gift).
ex.cn: 贵在心意。

ex.en: The fact that she had apologized counted for nothing with him.
ex.cn: 她已道歉，但他认为这没有用。

senses.def: to be officially accepted; to accept sth officially

ex.en: Don't go over that line or your throw won't count.
ex.cn: 别越过那条线，否则你的投掷就会被判无效。

ex.en: Applications received after 1 July will not be counted.
ex.cn: 7 月 1 日以后收到的申请书将不予受理。

senses.def: to consider sb/sth in a particular way; to be considered in a particular way

ex.en: For tax purposes that money counts/is counted as income.
ex.cn: 那笔钱算作收入，需要纳税。

ex.en: I count him among my closest friends.
ex.cn: 我把他看作我最亲密的朋友之一。

ex.en: I count myself lucky to have known him.
ex.cn: 和他相识，我觉得很幸运。

ex.en: She counts herself one of the lucky ones.
ex.cn: 她认为自己是一个幸运儿。

senses.def: used to say that the total number of sb/sth is very small
used to say that a total is continuing to increase

ex.en: The movie's ticket sales add up to $39 million, and counting.
ex.cn: 这部电影的票房共 3 900 万元，还在继续上升。

senses.def: to be grateful for the good things in your life
you should not be too confident that sth will be successful, because sth may still go wrong
senses.chn: 不要蛋未孵化先数小鸡；别过早打如意算盘

senses.def: to feel the bad effects of a mistake, an accident, etc.
senses.chn: 感受（错误、事故等造成的）不利后果

ex.en: The town is now counting the cost of its failure to provide adequate flood protection.
ex.cn: 这个镇未采取充分的防洪措施，现在尝到苦头了。

senses.def: to imagine that sheep are jumping over a fence and to count them, as a way of getting to sleep
senses.chn: 数（假想中跳过栅栏的）羊以求入睡

senses.def: to say publicly that you support sb or you agree with sth
used to say that you do not care how many times sth happens
senses.chn: （表示不管发生多少次）谁在乎呢，管它呢

ex.en: I've seen the film five times, but who's counting?
ex.cn: 这部电影我看了五遍，管它呢。

senses.def: to be considered or to consider sth to be a disadvantage in sb

ex.en: For that job her lack of experience may count against her.
ex.cn: 她缺乏经验可能对她申请那份工作不利。

senses.def: to think about a future event with pleasure or excitement and count the minutes, days, etc. until it happens

ex.en: She's already counting down to the big day.
ex.cn: 她已经在为这一重大日子倒计时了。

senses.def: to include sb in an activity

ex.en: I hear you're organizing a trip to the game next week? Count me in!
ex.cn: 我听说你们将在下周组织旅行去看比赛？把我也算上！

senses.def: to trust sb to do sth or to be sure that sth will happen
senses.chn: 依赖，依靠，指望（某人做某事）；确信（某事会发生）

ex.en: 'I'm sure he'll help.' ' Don't count on it.'
ex.cn: “我肯定他会帮忙的。” “那可靠不住。”

ex.en: I'm counting on you to help me.
ex.cn: 我就靠你帮我啦。

ex.en: Few people can count on having a job for life.
ex.cn: 很少人会指望一辈子都干一个工作。

ex.en: We can't count on this warm weather lasting.
ex.cn: 我们不能指望这暖和的天气会持久。

ex.en: You can trust me not to tell anyone.
ex.cn: 你可以相信我不会跟任何人讲。

ex.en: Don't trust what you read in the newspapers!
ex.cn: 别相信你在报纸上读到的！

senses.def: to count things one after the other as you put them somewhere

ex.en: She counted out $70 in $10 bills.
ex.cn: 她数出了 70 美元，都是 10 美元一张的。

senses.def: to not include sb in an activity

ex.en: If you're going out tonight you'll have to count me out.
ex.cn: 假如你们今晚要出去，就别把我算在内。

senses.def: to be included as part of sth that you hope to achieve in the future
senses.chn: 被包括在内（成为将来所得的一部分）

ex.en: Students gain college credits which count towards their degree.
ex.cn: 学生获得的学分将计入其学位积分。

senses.def: an act of counting to find the total number of sth; the total number that you find

ex.en: The bus driver did a quick count of the empty seats.
ex.cn: 公共汽车司机很快地数了数空位。

ex.en: If the election result is close, there will be a second count.
ex.cn: 如果选举结果很接近，将进行第二次计票。

ex.en: The body count (= the total number of people who have died) stands at 24.
ex.cn: 死亡人数总计为 24 人。

senses.def: an act of saying numbers in order beginning with 1

ex.en: Raise your leg and hold for a count of ten.
ex.cn: 抬起一条腿，保持这一姿势，直至数到十。

ex.en: He was knocked to the ground and stayed down for a count of eight (= in boxing).
ex.cn: 他被击倒在地，躺在地上直至数到八（拳击用语）。

senses.def: a measurement of the amount of sth contained in a particular substance or area
senses.chn: （某物质在某物或面积中）量的计数

ex.en: a raised white blood cell count
ex.cn: 升高了的白血球数

senses.def: a crime that sb is accused of committing

ex.en: They were found guilty on all counts.
ex.cn: 他们被判各项罪名成立。

ex.en: She appeared in court on three counts of fraud.
ex.cn: 她因三项诈骗罪而出庭受审。

senses.def: a point made during a discussion or an argument
senses.chn: （讨论或争论的）论点，观点，问题，事项

ex.en: I disagree with you on both counts.
ex.cn: 我对你的两个观点均不敢苟同。

senses.def: (in some European countries) a in Britain
senses.chn: 伯爵（欧洲一些国家相当于英国 earl 的贵族封号）

ex.en: Count Tolstoy
ex.cn: 托尔斯泰伯爵

senses.def: according to the latest information about the numbers of sth
senses.chn: 根据有关…数字的最新消息

ex.en: She'd applied for 30 jobs at the last count.
ex.cn: 根据有关的最新消息她申请过 30 个职位。

senses.def: to remember or keep a record of numbers or amounts of sth over a period of time
senses.chn: （在一段时期内）记得数目，数得清，记录

ex.en: Keep a count of your calorie intake for one week.
ex.cn: 把你一星期的卡路里摄入量记录下来。

senses.def: to forget the total of sth before you have finished counting it

ex.en: I lost count and had to start again.
ex.cn: 我数着数着忘了，不得不又从头开始数。

ex.en: She had lost count of the number of times she'd told him to be careful (= she could not remember because there were so many).
ex.cn: 她不知多少次告诉过他要小心。

senses.def: unable to get up again within ten seconds after being knocked down
senses.chn: （被击倒后的十秒钟以内）无法再站立起来

senses.def: in a deep sleep
a noun that is countable can be used in the plural or with a or an, for example table, cat and idea
to be considered or to consider sth to be a disadvantage in sb

ex.en: For that job her lack of experience may count against her.
ex.cn: 她缺乏经验可能对她申请那份工作不利。

senses.def: the action of counting seconds backwards to zero, for example before a spacecraft is launched
senses.chn: 倒数读秒，倒计时（如发射宇宙飞船时）

senses.def: the period of time just before sth important happens

ex.en: the countdown to the wedding
ex.cn: 婚礼的临近

senses.def: a person's face or their expression
to support sth or agree to sth happening

ex.en: The committee refused to countenance his proposals.
ex.cn: 委员会拒不同意他的方案。

senses.def: a long flat surface over which goods are sold or business is done in a shop/store, bank, etc.

ex.en: I asked the woman behind the counter if they had any postcards.
ex.cn: 我问柜台后面的女售货员是否有明信片。

senses.def: a flat surface in a kitchen for preparing food on
a small disc used for playing or scoring in some board games
an electronic device for counting sth

ex.en: The needle on the rev counter soared.
ex.cn: 转速计的指针猛升。

senses.def: a response to sb/sth that opposes their ideas, position, etc.

ex.en: The employers' association was seen as a counter to union power.
ex.cn: 雇主协会被看作是工会权力的对头。

senses.def: goods, especially medicines, for sale over the counter can be bought without a prescription (= written permission from a doctor to buy a medicine) or special licence

ex.en: These tablets are available over the counter.
ex.cn: 这些药片不用处方就可买到。

senses.def: goods that are bought or sold under the counter are sold secretly and sometimes illegally
senses.chn: （商品销售）秘密地，暗地里，非法地

senses.def: to reply to sb by trying to prove that what they said is not true

ex.en: Such arguments are not easily countered.
ex.cn: 这种论点不易反驳。

ex.en: I tried to argue but he countered that the plans were not yet finished.
ex.cn: 我试图争辩，但他却申辩说各项计划尚未完成。

ex.en: 'But I was standing right here!' he countered.
ex.cn: “但我那时就站在这儿！” 他反驳道。

ex.en: Butler has countered with a lawsuit against the firm.
ex.cn: 巴特勒反诉了这家公司。

senses.def: to do sth to reduce or prevent the bad effects of sth

ex.en: Businesses would like to see new laws to counter late payments of debts.
ex.cn: 商界希望见到对付债务逾期不还的新法律出台。

senses.def: in the opposite direction to sth; in opposition to sth

ex.en: The government's plans run counter to agreed European policy on this issue.
ex.cn: 政府的计划违反了有关这个问题已协商好的欧盟政策。

senses.def: against; opposite

ex.en: counterterrorism
ex.cn: 反恐怖主义

ex.en: counter-argument
ex.cn: 相对立的论点

senses.def: corresponding

ex.en: counterpart
ex.cn: 对方职位相当的人

senses.def: to do sth to reduce or prevent the bad or harmful effects of sth

ex.en: These exercises aim to counteract the effects of stress and tension.
ex.cn: 这些训练动作旨在缓解压力与紧张。

senses.def: an attack made in response to the attack of an enemy or opponent in war, sport or an argument
senses.chn: （战争、体育运动或争论中的）反攻，反击

senses.def: to make an attack in response to the attack of an enemy or opponent in war, sport or an argument
senses.chn: （在战争、体育运动或争论中）反攻，反击

senses.def: to have an equal but opposite effect to sth else
senses.chn: 抗衡；抵消；对…起平衡作用

ex.en: Parents' natural desire to protect their children should be counterbalanced by the child's need for independence.
ex.cn: 父母保护孩子的本能愿望应当与孩子独立的需要相平衡。

senses.def: a thing that has an equal but opposite effect to sth else and can be used to limit the bad effects of sth
senses.chn: 平衡抵消物；平衡重（或块、锤）

ex.en: The accused's right to silence was a vital counterbalance to the powers of the police.
ex.cn: 被告人的沉默权对警方的权力是一种至关重要的抗衡。

senses.def: a very strong spoken or written reply to sth that has been said or written
a claim made in reply to another claim and different from it
in the opposite direction to the movement of the hands of a clock
a way of life and set of ideas that are opposed to those accepted by most of society; a group of people who share such a way of life and such ideas
senses.chn: 反主流文化；反正统文化；反主流文化的群体

senses.def: secret action taken by a country to prevent an enemy country from finding out its secrets
connected with what did not happen or what is not the case

ex.en: counterfactual questions such as 'What if the President had not been assassinated?'
ex.cn: “假如总统没有遇刺会怎么样？” 之类的反事实问题

ex.en: an interesting exercise in counterfactual history
ex.cn: 假设历史并非如此的一个有趣活动

senses.def: made to look exactly like sth in order to trick people into thinking that they are getting the real thing

ex.en: counterfeit watches
ex.cn: 冒牌手表

ex.en: Are you aware these notes are counterfeit?
ex.cn: 你觉察到这些钞票是伪造的吗？

ex.cn: 假如你们今晚要出去，就别把我算在内。

ex.cn: 两年制硕士研究生课程

ex.cn: 有十次讲座的课程

ex.en: He radioed the pilot to change course.
ex.cn: 他用无线电通知飞行员改变航向。

ex.cn: 他们确定了去群岛的航线。

ex.en: The president appears likely to change course on some key issues.
ex.cn: 总统看起来可能要在某些重要问题上改变方针。

ex.en: Politicians are often obliged to steer a course between incompatible interests.
ex.cn: 政治家常常被迫在互不相容的利益集团之间开辟航道。

senses.def: a way of acting in or dealing with a particular situation

ex.en: There are various courses open to us.
ex.cn: 我们有多种处理方法可采取。

ex.cn: 你想推荐什么办法呢？

ex.en: The wisest course would be to say nothing.
ex.cn: 最明智的对策是缄口不语。

senses.def: the way sth develops or should develop

ex.en: an event that changed the course of history
ex.cn: 改变了历史进程的事件

ex.en: The unexpected course of events aroused considerable alarm.
ex.cn: 意外的事态发展引起了相当大的恐慌。

senses.def: any of the separate parts of a meal

ex.en: a four-course dinner
ex.cn: 有四道菜的正餐

ex.cn: 主菜是烤鸭。

senses.chn: 比赛场地；跑道；赛船水道；泳道

ex.en: She was overtaken on the last stretch of the course.
ex.cn: 她在最后一个直道上被超过。

senses.def: the direction a river moves in

ex.en: The path follows the course of the river.
ex.cn: 小路沿河道延伸。

ex.en: to prescribe a course of antibiotics
ex.cn: 开一个疗程抗生素的处方

ex.en: A new damp-proof course could cost £1 000 or more.
ex.cn: 新的防潮层可花掉 1 000 英镑以上。

senses.def: going through a particular process

ex.cn: 新的教科书正在准备之中。

ex.en: He's seen many changes in the course of his long life.
ex.cn: 他在漫长的一生中目睹了许许多多的变化。

ex.en: The company faces major challenges over the course of the next few years.
ex.cn: 这家公司今后几年将面临重大的挑战。

senses.def: when enough time has passed

ex.en: It is possible that in the course of time a cure for cancer will be found.
ex.cn: 治疗癌症的方法终有一天能找到。

ex.cn: 在一般情况下，她不露面，我们也不会觉得有什么可疑之处。

senses.def: used to emphasize that what you are saying is true or correct
senses.chn: （强调所说的话属实或正确）当然

ex.en: 'Don't you like my mother?' 'Of course I do!'
ex.cn: “难道你不喜欢我母亲？” “当然喜欢！”

ex.en: 'Will you be there?' 'Course I will.'
ex.cn: “你会去那里吗？” “当然会。”

senses.def: used as a polite way of giving sb permission to do sth
senses.chn: （允许某人做某事的客气说法）当然

ex.en: 'Can I come, too?' 'Course you can.'
ex.cn: “我也可以来吗？” “当然可以。”

ex.en: 'Can I have one of those pens?' 'Of course—help yourself.'
ex.cn: “我能在那些笔中拿一支吗？” “当然，自己拿吧。”

senses.def: used as a polite way of agreeing with what sb has just said
senses.chn: （礼貌地同意某人刚说的话）当然

ex.en: 'I did all I could to help.' 'Of course,' he murmured gently.
ex.cn: “我尽全力帮忙了。” “当然。” 他轻声低语道。

senses.def: used to show that what you are saying is not surprising or is generally known or accepted
senses.chn: （表示所说的事不令人惊讶或具有普遍性）当然，自然

ex.en: Ben, of course, was the last to arrive.
ex.cn: 本当然是最后一个到的。

ex.en: Of course, there are other ways of doing this.
ex.cn: 当然还有别的方法做这件事。

ex.en: 'Is this the right room for the English class?' 'Yes, it is.'
ex.cn: “这是上英语课的教室吗？” “是的。”

ex.en: 'Can I borrow your dictionary?' 'Certainly.'(formal)
ex.cn: “我可以借用一下你的词典吗？” “当然可以。”（正式）

ex.en: 'Sure.'(informal)
ex.cn: “当然可以。”（非正式）

ex.en: 'Do you mind if I borrow your dictionary?' 'Not at all.'
ex.cn: “我借用一下你的词典行吗？” “没问题。”

senses.def: used to emphasize the fact that you are saying 'no'

ex.en: 'Are you going?' 'Of course not.'
ex.cn: “你要去吗？” “当然不去。”

ex.en: 'Do you mind?' 'No, of course not.'
ex.cn: “你介意吗？” “不，当然不介意。”

senses.def: likely to achieve or do sth because you have already started to do it
senses.chn: （因为已开始做而）很可能做成（或做）

ex.en: The American economy is on course for higher inflation than Britain by the end of the year.
ex.cn: 美国经济很可能在今年年底前出现比英国高的通货膨胀。

senses.def: to develop in the usual way and come to the usual end

ex.en: When her tears had run their course, she felt calmer and more in control.
ex.cn: 等她哭够了，她就比较镇静，比较克制了。

ex.en: With minor ailments the best thing is often to let nature take its course.
ex.cn: 对于小病，往往最好是听其自然。

senses.def: to be in a situation which is almost certain to cause a disagreement or argument
senses.chn: 几乎发生冲突（或争端、纠纷）

ex.en: I was on a collision course with my boss over the sales figures.
ex.cn: 我和我的老板在销售数字问题上差点发生争执。

senses.def: to be moving in a direction in which it is likely that you will crash into sb/sth
senses.chn: 朝着可能会碰撞的方向移动；有可能相撞的趋势

ex.en: A giant iceberg was on a collision course with the ship.
ex.cn: 巨大的冰山朝着可能与船相撞的方向漂移。

senses.def: at the right time and not before
senses.chn: 在适当的时候；到一定的时候

ex.en: Your request will be dealt with in due course.
ex.cn: 你的要求将在适当的时候予以处理。

senses.def: the act of matching people with suitable jobs or tasks
(as) the usual and correct thing to do
senses.chn: （作为）理所当然的事；（当作）常规

ex.en: We always check people's addresses as a matter of course.
ex.cn: 我们总是照例检查一下人们的地址。

senses.def: (to take/find) an acceptable course of action that avoids two extreme positions
senses.chn: （走）中间道路；（取）中庸之道；（采取）折中办法

senses.def: to be just what you would expect to happen or expect sb to do in a particular situation

ex.en: Starting early and working long hours is par for the course in this job.
ex.cn: 开工早、工时长是这份工作的常态。

senses.def: to tell a lie or to do sth in order to prevent the police, etc. from finding out the truth about a crime
to continue doing sth until it has finished or been completed, even though it is difficult

ex.en: Very few of the trainees have stayed the course.
ex.cn: 极少受训者坚持到底。

senses.def: to move or flow quickly
a book for studying from, used regularly in class
computer programs that are designed to be used to teach a subject
work that students do during a course of study, not in exams, that is included in their final mark/grade

ex.en: Coursework accounts for 40% of the final marks.
ex.cn: 课程作业占最后总成绩的 40%。

senses.def: the sport of hunting animals with dogs, using sight rather than smell
senses.chn: 追踪狩猎（凭借猎狗的视力而不是嗅觉追捕猎物）

ex.en: hare coursing
ex.cn: 追踪野兔

senses.def: the place where legal trials take place and where crimes, etc. are judged

ex.en: the civil/criminal courts
ex.cn: 民事／刑事法庭

ex.en: Her lawyer made a statement outside the court.
ex.cn: 她的律师在法庭外面发表了一份声明。

ex.en: She will appear in court tomorrow.
ex.cn: 她明天出庭。

ex.en: They took their landlord to court for breaking the contract.
ex.cn: 因为房东毁约，他们把他告上了法庭。

ex.en: The case took five years to come to court (= to be heard by the court).
ex.cn: 那案件历时五年才被法庭受理。

ex.en: There wasn't enough evidence to bring the case to court (= start a trial).
ex.cn: 没有足够的证据可把此案提交法庭。

senses.def: the people in a court, especially those who make the decisions, such as the judge and jury
senses.chn: 全体出庭人员；（尤指）全体审判人员

ex.en: Please tell the court what happened.
ex.cn: 请向法庭陈述事情的经过。

senses.def: a place where games such as tennis are played

ex.en: a tennis/squash/badminton court
ex.cn: 网球场；壁球场；羽毛球场

ex.en: He won after only 52 minutes on court.
ex.cn: 他上场仅 52 分钟就赢得了胜利。

senses.def: the official place where kings and queens live

ex.en: the court of Queen Victoria
ex.cn: 维多利亚女王的宫廷

senses.def: the king or queen, their family, and the people who work for them and/or give advice to them
used in the names of blocks of flats or apartment buildings, or of some short streets; (in Britain) used in the name of some large houses
senses.chn: （用于套房、公寓或某些短街区的名称）公寓大楼，短街；（英国用于某些大型宅第的名称）宅第，邸宅

senses.def: a large open section of a building, often with a glass roof
senses.chn: 建筑物的开阔部分（常有玻璃房顶）；大厅；馆

ex.en: the food court at the shopping mall
ex.cn: 大型购物中心的食品区

senses.def: to entertain people by telling them interesting or funny things
senses.chn: （讲趣闻或笑话）使人快乐，逗人乐

senses.def: to say that sth is completely wrong or not worth considering, especially in a trial
senses.chn: （尤指在法庭上）指明完全错误，不予考虑，不予受理

ex.en: The charges were thrown out of court.
ex.cn: 这些指控未予受理。

ex.en: Well that's my theory ruled out of court.
ex.cn: 唉，那就是我遭到摒弃的意见。

senses.def: it is your/sb's responsibility to take action next
senses.chn: （球已经丢给你了）下一步就看你的了

ex.en: They've offered me the job, so the ball's in my court now.
ex.cn: 他们已答应把那份工作给我，下一步就看我怎么办了。

senses.def: to completely reject an idea, a story, etc. that you think is not worth taking seriously at all
senses.chn: 对（某主意、说法等）一笑置之；置之不理；不屑一顾

senses.def: to treat sb with great respect in order to gain favour with them
to try to please sb in order to get sth you want, especially the support of a person, an organization, etc.
senses.chn: （为有所求，尤指为寻求支持而）试图取悦，讨好，争取

ex.en: Both candidates have spent the last month courting the media.
ex.cn: 两位候选人在过去的一个月里都在取悦媒体。

senses.def: to try to obtain sth

ex.en: He has never courted popularity.
ex.cn: 他从不追求名望。

senses.def: to do sth that might result in sth unpleasant happening
senses.chn: 招致，酿成，导致（不愉快的事）

ex.en: to court danger/death/disaster
ex.cn: 招致危险／死亡／灾难

ex.en: As a politician he has often courted controversy.
ex.cn: 作为政治人物，他常常招致争议。

senses.def: if a man courts a woman, he spends time with her and tries to make her love him, so that they can get married
to have a romantic relationship before getting married

ex.en: At that time they had been courting for several years.
ex.cn: 当时他们已经谈了好几年的恋爱了。

senses.def: (of a male bird or other animal) to try to attract a mate
a playing card with a picture of a king, queen or jack on it
senses.chn: 人头牌，花牌（纸牌的 K、Q 或 J）

senses.def: polite, especially in a way that shows respect
senses.chn: 有礼貌的；客气的；（尤指）恭敬的，谦恭的

ex.en: a courteous young man
ex.cn: 彬彬有礼的年轻人

ex.en: The hotel staff are friendly and courteous.
ex.cn: 旅馆服务人员友好而有礼貌。

senses.def: (in the past) a prostitute, especially one with rich customers
senses.chn: （旧时尤指伺候富豪的）高级妓女

senses.def: polite behaviour that shows respect for other people

ex.en: I was treated with the utmost courtesy by the staff.
ex.cn: 我受到了工作人员极有礼貌的接待。

ex.en: It's only common courtesy to tell the neighbours that we'll be having a party (= the sort of behaviour that people would expect).
ex.cn: 告诉邻居我们要举行聚会，这是起码的礼貌。

senses.def: a polite thing that you say or do when you meet people in formal situations
senses.chn: （正式场合见面时的）客气话，礼貌

ex.en: an exchange of courtesies before the meeting
ex.cn: 会议开始前互致问候

senses.def: with the official permission of sb/sth and as a favour

ex.en: The pictures have been reproduced by courtesy of the British Museum.
ex.cn: 承蒙大英博物馆惠允，复制了这些画。

senses.def: given as a prize or provided free by a person or an organization

ex.en: Win a weekend in Rome, courtesy of Fiat.
ex.cn: 赢了就可以获得菲亚特公司提供的到罗马度周末的机会。

senses.def: as the result of a particular thing or situation

ex.en: Viewers can see the stadium from the air, courtesy of a camera fastened to the plane.
ex.cn: 由于飞机上安装有摄像机，电视观众可从空中鸟瞰体育场。

senses.def: to be polite by doing the thing that is mentioned
senses.chn: （做提及的事）对某人表示礼貌

ex.en: Please do me the courtesy of listening to what I'm saying.
ex.cn: 请耐心听一听我的话。

senses.def: to know when you should do sth in order to be polite
senses.chn: 知道何时该做…（以示礼貌）

ex.en: You think he'd at least have the courtesy to call to say he'd be late.
ex.cn: 谁都会觉得他至少应该懂得打个电话说一声他要晚来。

senses.def: provided free, at no cost to the person using it

ex.en: A courtesy bus operates between the hotel and the town centre.
ex.cn: 有免费接送的公共汽车往返于旅馆和市中心之间。

ex.en: The dealer will provide you with a courtesy car while your vehicle is being repaired.
ex.cn: 车辆维修期间，经销商会提供免费使用的汽车。

senses.def: a formal or official visit, usually by one important person to another, just to be polite, not to discuss important business
a telephone call from a company to one of its customers, for example to see if they are satisfied with the company's service
senses.chn: 礼节性征询电话（如公司征询顾客对服务是否满意）

senses.def: a small light inside a car which is automatically switched on when sb opens the door
a title that sb is allowed to use but which has no legal status
a building containing courts of law

ex.en: The prison is opposite the law court.
ex.cn: 监狱在法院对面。

senses.def: (in the US) a building containing the offices of a county government
(especially in the past) a person who is part of the court of a king or queen
extremely polite and full of respect, especially in an old-fashioned way
senses.chn: （尤指老式）极其恭敬有礼的，温文尔雅的

senses.def: a tradition in literature, especially in Medieval times, involving the faithful love of a knight for his married lady , with whom he can never have a relationship
senses.chn: 典雅爱情（尤指中世纪的一种文学传统，指骑士对贵妇人的忠贞但无结果的爱情）

senses.def: a military court that deals with members of the armed forces who break military law; a trial at such a court
senses.chn: 军事法庭；军事法庭的审判；军法审判

ex.en: He was convicted at a court martial.
ex.cn: 他在军事法庭上被判有罪。

ex.en: All the men now face court martial.
ex.cn: 现在所有这些军人都面临军事法庭的审判。

senses.def: to hold a trial of sb in a military court
senses.chn: （在军事法庭上）举行审判；以军法审判

ex.en: He was court-martialled for desertion.
ex.cn: 他因擅离职守受到了军法审判。

senses.def: a court that people can go to in order to try and change decisions that have been made by a lower court
the highest court in Britain (apart from the Supreme Court), that can change decisions made by a lower court
senses.chn: （英国）上诉法院（仅次于最高法院的司法机构）

senses.def: one of the courts in the US that can change decisions made by a lower court
a court in the US that hears claims made against the government
senses.chn: （美国）求偿法院（负责审理对政府的申诉案件）

senses.def: a special official group of people that investigates a particular problem
a room or building where legal cases are judged

ex.en: The prison is opposite the law court.
ex.cn: 监狱在法院对面。

senses.def: in Scotland, the highest court that deals with civil cases (= not criminal cases)
a decision that is made in court about what must happen in a particular situation
a room in which trials or other legal cases are held

ex.en: The prison is opposite the law court.
ex.cn: 监狱在法院对面。

senses.def: the time when two people have a romantic relationship before they get married; the process of developing this relationship

ex.en: They married after a short courtship.
ex.cn: 他们恋爱不久便结婚了。

ex.en: Mr Elton's courtship of Harriet
ex.cn: 埃尔顿先生对哈丽雅特的追求

senses.def: the special way animals behave in order to attract a mate for producing young animals

ex.en: courtship displays
ex.cn: 求偶的炫耀行为

senses.def: the process or act of attracting a business partner, etc.

ex.en: the company's courtship by the government
ex.cn: 政府向公司献殷勤

senses.def: a woman's formal shoe that is plain and does not cover the top part of the foot
senses.chn: 船鞋，半高跟鞋（正式场合穿的素色女鞋）

senses.def: an old form of tennis played inside a building with a hard ball
senses.chn: 庭院网球（使用硬球的旧式室内网球运动）

senses.def: an open space that is partly or completely surrounded by buildings and is usually part of a castle, a large house, etc.
senses.chn: （通常为城堡、大宅第等的）庭院，院子，天井

ex.en: the central/inner courtyard
ex.cn: 中心／内庭院

senses.def: a type of N African food made from crushed wheat; a dish of meat and/or vegetables with couscous
a child of your aunt or uncle
senses.chn: 同辈表亲（或堂亲）；堂兄（或弟、姊、妹）；表兄（或弟、姊、妹）

ex.en: She's my cousin.
ex.cn: 她是我的表妹。

ex.en: We're cousins.
ex.cn: 我们是表亲。

senses.def: a person who is in your wider family but who is not closely related to you

ex.en: He's a distant cousin of mine.
ex.cn: 他是我远房的一个表亲。

senses.def: a way of describing people from another country who are similar in some way to people in your own country
senses.chn: 兄弟的…国人民（对与本民族有某些类似的另一国家人民的说法）

ex.en: our American cousins
ex.cn: 我们兄弟的美国人民

senses.def: a way of describing things that are similar or related in some way

ex.en: Asian elephants are smaller than their African cousins.
ex.cn: 亚洲象比它们的非洲同类小些。

senses.def: a male cousin of your own generation
a female cousin of your own generation
the design and production of expensive and fashionable clothes; these clothes

ex.en: a couture evening dress
ex.cn: 昂贵时髦的晚礼服

senses.def: a person who designs, makes and sells expensive, fashionable clothes, especially for women
senses.chn: （尤指）女装设计师；时装裁缝；女装商人

senses.def: sharing a pair of electrons
showing a tendency to change with another variable
a small bay (= an area of sea that is partly surrounded by land)

ex.en: a secluded cove
ex.cn: 僻静的小海湾

senses.def: a man
a group or meeting of witches
a promise to sb, or a legal agreement, especially one to pay a regular amount of money to sb/sth
senses.chn: 承诺；合同；协约；（尤指定期付款的）契约

ex.en: God's covenant with Abraham
ex.cn: 上帝与亚伯拉罕的立约

ex.en: a covenant to a charity
ex.cn: 向慈善机构定期捐款的契约

senses.def: to refuse to speak to sb, as a way of punishing them for sth that they have done
senses.chn: 拒绝与某人交谈（作为惩罚）

senses.def: an industrial city in the English Midlands. Many of its buildings were destroyed by bombs in World War II, including its cathedral. A new cathedral designed by Basil Spence was built next to the ruins of the old one after the war.
senses.chn: 考文垂（英格兰中部地区的工业城市，包括大教堂在内的许多建筑在二战中被炸毁。战后，在老教堂的废墟旁边修建了一座新的大教堂，由巴兹尔 · 斯彭斯设计）

senses.def: to place sth over or in front of sth in order to hide or protect it

ex.en: Cover the chicken loosely with foil.
ex.cn: 用锡箔把鸡肉松松地盖起来。

ex.en: She covered her face with her hands.
ex.cn: 她双手掩面。

ex.en: He laughed to cover (= hide) his nervousness.
ex.cn: 他哈哈大笑以掩饰他紧张的心情。

ex.en: He hid the letter in a drawer.
ex.cn: 他把信藏在抽屉里。

ex.en: She managed to hide her disappointment.
ex.cn: 她设法掩藏了自己的失望。

ex.en: The paintings were concealed beneath a thick layer of plaster.
ex.cn: 那些画藏在厚厚的灰泥层下面。

senses.def: to lie or spread over the surface of sth

ex.en: Snow covered the ground.
ex.cn: 大雪覆盖了大地。

ex.en: Much of the country is covered by forest.
ex.cn: 森林覆盖着这个国家的大片土地。

senses.def: to put or spread a layer of liquid, dust, etc. on sb/sth
senses.chn: 撒上，洒上，溅上（一层液体、尘土等）

ex.en: The players were soon covered in mud.
ex.cn: 那些运动员很快就浑身溅满了泥。

ex.en: The wind blew in from the desert and covered everything with sand.
ex.cn: 风从沙漠那边吹来，把一切都蒙上了一层沙子。

senses.def: to include sth; to deal with sth

ex.en: The survey covers all aspects of the business.
ex.cn: 调查包括这家企业的各个方面。

ex.en: The lectures covered a lot of ground (= a lot of material, subjects, etc.).
ex.cn: 这些讲座涉及的内容极为广泛丰富。

ex.en: the sales team covering the northern part of the country (= selling to people in that area)
ex.cn: 负责这个国家北部地区的销售队伍

ex.en: Do the rules cover (= do they apply to) a case like this?
ex.cn: 这些规则适用于这样的情况吗？

senses.def: to be or provide enough money for sth

ex.en: $100 should cover your expenses.
ex.cn: 100 美元该足够支付你的费用了。

ex.en: Your parents will have to cover your tuition fees.
ex.cn: 你的父母得支付你的学费。

ex.en: The show barely covered its costs.
ex.cn: 这场演出勉强够本。

senses.def: to travel the distance mentioned

ex.en: By sunset we had covered thirty miles.
ex.cn: 到日落时我们已走了三十英里。

ex.en: They walked for a long time and covered a good deal of ground.
ex.cn: 他们步行了很长时间，走了一大段路。

senses.def: to spread over the area mentioned

ex.en: The reserve covers an area of some 1 140 square kilometres.
ex.cn: 保护区占地面积大约 1 140 平方公里。

senses.def: to report on an event for television, a newspaper, etc.; to show an event on television

ex.en: She's covering the party's annual conference.
ex.cn: 她正在报道这个政党的年会新闻。

ex.en: The BBC will cover all the major games of the tournament.
ex.cn: 英国广播公司将报道这次锦标赛的所有重要赛事。

senses.def: to do sb's work or duties while they are away
senses.chn: 代替，顶替，替补（某人工作或履行职责）

ex.en: I'm covering for Jane while she's on leave.
ex.cn: 简休假时我来顶替她工作。

senses.def: to invent a lie or an excuse that will stop sb from getting into trouble
senses.chn: （为免他人陷入麻烦而用谎话或借口）遮掩，掩盖，敷衍

ex.en: I have to go out for a minute—will you cover for me if anyone asks where I am?
ex.cn: 我得出去一会儿，假如有人问起我在哪里，你能为我搪塞一下吗？

senses.def: to protect sb against loss, injury, etc. by insurance

ex.en: Are you fully covered for fire and theft?
ex.cn: 你是否买了足够的火险和盗窃险？

ex.en: Does this policy cover my husband to drive?
ex.cn: 这份保险单是否保我丈夫的驾车险？

senses.def: to take action in order to protect yourself against being blamed for sth
senses.chn: 采取预防行动（以使自己免遭责备）

ex.en: One reason doctors take temperatures is to cover themselves against negligence claims.
ex.cn: 医生测量体温的一个原因是免得因玩忽职守而遭索赔。

senses.def: to protect sb by threatening to shoot at anyone who tries to attack them

ex.en: Cover me while I move forward.
ex.cn: 掩护我前进。

senses.def: to aim a gun at a place or person so that nobody can escape or shoot
senses.chn: 用枪瞄准（以致无人可逃跑或开枪）

ex.en: The police covered the exits to the building.
ex.cn: 警方用枪封锁了那栋大楼的出口。

ex.en: Don't move—we've got you covered!
ex.cn: 不许动！我们的枪口正对着你们！

senses.def: to record a new version of a song that was originally recorded by another band or singer
senses.chn: 翻唱（原来由另一乐队或歌手演唱的歌曲）

ex.en: They've covered an old Rolling Stones number.
ex.cn: 他们翻唱了滚石乐队的一首老歌。

senses.def: to consider and deal with all the things that could happen or could be needed when you are arranging sth
to realize that you may be blamed or criticized for sth later and take action to avoid this
senses.chn: 粉饰污点；防止可预见的指责

ex.en: Get everything in writing in order to cover your back.
ex.cn: 一切都要立字为据，以绝后患。

senses.def: to try and hide what you have done, because you do not want other people to find out about it

ex.en: He had attempted to cover his tracks by making her death appear like suicide.
ex.cn: 他使她的死亡看起来像是自杀，企图以此掩盖自己的罪行。

senses.def: to hide the real situation or facts when these are not good or pleasant
to put a covering or roof over an open space
to cover sth completely so that it cannot be seen

ex.en: The Roman remains are now covered over by office buildings.
ex.cn: 这些罗马时代的遗址现已被栋栋办公大楼完全遮住。

senses.def: to put on more clothes
to cover sth completely so that it cannot be seen

ex.en: He covered up the body with a sheet.
ex.cn: 他用一条布单把尸体盖上了。

senses.def: to try to stop people from knowing the truth about a mistake, a crime, etc.
senses.chn: 掩盖（错误、罪行等的）真相

senses.def: a thing that is put over or on another thing, usually to protect it or to decorate it
senses.chn: 覆盖物；掩蔽物；套子；罩子

ex.en: a cushion cover
ex.cn: 靠垫套

ex.en: a plastic waterproof cover for the stroller
ex.cn: 手推童车的塑料防水篷

senses.def: a place that provides shelter from bad weather or protection from an attack

ex.en: Everyone ran for cover when it started to rain.
ex.cn: 雨下起来时，大家都跑着找地方避雨。

ex.en: The climbers took cover from the storm in a cave.
ex.cn: 登山者在山洞里躲避暴风雨。

ex.en: After the explosion the street was full of people running for cover.
ex.cn: 爆炸发生以后，满街的人都奔跑着找躲避处。

senses.def: the outside of a book or a magazine

ex.en: the front/back cover
ex.cn: 封面；封底

ex.en: Her face was on the cover (= the front cover) of every magazine.
ex.cn: 各种杂志的封面都有她的头像。

ex.en: He always reads the paper from cover to cover (= everything in it).
ex.cn: 他总是把报纸从头到尾全看一遍。

senses.def: protection that an insurance company provides by promising to pay you money if a particular event happens

ex.en: accident cover
ex.cn: 事故保险

ex.en: cover against accidental damage
ex.cn: 意外损害保险

senses.def: support and protection that is provided when sb is attacking or in danger of being attacked

ex.en: The ships needed air cover (= protection by military planes) once they reached enemy waters.
ex.cn: 一到达敌方的水域，船只就需要空中掩护。

senses.def: trees and plants that grow on an area of land

ex.en: The total forest cover of the earth is decreasing.
ex.cn: 地球上森林覆盖的总面积正在减少。

senses.def: the fact of the sky being covered with cloud or the ground with snow

ex.en: Fog and low cloud cover are expected this afternoon.
ex.cn: 预计今天下午有雾和低空云层。

ex.en: In this area there is snow cover for six months of the year.
ex.cn: 这个地区一年中有六个月被积雪覆盖。

senses.def: the sheets, blankets, etc. on a bed

ex.en: She threw back the covers and leapt out of bed.
ex.cn: 她掀开被子跳下床来。

senses.def: activities or behaviour that seem honest or true but that hide sb's real identity or feelings, or that hide sth illegal
senses.chn: （对身份、感情或违法事情的）掩盖，掩饰

ex.en: His work as a civil servant was a cover for his activities as a spy.
ex.cn: 他以公务员的工作来掩护他搞间谍活动。

ex.en: Her over-confident attitude was a cover for her nervousness.
ex.cn: 她以过分自信的态度来掩饰她紧张的心情。

ex.en: It would only take one phone call to blow their cover (= make known their true identities and what they were really doing).
ex.cn: 只要拨打一个电话就可揭穿他们的伪装。

senses.def: the fact of sb doing another person's job when they are away or when there are not enough staff

ex.en: It's the manager's job to organize cover for staff who are absent.
ex.cn: 安排他人顶替缺席的员工是经理的工作。

ex.en: Ambulance drivers provided only emergency cover during the dispute.
ex.cn: 纠纷期间救护车司机只提供急救替班。

senses.def: to leave a place that you have been hiding in, usually at a high speed
senses.chn: 匆匆离开隐蔽处；冲出躲藏处

senses.def: pretending to be sb else in order to do sth secretly
senses.chn: （为秘密活动）伪装着，装扮着，冒名顶替

ex.en: a police officer working under cover
ex.cn: 做隐蔽工作的警察

senses.def: under a structure that gives protection from the weather
hidden or protected by sth

ex.en: Later, under cover of darkness, they crept into the house.
ex.cn: 后来他们在夜幕的掩护下溜进了房子。

senses.def: in a separate envelope

ex.en: The information you requested is being forwarded to you under separate cover.
ex.cn: 现另函寄上所要资料。

senses.def: used to say that you should not form an opinion about sb/sth from their appearance only
senses.chn: 勿以貌取人；勿只凭外表判断

senses.def: the reporting of news and sport in newspapers and on the radio and television

ex.en: media/newspaper/press coverage
ex.cn: 媒体／报纸／报刊的报道

ex.en: tonight's live coverage of the hockey game
ex.cn: 今晚曲棍球比赛的现场直播

senses.def: the range or quality of information that is included in a book or course of study, on television, etc.
senses.chn: （书、课程学习、电视等的）信息范围，信息质量

ex.en: magazines with extensive coverage of diet and health topics
ex.cn: 包含大量饮食与健康话题的杂志

ex.en: The volume offers an incomplete coverage of the history of philosophy.
ex.cn: 这本书所涵盖的哲学史并不完整。

senses.def: the amount of sth that sth provides; the extent to which sth covers an area or a group of people

ex.en: Immunization coverage against fatal diseases has increased to 99% in some countries.
ex.cn: 在一些国家致命疾病免疫注射的覆盖面已达到 99%。

ex.en: The service has a coverage of 90% of the UK population.
ex.cn: 该服务覆盖了英国 90% 的人口。

senses.def: protection that an insurance company provides by promising to pay you money if a particular event happens

ex.en: insurance coverage
ex.cn: 保险范围

ex.en: Medicaid health coverage for low-income families
ex.cn: 对低收入家庭的医疗保险

senses.def: a loose piece of clothing like a shirt and trousers/pants in one piece, made of heavy cloth and usually worn over other clothing by workers doing dirty work
to consider and deal with all the things that could happen or could be needed when you are arranging sth
an amount of money that you pay in some restaurants or clubs in addition to the cost of the food and drink
senses.chn: （餐馆或俱乐部中饮食之外的）服务费

senses.def: having a layer or amount of sth on it

ex.en: His face was covered in blood.
ex.cn: 他满脸是血。

ex.en: The walls were covered with pictures.
ex.cn: 这些墙上挂满了画。

senses.def: having a roof over it

ex.en: a covered area of the stadium with seats
ex.cn: 体育场有顶的座席区域

senses.def: a large wooden vehicle with a curved roof made of cloth, that is pulled by horses, used especially in the past in N America by people travelling across the land to the west
senses.chn: （尤指旧时用于横跨北美大陆到西部的）大篷马车

senses.def: a young woman whose photograph is on the front of a magazine
a layer of sth that covers sth else

ex.en: a thick covering of snow on the ground
ex.cn: 地上厚厚的一层积雪

senses.def: a layer of material such as carpet or wallpaper, used to cover, decorate and protect floors, walls, etc.

ex.en: floor/wall coverings
ex.cn: 地板／墙壁覆盖物

senses.def: a piece of material that covers sth
senses.chn: 覆盖某物的一块（或一片）材料

ex.en: He pulled the plastic covering off the dead body.
ex.cn: 他拉掉了盖在尸体上的塑料布。

senses.def: a letter containing extra information that you send with sth
a type of bedspread to cover a bed
the main story in a magazine, that goes with the picture shown on the front cover
senses.chn: 封面故事（杂志中与封面图片有关的内容）

senses.def: a story that is invented in order to hide sth, especially a person's identity or their reasons for doing sth
senses.chn: （尤指掩饰身份或做某事原因的）托辞，借口

senses.def: secret or hidden, making it difficult to notice

ex.en: covert operations/surveillance
ex.cn: 暗中活动／监视

ex.en: He stole a covert glance at her across the table.
ex.cn: 他隔着桌子偷偷地瞥了她一眼。

senses.def: an area of thick low bushes and trees where animals can hide
senses.chn: （动物可藏身的）矮树丛，灌木林

senses.def: to put on more clothes
action that is taken to hide a mistake or an illegal activity from the public

ex.en: Government sources denied there had been a deliberate cover-up.
ex.cn: 政府方面否认了有故意掩饰的行为。

senses.def: a new recording of an old song by a different band or singer
senses.chn: （由不同乐队演奏或不同歌手演唱的）翻唱版本

senses.def: to realize that you may be blamed or criticized for sth later and take action to avoid this
senses.chn: 粉饰污点；防止可预见的指责

ex.en: Get everything in writing in order to cover your back.
ex.cn: 一切都要立字为据，以绝后患。

senses.def: to put on more clothes
to try and hide what you have done, because you do not want other people to find out about it

ex.en: He had attempted to cover his tracks by making her death appear like suicide.
ex.cn: 他使她的死亡看起来像是自杀，企图以此掩盖自己的罪行。

senses.def: to want sth very much, especially sth that belongs to sb else
senses.chn: 渴望；贪求（尤指别人的东西）；觊觎

ex.en: He had long coveted the chance to work with a famous musician.
ex.cn: 他一直渴望有机会与著名音乐家合作。

ex.en: They are this year's winners of the coveted trophy (= that everyone would like to win).
ex.cn: 他们获得了本年度人人觊觎的大奖。

senses.def: having a strong desire for the things that other people have
a large animal kept on farms to produce milk or beef

ex.en: cow's milk
ex.cn: 牛奶

ex.en: a herd of dairy cows (= cows kept for their milk)
ex.cn: 一群奶牛

senses.def: the female of the elephant, whale and some other large animals
senses.chn: 雌象；雌鲸；大型雌性动物

senses.def: an offensive word for a woman

ex.en: You stupid cow!
ex.cn: 你这蠢婆娘！

senses.def: an unpleasant person, thing or situation
to become very angry or anxious about sth

ex.en: Don't have a cow—it's no big deal.
ex.cn: 别发火，没什么大不了。

senses.def: for a very long time; for ever
to frighten sb in order to make them obey you

ex.en: She was easily cowed by people in authority.
ex.cn: 她很容易被有权势的人吓住。

senses.def: a person who is not brave or who does not have the courage to do things that other people do not think are especially difficult

ex.en: You coward! What are you afraid of?
ex.cn: 你这胆小鬼！你怕什么呢？

ex.en: I'm a real coward when it comes to going to the dentist.
ex.cn: 我一去看牙医就胆战心惊。

senses.def: fear or lack of courage
a bell that is put around a cow's neck so that the cow can easily be found
a man who rides a horse and whose job is to take care of cattle in the western parts of the US

ex.en: cowboy boots
ex.cn: 牛仔靴

senses.def: a man like this as a character in a film/movie about the American West

ex.en: children playing a game of cowboys and Indians
ex.cn: 玩美国西部牛仔与印第安人游戏的孩子们

senses.def: a dishonest person in business, especially sb who produces work of bad quality or charges too high a price
senses.chn: （尤指产品质量差或索价太高的）奸商

a pointed metal structure at the front of a train that is used for pushing things off the track
a very hard cowpat
made to feel afraid and that you are not as good as sb else
senses.chn: 使感到胆怯的；自惭形秽的

senses.def: to bend low and/or move backwards because you are frightened

ex.en: A gun went off and people cowered behind walls and under tables.
ex.cn: 一声枪响，人们缩到墙后或桌子底下躲起来。

senses.def: a female cowboy in the American West
a person whose job is taking care of cows
strong leather made from the skin of a cow
a large loose covering for the head, worn especially by monks
senses.chn: （尤指修道士戴的）大兜帽，大风帽

senses.chn: 烟囱罩，通风帽（常可随风转动以利通风或排烟）

senses.def: a piece of hair that grows in a different direction from the rest of your hair and is difficult to make lie flat
a metal cover for an engine, especially on an aircraft
senses.chn: 整流罩；（尤指）飞机引擎罩

senses.def: a collar on a woman's sweater that hangs in several folds
a person that sb works with, doing the same kind of job
senses.chn: 共同工作者；合作者；同事；同僚

senses.def: a European wild plant with a lot of very small white flowers that look like lace
senses.chn: 峨参，饰带花（原产欧洲，开小白花）

senses.def: a round flat piece of solid waste from a cow
a type of bean that is white with a black spot and is grown for food

ex.en: Cowpeas are an important crop in many African countries.
ex.cn: 黑眼豆是很多非洲国家的重要作物。

senses.def: a disease caused by a virus, which affects cows and can infect humans. The cowpox virus was used in making vaccines against smallpox.
senses.chn: 牛痘（病毒引起的牛疾病，可传染人类；牛痘病毒过去用于制天花疫苗）

senses.def: a small shiny shell that was used as money in the past in parts of Africa and Asia
senses.chn: 宝贝贝壳（旧时亚非部分地区用作货币的小贝壳）

senses.def: a farm building in which cows are kept
a small wild plant with yellow flowers with a sweet smell
senses.chn: 樱草；欧洲樱草；黄花九轮草；野生报春花

senses.def: the person who controls the direction of a rowing boat while other people are rowing
to control the direction of a rowing boat while other people are rowing; to act as a cox
the person who is in charge of a lifeboat and who controls its direction
shy or pretending to be shy and innocent, especially about love or sex, and sometimes in order to make people more interested in you
senses.chn: （尤指对爱情或性爱）羞羞答答的，假装害羞无知的，故作忸怩的

ex.en: She gave me a coy smile.
ex.cn: 她羞答答地对我笑了笑。

senses.def: not willing to give information about sth, or answer questions that tell people too much about you
senses.chn: 不愿提供信息的；不肯作答的；含糊其词的

ex.en: She was a little coy about how much her dress cost.
ex.cn: 她对她那条连衣裙花了多少钱有点吞吞吐吐。

senses.def: a N American wild animal of the dog family
senses.chn: 丛林狼，草原狼（犬科动物，分布于北美）

senses.def: a large S American animal, like a beaver, that lives near water
warm, comfortable and safe, especially because of being small or confined
senses.chn: （尤指因地方小或封闭而）温暖舒适的

ex.en: a cozy little room
ex.cn: 温暖舒适的小房间

ex.en: a cozy feeling
ex.cn: 惬意的感觉

ex.en: I felt warm and cozy sitting by the fire.
ex.cn: 坐在炉火旁，我感到又暖和又舒服。

senses.def: friendly and private

ex.en: a cozy chat with a friend
ex.cn: 与朋友亲切的闲聊

senses.def: easy and convenient, but not always honest or right
senses.chn: 轻易得到的，轻松的（但不一定是诚实或正当的）

ex.en: The firm has a cozy relationship with the Department of Defense.
ex.cn: 这家公司与国防部关系密切。

ex.en: The danger is that things get too cozy.
ex.cn: 危险在于一切都来得太容易。

senses.def: to act in a friendly way towards sb, especially sb who will be useful to you
to act in a friendly way towards sb, especially sb who will be useful to you

the abbreviation for 'Certificate of Proficiency in English' (a British test, now called 'Cambridge English: Proficiency' that measures a person's ability to speak and write English at a very advanced level)
senses.chn: 熟练英语证书考试，剑桥英语第五级认证（全写为 Certificate of Proficiency in English，现称 Cambridge English: Proficiency，英国考试，检测英语作为外语者的高级口语和写作能力）

senses.def: consumer price index
senses.chn: 居民消费价格指数；消费价格指数

senses.def: corporal
the abbreviation for 'cardiopulmonary resuscitation' (breathing air into the mouth of an unconscious person and pressing on their chest to keep them alive by sending air around their body)
senses.chn: 心肺复苏（全写为 cardiopulmonary resuscitation，包括进行人工呼吸和体外心脏按压）

Canada Revenue Agency (the department of the Canadian government that deals with personal income tax)
a sea creature with a hard shell, eight legs and two pincers (= curved and pointed arms for catching and holding things). Crabs move sideways on land.
meat from a crab, used for food

ex.en: dressed crab
ex.cn: 经加工的螃蟹

senses.def: the condition caused by having lice) in the hair around the genitals (called crab lice) in the hair around the genitals
a tree that produces fruit like small hard sour apples, also called crab apples
senses.chn: 酸苹果树；花红树；沙果树

senses.def: small and difficult to read
bad-tempered and unpleasant
a type of grass that grows where it is not wanted, spreads quickly and is hard to get rid of
senses.chn: 马唐，指草（多为杂草，难以根除）

senses.def: a small pink stick made from pressed pieces of fish that have been flavoured to taste like crab
senses.chn: 蟹肉棒，蟹肉条（用鱼肉糜加香料制成）

senses.def: in a sideways direction, like a crab
senses.chn: 向一边地；横向似螃蟹地

senses.def: to break without dividing into separate parts; to break sth in this way

ex.en: The ice cracked as I stepped onto it.
ex.cn: 我一踩冰就裂了。

ex.en: He has cracked a bone in his arm.
ex.cn: 他的手臂有一处骨裂。

ex.en: Her lips were dry and cracked.
ex.cn: 她的嘴唇干裂了。

senses.def: to break open or into pieces; to break sth in this way

ex.en: A chunk of the cliff had cracked off in a storm.
ex.cn: 悬崖上的一块石头在暴风雨中崩塌下来。

ex.en: His face cracked into a smile.
ex.cn: 他脸上绽放了微笑。

ex.en: to crack a nut
ex.cn: 把坚果砸开

ex.en: She cracked an egg into the pan.
ex.cn: 她往锅里打了一个鸡蛋。

senses.def: to hit sth/sb with a short hard blow

ex.en: I cracked my head on the low ceiling.
ex.cn: 我的头撞上了低矮的天花板。

ex.en: He cracked me on the head with a ruler.
ex.cn: 他用尺子猛击我的头部。

senses.def: to make a sharp sound; to make sth do this

ex.en: A shot cracked across the ridge.
ex.cn: 一颗炮弹飞过山脊爆炸了。

ex.en: He cracked his whip and galloped away.
ex.cn: 他抽响鞭子，策马飞奔而去。

senses.def: if your voice cracks, it changes in depth, volume, etc. suddenly and in a way that you cannot control

ex.en: In a voice cracking with emotion, he told us of his son's death.
ex.cn: 他悲恸失声地告诉我们他儿子去世的消息。

senses.def: to no longer be able to function normally because of pressure

ex.en: Things are terrible at work and people are cracking under the strain.
ex.cn: 工作情况很糟糕，人们因过度紧张越来越吃不消了。

ex.en: They questioned him for days before he cracked.
ex.cn: 他们审讯他多日后他就垮掉了。

ex.en: The old institutions are cracking.
ex.cn: 旧的制度正在瓦解。

senses.def: to find the solution to a problem, etc.; to find the way to do sth difficult
senses.chn: 找到解决（难题等的）方法

ex.en: to crack the enemy's code
ex.cn: 破译敌人的密码

ex.en: After a year in this job I think I've got it cracked!
ex.cn: 干了一年后，我觉得我已知道怎样做这项工作了！

senses.def: to find a way of stopping or defeating a criminal or an enemy
senses.chn: 阻止，打击，击败，战胜（罪犯或敌人）

ex.en: Police have cracked a major drugs ring.
ex.cn: 警方破获了一个重大的贩毒集团。

senses.def: to open a bottle, especially of wine, and drink it
to tell a joke
to begin immediately and work quickly

ex.en: There's a lot to be done, so let's get cracking.
ex.cn: 要做的工作很多，咱们马上就干吧。

senses.def: not as good as people say

ex.en: He's not nearly such a good writer as he's cracked up to be.
ex.cn: 他远不是人们所说的那种优秀作家。

senses.def: to use your authority or power to make sb work very hard, usually by treating them in a strict way
a difficult problem or situation to deal with
senses.chn: 棘手的问题；不好对付的情形

senses.def: to use more force than is necessary
senses.chn: 抡着大锤砸核桃；杀鸡用牛刀

senses.def: to try harder to prevent an illegal activity and deal more severely with those who are caught doing it
senses.chn: 竭力取缔；严厉打击；镇压

ex.en: Police are cracking down on drug dealers.
ex.cn: 警方正在严厉打击毒品贩子。

senses.def: to work hard at sth so that you finish it quickly; to pass or continue quickly
senses.chn: （为尽快完成而）努力干；（急速）经过，穿过；快速继续下去

ex.en: If we crack on with the painting we should finish it today.
ex.cn: 只要我们拼命干，今天应该就能刷完漆。

ex.en: Time was cracking on and we were nowhere near finished.
ex.cn: 时间飞逝，可我们却远远没有完成。
