senses.chn: （因压力造成身体或精神）垮掉，崩溃

ex.en: You'll crack up if you carry on working like this.
ex.cn: 你再这样干下去，身体会垮掉的。

senses.def: to start laughing a lot

ex.en: He walked in and everyone just cracked up.
ex.cn: 他一进来，人人都捧腹大笑起来。

senses.def: to make sb laugh a lot

ex.en: Gill's so funny, she just cracks me up.
ex.cn: 吉尔滑稽极了，逗得我哈哈大笑。

senses.def: a line on the surface of sth where it has broken but not split into separate parts

ex.en: This cup has a crack in it.
ex.cn: 这杯子有一道裂痕。

ex.en: Cracks began to appear in the walls.
ex.cn: 墙壁开始出现裂缝了。

ex.en: The cracks (= faults) in the government's economic policy are already beginning to show.
ex.cn: 政府经济政策中的失误已开始显露出来。

ex.cn: 他做这项工作完全够格。

ex.cn: 她得首先证明她有担任领导的资格。

ex.cn: 各家报纸都在议论他言行不一。

ex.cn: 我们赊购了一台洗碗机。

ex.cn: 你的信用额度现在为 2 000 英镑。

ex.cn: 银行拒绝再给那家公司提供贷款。

ex.cn: 他这个选手好像很少得到应得的赞扬。

ex.cn: 演出成功不能都算成我一个人的功劳，这是集体努力的结果。

ex.cn: 他年仅 30，却已著有四部小说。

ex.cn: 已把 5 万美元存入你的账户。

ex.cn: 所有撰稿人的姓名均刊登在扉页上。

ex.cn: 我认为你更有见识。

ex.cn: 普遍认为猎豹是世界上跑得最快的动物。

ex.cn: 他说空旷的街道令他毛骨悚然。

ex.cn: 住房价格又在渐渐上涨。

senses.chn: 纵横字谜；纵横填字游戏

ex.en: to do a/the crossword
ex.cn: 做纵横填字游戏

ex.en: I've finished the crossword apart from 3 across and 10 down.
ex.cn: 这份纵横字谜除横 3 竖 10 以外我都填完了。

senses.def: to hope that your plans will be successful (sometimes putting one finger across another as a sign of hoping for good luck)
senses.chn: 祈求成功（有时使手指交叉为祈求好运的手势）

ex.en: I'm crossing my fingers that my proposal will be accepted.
ex.cn: 但愿我的建议能被采纳。

ex.en: Keep your fingers crossed!
ex.cn: 祈求好运吧！

senses.def: to come into your mind

ex.en: It never crossed my mind that she might lose (= I was sure that she would win).
ex.cn: 我从来没想过她会失败。

senses.def: the part of the body where the legs join at the top, including the area around the genitals
the part of a pair of trousers/pants, etc. that covers the crotch

ex.en: There's a hole in the crotch.
ex.cn: 裤裆上有个洞。

senses.def: a note that lasts half as long as a minim/ half note
bad-tempered; easily made angry
senses.chn: 脾气坏的；易怒的；动辄生气的

ex.en: He was tired and crotchety.
ex.cn: 他累了，动不动就发火。

senses.def: having a hole at the crotch
to put your body close to the ground by bending your legs under you

ex.en: He crouched down beside her.
ex.cn: 他在她的旁边蹲了下来。

ex.en: Doyle crouched behind a hedge.
ex.cn: 多伊尔蹲在篱笆后面。

senses.def: to bend over sb/sth so that you are very close to them or it

ex.en: He crouched over the papers on his desk.
ex.cn: 他俯身看他桌上的文件。

senses.def: a crouching position

ex.en: She dropped to a crouch.
ex.cn: 她俯身蹲了下来。

senses.def: a disease of children that makes them cough a lot and have difficulty breathing
senses.chn: 哮吼（儿童疾病，咳得厉害，呼吸困难）

senses.def: a person whose job is to be in charge of a gambling table and collect and pay out money, give out cards, etc.
senses.chn: （负责收付钱、发牌等的）赌台管理员，赌台主持人

senses.def: a small piece of cold crisp fried bread served in soup or as part of a salad
senses.chn: （放在汤或色拉里的）油炸面包丁

senses.def: a large bird, completely or mostly black, with a rough unpleasant cry
a sound like that of a cock/ rooster crowing

ex.en: She gave a little crow of triumph.
ex.cn: 她轻轻地发出了胜利的欢呼声。

senses.def: in a straight line

ex.en: The villages are no more than a mile apart as the crow flies.
ex.cn: 这些村庄直线距离相隔不超过一英里。

senses.def: to say and show that you are sorry for a mistake that you made
used to express surprise, shock, anger, etc.
to make repeated loud high sounds, especially early in the morning
to talk too proudly about sth you have achieved, especially when sb else has been unsuccessful
senses.chn: （尤指在其他人不成功时）扬扬自得地夸口，自鸣得意

ex.en: He won't stop crowing about his victory.
ex.cn: 他滔滔不绝地夸耀自己的胜利。

ex.en: 'I've won, I've won!' she crowed.
ex.cn: “我赢了，我赢了！” 她得意忘形地叫道。

ex.en: He crowed that they had sold out in one day.
ex.cn: 他扬扬得意地炫耀他们一天内就全部售完了。

senses.def: to make happy sounds
a straight iron bar, usually with a curved end, used for forcing open boxes and moving heavy objects
a large number of people gathered together in a public place, for example in the streets or at a sports game

ex.en: He pushed his way through the crowd.
ex.cn: 他在人群中往前挤。

ex.en: A small crowd had gathered outside the church.
ex.cn: 一小群人聚集在教堂的外面。

ex.en: Police had to break up the crowd.
ex.cn: 警方不得不驱散人群。

ex.en: Crowds of people poured into the street.
ex.cn: 人们成群结队涌上街头。

ex.en: I want to get there early to avoid the crowds.
ex.cn: 我想早点儿赶到那里，免得拥挤。

ex.en: The match attracted a capacity crowd of 80 000.
ex.cn: 这场比赛爆满，吸引了 8 万名观众。

senses.def: a particular group of people

ex.en: Bob introduced her to some of the usual crowd (= people who often meet each other).
ex.cn: 鲍勃把她介绍给常见面的几个朋友。

ex.en: the bright young theatrical crowd
ex.cn: 这帮年轻聪明的戏剧演员

senses.def: ordinary people, not special or unusual in any way
senses.chn: 群众；民众；老百姓；凡夫俗子

ex.en: We all like to think we stand out from the crowd (= are different from and better than other people).
ex.cn: 我们都喜欢认为自己胜人一筹。

ex.en: He prefers to be one of the crowd.
ex.cn: 他宁愿做个凡夫俗子。

ex.en: She's quite happy to follow the crowd.
ex.cn: 她就愿意随大溜。

senses.def: to fill a place so there is little room to move

ex.en: Thousands of people crowded the narrow streets.
ex.cn: 成千上万的人把狭窄的街道挤得水泄不通。

senses.def: to fill your mind so that you can think of nothing else

ex.en: Memories crowded his mind.
ex.cn: 往事涌上他的心头。

senses.def: to stand very close to sb so that they feel uncomfortable or nervous
senses.chn: 挤，靠近，挤在一旁（以致使人不舒服或紧张）

senses.def: to gather in large numbers around sb/sth

ex.en: We all crowded around the stove to keep warm.
ex.cn: 我们都挤在炉边取暖。

ex.en: Photographers were crowding around outside.
ex.cn: 摄影师聚集在外面。

senses.def: to fill your mind so that you can think of nothing else

ex.en: Too many uncomfortable thoughts were crowding in on her.
ex.cn: 她心乱如麻。

ex.en: Memories came crowding into her mind.
ex.cn: 往事一齐涌上她的心头。

senses.def: to move in large numbers into a small space

ex.en: We all crowded into her office to sing 'Happy Birthday'.
ex.cn: 我们全都涌进她的办公室，唱 “祝你生日快乐”。

senses.def: to put many people or things into a small space

ex.en: Guests were crowded into the few remaining rooms.
ex.cn: 客人都给塞进了剩下的几个房间。

senses.def: to fill a place so that other people or things are kept out
senses.chn: 把（其他人或物）排挤在外

senses.def: having a lot of people or too many people

ex.en: crowded streets
ex.cn: 拥挤的街道

ex.en: a crowded bar
ex.cn: 挤满人的酒吧

ex.en: In the spring the place is crowded with skiers.
ex.cn: 春季这地方满是滑雪的人。

ex.en: London was very crowded.
ex.cn: 伦敦拥挤不堪。

senses.def: full of sth

ex.en: a room crowded with books
ex.cn: 堆满书籍的房间

ex.en: We have a very crowded schedule.
ex.cn: 我们的日程排得满满的。

senses.def: the practice of funding a project or an activity by raising many small amounts of money from a large number of people, usually using the Internet
senses.chn: 众筹，大众集资（向大众募集小额资金，通常利用互联网进行）

ex.en: They raised the money for the film through crowdfunding.
ex.cn: 他们通过众筹为影片筹措资金。

senses.def: to move in large numbers into a small space

ex.en: We all crowded into her office to sing 'Happy Birthday'.
ex.cn: 我们全都涌进她的办公室，唱 “祝你生日快乐”。

senses.def: to fill your mind so that you can think of nothing else

ex.en: Too many uncomfortable thoughts were crowding in on her.
ex.cn: 她心乱如麻。

ex.en: Memories came crowding into her mind.
ex.cn: 往事一齐涌上她的心头。

senses.def: a person or performance that always pleases an audience
a person or thing that always attracts a large audience
senses.chn: 吸引大量观众的人（或事物）

senses.def: the activity of getting information or help for a project or a task from a large number of people, typically using the Internet
senses.chn: 众包，众源（向大众寻求信息或帮助，尤利用互联网进行）

ex.en: The newspaper uses crowdsourcing to gather information for its website.
ex.cn: 这家报纸采用众包模式为其网站收集信息。

senses.def: an object in the shape of a circle, usually made of gold and precious stones, that a king or queen wears on his or her head on official occasions
the government of a country, thought of as being represented by a king or queen

ex.en: land owned by the Crown
ex.cn: 王国的土地

ex.en: a Minister of the Crown
ex.cn: 王国的大臣

ex.en: Who's appearing for the Crown (= bringing a criminal charge against sb on behalf of the state) in this case?
ex.cn: 谁将在此案中代表王国政府出庭？

senses.def: the position or power of a king or queen

ex.en: She refused the crown (= refused to become queen).
ex.cn: 她拒绝接受王位。

ex.en: his claim to the French crown
ex.cn: 他声称有继任法国王位的权利

senses.def: a circle of flowers, leaves, etc. that is worn on sb's head, sometimes as a sign of victory
senses.chn: 花冠（戴在头上，有时象征胜利）

senses.def: the position of winning a sports competition

ex.en: She is determined to retain her Wimbledon crown.
ex.cn: 她决心卫冕她的温布尔登网球赛的冠军宝座。

senses.def: the top part of the head or a hat
the highest part of sth

ex.en: the crown of a hill
ex.cn: 山顶

senses.def: an artificial cover for a damaged tooth
anything in the shape of a crown, especially as a decoration or a badge
senses.chn: 王冠状物（尤指饰物或徽章）

senses.def: a unit of money in several European countries
senses.chn: 克朗（欧洲一些国家的货币单位）

ex.en: Czech crowns
ex.cn: 捷克克朗

senses.def: an old British coin worth five shillings (= now 25p) *
senses.chn: 5 先令的英国旧币（等于现在的 25 便士）

senses.def: the most attractive or valuable part of sth
senses.chn: 王冠上的宝石；最有吸引力（或珍贵、有价值）的东西

senses.def: to put a crown on the head of a new king or queen as a sign of royal power

ex.en: Queen Elizabeth was crowned in 1953.
ex.cn: 伊丽莎白女王于 1953 年加冕。

ex.en: The prince was soon to be crowned King of England.
ex.cn: 王子不久就要被立为英格兰国王了。

senses.def: to form or cover the top of sth

ex.en: His head was crowned with a mop of brown curls.
ex.cn: 他长了一头蓬乱的棕色鬈发。

senses.def: to make sth complete or perfect, especially by adding an achievement, a success, etc.
senses.chn: （尤指通过增添成就、成功等）使圆满，使完美

ex.en: The award of the Nobel Prize has crowned a glorious career in physics.
ex.cn: 荣获诺贝尔奖使其物理学研究的辉煌事业达到了顶点。

ex.en: Their efforts were finally crowned with success.
ex.cn: 他们的努力终于取得圆满成功。

senses.def: to hit sb on the head
to put an artificial cover on a tooth

ex.en: I've had one of my teeth crowned.
ex.cn: 我的一颗牙齿镶了假齿冠。

senses.def: used to say that sth is the final and worst event in a series of unpleasant or annoying events
senses.chn: （在一系列不愉快或讨厌的事件中）最糟糕的是

ex.en: It was cold and raining, and, to crown it all, we had to walk home.
ex.cn: 天气寒冷又下着雨，最糟的是我们得走着回家。

senses.def: a colony ruled directly by the British government
a court which deals with criminal cases, with a judge and jury
senses.chn: 刑事法院（有法官和陪审团）

senses.def: making sth perfect or complete

ex.en: The cathedral is the crowning glory of the city.
ex.cn: 大教堂是这座城市至高无上的骄傲。

ex.en: His 'Beethoven' sculpture is seen as the crowning achievement of his career.
ex.cn: 人们认为他制作的贝多芬雕像是他在事业上取得的最高成就。

senses.def: the crown and other objects worn or carried by a king or queen on formal occasions
senses.chn: 御宝（国王或女王在正式场合佩戴的饰物）

senses.def: (in some countries) a prince who will become king when the present king or queen dies
the wife of a crown prince
(in some countries) a princess who will become queen when the present king or queen dies
in England and Wales, a lawyer who works for the state
senses.chn: （英格兰和威尔士的）皇家检察官

senses.def: lines in the skin around the outer corner of a person's eye
a platform at the top of a ship's mast (= the post that supports the sails) from which sb can see a long way and watch for land, danger, etc.
extremely important, because it will affect other things

ex.en: a crucial factor/issue/decision
ex.cn: 关键性的因素／问题／决定

ex.en: topics of crucial importance
ex.cn: 至关重要的课题

ex.en: The next few weeks are going to be crucial.
ex.cn: 今后几个星期是关键。

ex.en: Winning this contract is crucial to the success of the company.
ex.cn: 赢得这份合同对这家公司的成败至关重要。

ex.en: It is crucial that we get this right.
ex.cn: 我们把这个问题弄明白是极其重要的。

ex.en: Parents play a crucial role in preparing their child for school.
ex.cn: 父母对孩子做好上学的准备起着至关重要的作用。

senses.def: a pot in which substances are heated to high temperatures, metals are melted, etc.
a place or situation in which people or ideas are tested severely, often creating sth new or exciting in the process
a model of a cross with a figure of Jesus Christ on it, as a symbol of the Christian religion
the act of killing sb by fastening them to a cross

ex.en: the Crucifixion (= of Jesus)
ex.cn: 耶稣被钉在十字架上

senses.def: a painting or other work of art representing the crucifixion of Jesus Christ
senses.chn: 十字架苦像（耶稣受难的画像或艺术品）

senses.def: in the shape of a cross
to kill sb as a punishment by fastening them to a wooden cross
senses.chn: 把（某人）钉（或捆）在木十字架上处死

senses.def: to criticize or punish sb very severely

ex.en: The prime minister was crucified in the press for his handling of the affair.
ex.cn: 首相因处理此事的方式而受到新闻界的严厉抨击。

senses.def: any dirty or unpleasant substance
bad, dirty or of low quality

ex.en: We got really cruddy service in that restaurant last time.
ex.cn: 我们上次在那家餐馆得到的服务实在差极了。

senses.def: simple and not very accurate but giving a general idea of sth

ex.en: In crude terms, the causes of mental illness seem to be of three main kinds.
ex.cn: 简略地说，导致精神病的原因看起来主要有三种。

senses.def: simply made, not showing much skill or attention to detail

ex.en: a crude drawing of a face
ex.cn: 脸部的略图

senses.def: offensive or rude, especially about sex
senses.chn: 冒犯的，粗俗的，粗鲁的（尤其有关性的）

ex.en: crude jokes/language
ex.cn: 粗俗的笑话／语言

senses.def: in its natural state, before it has been treated with chemicals

ex.en: crude oil/metal
ex.cn: 原油；未经提炼的金属

senses.def: oil in its natural state, before it has been treated with chemicals

ex.en: 50 000 barrels of crude
ex.cn: 5 万桶石油

senses.def: the fact of being crude; an example of sth crude
senses.chn: 粗糙，简陋，粗俗，粗鲁（的事例）

ex.en: Despite the crudity of their methods and equipment, the experiment was a considerable success.
ex.cn: 尽管他们的方法和设备较为粗陋，那次实验却相当成功。

ex.en: the novel's structural crudities
ex.cn: 那部小说粗糙的结构

ex.en: The crudity of her language shocked him.
ex.cn: 她粗鄙的语言使他感到震惊。

senses.def: having a desire to cause pain and suffering
senses.chn: 残酷的；冷酷的；残忍的；残暴的

ex.en: a cruel dictator
ex.cn: 残暴的独裁者

ex.en: I can't stand people who are cruel to animals.
ex.cn: 我无法容忍虐待动物的人。

ex.en: Her eyes were cruel and hard.
ex.cn: 她目光冷酷逼人。

ex.en: Sometimes you have to be cruel to be kind (= make sb suffer because it will be good for them later).
ex.cn: 有时候为了某人好你就得对他狠。

senses.def: causing pain or suffering

ex.en: a cruel punishment/joke
ex.cn: 残酷的惩罚；挖苦人的笑话

ex.en: Her father's death was a cruel blow.
ex.cn: 父亲去世对她是一大打击。

senses.def: behaviour that causes pain or suffering to others, especially deliberately

ex.en: cruelty to animals
ex.cn: 对动物的虐待

ex.en: The deliberate cruelty of his words cut her like a knife.
ex.cn: 他故意说的那些残酷无情的话对她像刀割一样。

senses.def: a cruel action
something that happens that seems unfair

ex.en: the cruelties of life
ex.cn: 生活中的种种不公

senses.def: a small container, or set of containers, for salt, pepper, oil, etc. for use on the table at meals
senses.chn: （餐桌上的）调味瓶，一组调味瓶

senses.def: a journey by sea, visiting different places, especially as a holiday/vacation

ex.en: I'd love to go on a round-the-world cruise.
ex.cn: 我很想乘船周游世界。

ex.en: a luxury cruise ship
ex.cn: 豪华游轮

senses.def: to travel in a ship or boat visiting different places, especially as a holiday/vacation

ex.en: They cruised down the Nile.
ex.cn: 他们沿尼罗河而下乘船游览。

ex.en: We spent two weeks cruising the Bahamas.
ex.cn: 我们花了两个星期乘船游览巴哈马群岛。

senses.def: to travel at a steady speed

ex.en: a light aircraft cruising at 4 000 feet
ex.cn: 一架在 4 000 英尺高度巡航的轻型飞机

ex.en: a cruising speed of 50 miles an hour
ex.cn: 每小时 50 英里平稳行驶的速度

senses.def: to drive along slowly, especially when you are looking at or for sth
senses.chn: （尤指查看或寻找时）慢速行驶，巡行

ex.en: She cruised around the block looking for a parking space.
ex.cn: 她绕着那个街区慢慢行驶，想找个停车位。

ex.en: Taxis cruised the streets, looking for fares.
ex.cn: 出租汽车在街上缓慢行驶招揽顾客。

senses.def: to win or achieve sth easily
senses.chn: 轻而易举赢得（或获得）；轻取

ex.en: The home team cruised to victory.
ex.cn: 主队轻松取胜。

senses.def: to go around in public places looking for a sexual partner
senses.chn: （在公共场所）寻觅性伙伴，猎艳

senses.def: a device in a vehicle that allows it to stay at the speed that the driver has chosen
senses.chn: 定速巡航装置（让车辆以选定速度行驶）

senses.def: a large weapon with a warhead that flies close to the ground and is guided by its own computer to an exact place
a large fast ship used in war
a boat with a motor and room for people to sleep, used for pleasure trips
a police car
a very small piece of food, especially of bread or cake, that has fallen off a larger piece
senses.chn: 食物碎屑；（尤指）面包屑，糕饼屑

ex.en: She stood up and brushed the crumbs from her sweater.
ex.cn: 她站起身掸掉了毛衣上的面包屑。

senses.def: a small piece or amount

ex.en: a few crumbs of useful information
ex.cn: 点滴有用的消息

ex.en: The government's only crumb of comfort is that their opponents are as confused as they are.
ex.cn: 政府唯一聊以自慰的是反对派与他们一样困惑不解。

senses.def: to break or break sth into very small pieces

ex.en: Rice flour makes the cake less likely to crumble.
ex.cn: 这种糕饼用米粉做不那么容易碎。

ex.en: Crumble the cheese over the salad.
ex.cn: 把干酪弄成碎屑洒在色拉上。

senses.def: if a building or piece of land is crumbling, parts of it are breaking off

ex.en: buildings crumbling into dust
ex.cn: 渐渐坍塌的建筑物

ex.en: crumbling stonework
ex.cn: 不断破裂的石制建筑

ex.en: The cliff is gradually crumbling away.
ex.cn: 峭壁正在逐渐崩坍。

senses.def: to begin to fail or get weaker or to come to an end
senses.chn: （开始渐渐）衰退，衰弱；崩溃；瓦解；消亡

ex.en: a crumbling business/relationship
ex.cn: 逐渐衰败的企业；日益恶化的关系

ex.en: All his hopes began to crumble away.
ex.cn: 他所有的希望开始化为泡影。

ex.en: The empire finally crumbled into dust.
ex.cn: 这个帝国最终崩溃了。

senses.def: that is the situation and we cannot change it, so we must accept it
senses.chn: 情况就是这样；没有别的办法

senses.def: a dessert (= a sweet dish) made from fruit that is covered with a rough mixture of flour, butter and sugar, cooked in the oven and usually served hot

ex.en: apple crumble and custard
ex.cn: 酥皮苹果甜点心加蛋奶沙司

senses.def: that easily breaks into very small pieces

ex.en: crumbly soil/cheese
ex.cn: 易碎的土壤／干酪

senses.def: used to show that you are surprised

ex.en: Oh crumbs! Is that the time?
ex.cn: 啊，天哪！都这会儿啦？

senses.def: of very bad quality

ex.en: Most of his songs are pretty crummy.
ex.cn: 他的歌曲大多糟糕透顶。

senses.def: a small flat round cake with small holes in the top, eaten hot with butter
senses.chn: （上层有孔，涂上黄油趁热吃的）小圆烤饼

senses.def: an offensive way of referring to people who are sexually attractive, usually women
senses.chn: （对性感的人的蔑称，通常指女人）

senses.def: to crush sth into folds; to become crushed into folds

ex.en: She crumpled the letter up into a ball and threw it on the fire.

senses.chn: （报章等描述女子）有曲线美的，体形优美的

senses.def: the state of being curved; the amount that sth is curved

ex.en: the delicate curve of her ear
ex.cn: 她耳朵的优美曲线

ex.cn: 直线与曲线交织的图案

ex.en: a curve in the road
ex.cn: 道路上的拐弯处

ex.cn: 司机在拐弯处失控，车撞到了一棵树上。

ex.en: the unemployment-income curve (= a line on a graph showing the relationship between the number of unemployed people and national income)

senses.def: a ball that moves in a curve when it is thrown to the batter

ex.cn: 一名记者向那位参议员提出了一个出乎意料的难题。

senses.def: in advance of or behind a particular trend

ex.en: Our expert advice will help you stay ahead of the curve.
ex.cn: 我们的专业建议将有助于你保持引领潮流。

ex.en: We've fallen behind the curve when it comes to developing new digital products.
ex.cn: 就开发新的数字产品而论，我们已经落后了。

senses.def: to move or make sth move in the shape of a curve; to be in the shape of a curve

ex.en: The road curved around the bay.
ex.cn: 那条路沿海湾呈曲线伸展。

ex.en: The ball curved through the air.
ex.cn: 球在空中沿曲线移动。

ex.en: His lips curved in a smile.
ex.cn: 他咧嘴笑了。

ex.en: A smile curved his lips.
ex.cn: 他咧嘴笑了。

senses.def: having a round shape

ex.en: a curved path/roof/blade
ex.cn: 蜿蜒的小路；拱顶；弧形刀片

senses.def: consisting of a curved line or lines
having curves

ex.en: a curvy body
ex.cn: 富有曲线美的身段

ex.en: curvy lines
ex.cn: 弯弯曲曲的线条

senses.def: a cloth bag filled with soft material or feathers that is used, for example, to make a seat more comfortable

ex.en: matching curtains and cushions
ex.cn: 颜色协调的窗帘与靠垫

ex.en: a floor cushion (= a large cushion that you put on the floor to sit on)
ex.cn: 地板坐垫

ex.en: a pile of scatter cushions (= small cushions, often in bright colours, that you put on chairs, etc.)
ex.cn: 一堆小靠垫

ex.en: a cushion of moss on a rock
ex.cn: 岩石上的一层苔藓

senses.def: a layer of sth between two surfaces that keeps them apart

ex.en: A hovercraft rides on a cushion of air.
ex.cn: 气垫船悬浮在气垫上行驶。

senses.def: something that protects you against sth unpleasant that might happen
senses.chn: 起保护（或缓冲）作用的事物

ex.en: His savings were a comfortable cushion against financial problems.
ex.cn: 他的积蓄好比一个舒适的垫子，可以缓解财务问题。

ex.en: The team built up a safe cushion of two goals in the first half.
ex.cn: 球队上半场射进两球，吃了颗定心丸。

senses.def: the soft inside edge along each side of the table, that the balls bounce off
senses.chn: （台球桌内侧边缘的）弹性衬里

senses.def: to make the effect of a fall or hit less severe
senses.chn: （跌倒或碰撞时）起缓冲作用，缓和冲击

ex.en: My fall was cushioned by the deep snow.
ex.cn: 积雪很厚，我跌得不重。

senses.def: to protect sb/sth from being hurt or damaged or from the unpleasant effects of sth

ex.en: The south of the country has been cushioned from the worst effects of the recession.
ex.cn: 国家南部保护得好，没有受到经济衰退造成的最恶劣影响。

ex.en: He broke the news of my brother's death to me, making no effort to cushion the blow (= make the news less shocking).
ex.cn: 他把我弟弟死亡的消息直接告诉了我，没有试图减轻此事对我的打击。

senses.def: to make sth soft with a cushion
very easy and pleasant; needing little or no effort
senses.chn: 轻松愉快的；安逸的；不费劲的

ex.en: a cushy job
ex.cn: 不费心劳神的工作

senses.def: an easy job; a pleasant situation that other people would like
senses.chn: 轻松的工作；美差；令人羡慕的轻松状态

senses.def: a pointed end where two curves meet
senses.chn: （两曲线相交的）尖点，会切点，交点

ex.en: the cusp of a leaf
ex.cn: 叶尖

senses.def: the time when one sign of the zodiac ends and the next begins
senses.chn: （黄道十二宫的）两宫会切的时辰

ex.en: I was born on the cusp between Virgo and Libra.
ex.cn: 我生于室女宫和天秤宫会切的时辰。

ex.en: He was on the cusp between small acting roles and moderate fame.
ex.cn: 他这个配角演员现在已是小荷初露尖尖角。

senses.def: to swear at sb

ex.en: My dad used to come home drunk, shouting and cussing.
ex.cn: 我爹以前常常喝醉了回家，又是喊又是骂。

senses.def: used with a negative adjective to describe a person
senses.chn: （与贬义形容词一起用于描述人）家伙

ex.en: He's an awkward cuss.
ex.cn: 他是个笨家伙。

senses.def: not willing to be helpful
a sweet yellow sauce made from milk, sugar, eggs and flour, usually served hot with cooked fruit, puddings, etc.
senses.chn: 蛋奶沙司（通常与熟水果、布丁等一同食用）

ex.en: apple pie and custard
ex.cn: 苹果馅饼加蛋奶沙司

senses.def: a mixture of eggs, milk and sugar baked until it is firm
a flat pie filled with sth soft and wet that looks like custard, that performers throw at each other to make people laugh
senses.chn: （表演者互相投掷逗乐用的）蛋奶馅饼

senses.def: involving sending sb to prison

ex.en: The judge gave him a custodial sentence (= sent him to prison).
ex.cn: 法官判处他监禁。

senses.def: connected with the right or duty of taking care of sb; having custody
senses.chn: 监护权的；监管职责的；有监护权的

ex.en: The mother is usually the custodial parent after a divorce.
ex.cn: 离婚后母亲通常拥有孩子的监护权。

senses.def: a person who takes responsibility for taking care of or protecting sth

ex.en: the museum's custodians
ex.cn: 博物馆的管理员

ex.en: a self-appointed custodian of public morals
ex.cn: 自封的公共道德的卫道士

senses.def: a person whose job is to take care of a building such as a school or a block of flats or an apartment building
senses.chn: （建筑物的）管理员，看管人，看门人

senses.def: the legal right or duty to take care of or keep sb/sth; the act of taking care of sth/sb
senses.chn: 监护权；保管权；监护；保管

ex.en: Who will have custody of the children?
ex.cn: 谁来负责监护这些孩子？

ex.en: The divorce court awarded custody to the child's mother.
ex.cn: 离婚法庭把监护权判给了孩子的母亲。

ex.en: The parents were locked in a bitter battle for custody.
ex.cn: 双亲陷入了一场对孩子监护权的激烈争夺之中。

ex.en: The bank provides safe custody for valuables.
ex.cn: 这家银行提供对贵重物品的安全保管服务。

ex.en: The castle is now in the custody of the state.
ex.cn: 现在那座城堡由国家照管。

senses.def: the state of being in prison, especially while waiting for trial
senses.chn: （尤指在候审时的）拘留，拘押，羁押

ex.en: After the riot, 32 people were taken into police custody.
ex.cn: 那场暴乱后，有 32 人被警方拘留。

ex.en: He was remanded in custody, charged with the murder of a policeman.
ex.cn: 他被控谋杀一名警察，正在羁押候审。

senses.def: an accepted way of behaving or of doing things in a society or a community

ex.en: an old/ancient custom
ex.cn: 旧的／古老的习俗

ex.en: the custom of giving presents at Christmas
ex.cn: 在圣诞节赠送礼物的习俗

ex.en: It's a local custom.
ex.cn: 这是当地的风俗习惯。

ex.en: It is the custom in that country for women to marry young.
ex.cn: 女子早婚是那个国家的风俗。

senses.def: the way a person always behaves

ex.en: It was her custom to rise early.
ex.cn: 早起是她的习惯。

ex.en: As was his custom, he knocked three times.
ex.cn: 一如既往，他敲了三下。

senses.def: the fact of a person or people buying goods or services at a shop/store or business

ex.en: Thank you for your custom. Please call again.
ex.cn: 谢谢您的惠顾，请下次再来。

ex.en: We've lost a lot of custom since prices went up.
ex.cn: 自从价格上涨以来我们失去了很多生意。

senses.def: if sth is customary, it is what people usually do in a particular place or situation

ex.en: Is it customary to tip hairdressers in this country?
ex.cn: 这个国家兴不兴给理发师小费？

senses.def: typical of a particular person

ex.en: She arranged everything with her customary efficiency.
ex.cn: 她以她特有的高效率把一切都已安排妥当。

senses.def: designed and built for a particular person
a person or an organization that buys sth from a shop/store or business

ex.en: one of the shop's best/biggest customers
ex.cn: 此商店最佳／最大的客户之一

ex.en: They know me—I'm a regular customer.
ex.cn: 我是老主顾，他们都认识我。

ex.en: the customer service department
ex.cn: 客户服务部

ex.en: The firm has excellent customer relations.
ex.cn: 此公司与客户关系极好。

senses.def: used after an adjective to describe a particular type of person
senses.chn: （用于形容词之后描述某类型的人）家伙

ex.en: an awkward customer
ex.cn: 难对付的家伙

senses.def: all the people who buy or use a particular product or service
senses.chn: （统称某种产品或服务的）客户

ex.en: We need to appeal to a wider customer base.
ex.cn: 我们需要吸引更广泛的客户。

senses.def: dealing directly with customers or used by customers

ex.en: customer-facing operations such as call centres
ex.cn: 呼叫中心之类的客户服务

ex.en: customer-facing software applications
ex.cn: 面向客户的软件应用程序

senses.def: to make or change sth to suit the needs of the owner
senses.chn: 定制，定做，改制（以满足顾主的需要）

ex.en: You can customize the software in several ways.
ex.cn: 你可用几种方法按需要编制这个软件。

senses.def: designed and made for a particular person
the government department that collects taxes on goods bought and sold and on goods brought into the country, and that checks what is brought in

ex.en: French Customs have arrested two men.
ex.cn: 法国海关逮捕了两名男子。

ex.en: a customs officer
ex.cn: 海关官员

senses.def: the place at a port or an airport where your bags are checked as you come into a country

ex.en: to go through customs and passport control
ex.cn: 通过海关和交验护照

senses.def: the taxes that must be paid to the government when goods are brought in from other countries

ex.en: to pay customs on sth
ex.cn: 为某物缴纳关税

ex.en: customs duty/duties
ex.cn: 进口税

ex.en: income tax
ex.cn: 所得税

ex.en: tax cuts
ex.cn: 减税

ex.en: The company has to pay customs duties on all imports.
ex.cn: 该公司须为所有进口货物缴纳关税。

ex.en: A general tariff was imposed on foreign imports.
ex.cn: 国外进口货物当时按普通税率征税。

senses.def: a group of states that agree to have the same taxes on imported goods
senses.chn: 关税同盟（缔约国按统一关税进口商品）

senses.def: to make an opening or a wound in sth, especially with a sharp tool such as a knife or scissors

ex.en: She cut her finger on a piece of glass.
ex.cn: 一块玻璃把她的手指头划破了。

ex.en: He cut himself (= his face) shaving.
ex.cn: 他刮胡子把脸刮破了。

ex.en: She had fallen and cut her head open.
ex.cn: 她摔了一跤，把头磕破了。

ex.en: You need a powerful saw to cut through metal.
ex.cn: 切割金属需要用功率大的锯。

ex.en: The canoe cut through the water.
ex.cn: 独木舟划破水面前行。

senses.def: to remove sth or a part of sth, using a knife, etc.

ex.en: He cut four thick slices from the loaf.
ex.cn: 他从一条面包上切下四厚片。

ex.en: a bunch of cut flowers
ex.cn: 一束剪下的花朵

ex.en: I cut them all a piece of birthday cake.
ex.cn: 我给他们每个人都切了一块生日蛋糕。

ex.en: I cut a piece of birthday cake for them all.
ex.cn: 我给他们每个人都切了一块生日蛋糕。

senses.def: to make or form sth by removing material with a knife, etc.
senses.chn: 切成；割成；剪成；削成；凿成

ex.en: The climbers cut steps in the ice.
ex.cn: 攀登者在冰上凿出踩脚处。

ex.en: Workmen cut a hole in the pipe.
ex.cn: 工人在管子上切了一个口。

senses.def: to divide sth into two or more pieces with a knife, etc.

ex.en: Don't cut the string, untie the knots.
ex.cn: 不要剪断绳子，把结解开。

ex.en: He cut the loaf into thick slices.
ex.cn: 他把那条面包切成了厚片。

ex.en: The bus was cut in two by the train.
ex.cn: 那辆公共汽车被火车撞成两截。

ex.en: Now cut the tomatoes in half.
ex.cn: 把西红柿都切成两半。

senses.def: to make sth shorter by cutting

ex.en: to cut your hair/nails
ex.cn: 理发；剪指甲

ex.en: to cut the grass/lawn/hedge
ex.cn: 修剪草／草坪／树篱

ex.en: He's had his hair cut really short.
ex.cn: 他头发理得真短。

senses.def: to allow sb to escape from somewhere by cutting the rope, object, etc. that is holding them
senses.chn: （割断绳子、某物等）让（某人）逃跑，释放

ex.en: The injured driver had to be cut from the wreckage.
ex.cn: 受伤的司机不得不等到把汽车残骸拆开才逃出来。

ex.en: Two survivors were cut free after being trapped for twenty minutes.
ex.cn: 两名幸存者受困二十分钟后才被解救出来。

senses.def: to design and make a piece of clothing in a particular way

ex.en: The swimsuit was cut high in the leg.
ex.cn: 这件游泳衣的腿部开口很高。

senses.def: to be capable of cutting

ex.en: This knife won't cut.
ex.cn: 这把刀不快。

senses.def: to be capable of being cut

ex.en: Sandstone cuts easily.
ex.cn: 沙岩容易切割。

senses.def: to reduce sth by removing a part of it

ex.en: to cut prices/taxes/spending/production
ex.cn: 削价；减税；缩减开支；降低产量

ex.en: Buyers will bargain hard to cut the cost of the house they want.
ex.cn: 买主会竭力讨价还价以压低他们想买的房子的价格。

ex.en: His salary has been cut by ten per cent.
ex.cn: 他的薪金减少了百分之十。

ex.en: Could you cut your essay from 5 000 to 3 000 words?
ex.cn: 请把你的文章从 5 000 字删减到 3 000 字好吗？

ex.en: The President has promised to cut taxes significantly.
ex.cn: 总统承诺大幅度减税。

ex.en: Buyers will bargain hard to cut the cost of the house they want.
ex.cn: 买主会竭力讨价还价以压低他们想买的房子的价格。

senses.def: to remove sth from sth

ex.en: This scene was cut from the final version of the movie.
ex.cn: 这场戏在电影的最终版本中被删剪了。

senses.def: to delete (= remove) part of a text on a computer screen in order to place it somewhere else

ex.en: You can cut and paste between different programs.
ex.cn: 可在不同的程序之间进行剪切和粘贴。

senses.def: used to tell sb to stop doing sth

ex.en: Cut the chatter and get on with your work!
ex.cn: 别闲聊了，继续干活吧！

senses.def: to completely end a relationship or all communication with sb

ex.en: She has cut all ties with her family.
ex.cn: 她已经和家人完全断绝关系。

senses.def: to prepare a film/movie or tape by removing parts of it or putting them in a different order
to stop filming or recording

ex.en: The director shouted 'Cut!'
ex.cn: “停！” 导演大声喊道。

senses.def: to move quickly from one scene to another

ex.en: The scene cuts from the bedroom to the street.
ex.cn: 镜头从卧室转换到街道。

senses.def: to stay away from a class that you should go to

ex.en: He's always cutting class.
ex.cn: 他总是旷课。

senses.def: to hurt sb emotionally

ex.en: His cruel remarks cut her deeply.
ex.cn: 他那些无情的话深深地刺痛了她的心。

senses.def: to divide a pack/ deck of playing cards by lifting a section from the top, in order to reveal a card to decide who is to play first, etc.
senses.chn: 切牌，抽牌（为决定谁先出牌等）

ex.en: Let's cut for dealer.
ex.cn: 咱们切牌决定由谁发牌吧。

senses.def: to cross another line

ex.en: The line cuts the circle at two points.
ex.cn: 那条线与圆相交于两点。

senses.def: to have a new tooth beginning to appear through the gum

ex.en: When did she cut her first tooth?
ex.cn: 她什么时候长出了第一颗牙？

senses.def: to make a recording of music on a record, CD, etc.
senses.chn: 灌制（唱片）；制作（激光唱片等）

ex.en: The Beatles cut their first disc in 1962.
ex.cn: 披头士乐队于 1962 年灌制了他们的第一张唱片。

senses.def: to mix an illegal drug such as heroin with another substance
senses.chn: 把（海洛因等）与另一种物质掺和

senses.def: to make a quick or sudden escape
to (not) be as good as is expected or needed
senses.chn: （不）如预想的一般好；（不）像所需要的那么好

ex.en: He won't cut it as a professional singer.
ex.cn: 他的歌艺未达到专业歌手水平。

senses.def: to affect or be true for different groups that usually remain separate
senses.chn: 影响，符合，适用于（分离的不同群体）

ex.en: Opinion on this issue cuts across traditional political boundaries.
ex.cn: 人们对这个问题的看法超越了传统的政治界限。

senses.def: to go across sth in order to make your route shorter

ex.en: I usually cut across the park on my way home.
ex.cn: 我回家常抄近路，打公园里头走。

senses.def: to remove sth from sth by cutting

ex.en: They cut away all the dead branches from the tree.
ex.cn: 他们把这棵树上的枯枝全都砍掉了。

senses.def: to reduce sth

ex.en: If we don't sell more we'll have to cut back production.
ex.cn: 我们若不能多销，就必须减产。

ex.en: to cut back on spending
ex.cn: 削减开支

senses.def: to make a bush, etc. smaller by cutting branches off

ex.en: to cut back a rose bush
ex.cn: 给玫瑰丛剪枝

senses.def: to kill sb

ex.en: He was cut down by an assassin's bullet.
ex.cn: 他被刺客的子弹击中身亡。

senses.def: to make sth fall down by cutting it at the base

ex.en: to cut down a tree
ex.cn: 齐根砍倒一棵树

senses.def: to reduce the size, amount or number of sth
senses.chn: 削减，缩小（尺寸、数量或数目）

ex.en: We need to cut the article down to 1 000 words.
ex.cn: 我们得把这篇文章压缩到 1 000 字。

ex.en: The doctor told him to cut down on his drinking.
ex.cn: 医生劝他少喝酒。

ex.en: I won't have a cigarette, thanks—I'm trying to cut down (= smoke fewer).
ex.cn: 谢谢，我不抽。我现在尽量少抽烟。

senses.def: if a motor or an engine cuts in, it starts working

ex.en: Emergency generators cut in.
ex.cn: 应急发电机启动了。

senses.def: to go in front of other people who are waiting
to interrupt sb when they are speaking

ex.en: She kept cutting in on our conversation.
ex.cn: 我们谈话时她老是插嘴。

ex.en: 'Forget it!' she cut in.
ex.cn: “算了吧！” 她插嘴道。

senses.def: to move suddenly in front of another vehicle, leaving little space between the two vehicles
to give sb a share of the profit in a business or an activity
to interrupt sb who is speaking on the telephone by breaking the connection

ex.en: We were cut off in the middle of our conversation.
ex.cn: 我们电话打到一半就断线了。

senses.def: to refuse to let sb receive any of your property after you die

ex.en: He cut his son off without a penny.
ex.cn: 他完全剥夺了儿子的继承权。

senses.def: to interrupt sb and stop them from speaking
senses.chn: 打断（某人并阻止其讲话）

ex.en: My explanation was cut off by loud protests.
ex.cn: 我的解释被强烈的抗议声打断了。

senses.def: to stop the supply of sth to sb

ex.en: Our water supply has been cut off.
ex.cn: 我们断水了。

ex.en: They were cut off for not paying their phone bill.
ex.cn: 他们未付电话费，被停机了。
